families.title: Informatiki ya kitabibu na usalama wa kitabibu

bands.title: Daraja la 1
bands.knowledge: Ujuzi wa msingi wa kusoma, kuandika na kuhesabu; hujifunza kazi rahisi za kila siku kazini.
bands.autonomy: Hufuata maelekezo wazi; kazi hukaguliwa mara kwa mara.
bands.accountability: Kukamilisha kazi za kila siku kwa usahihi.

bands.title: Daraja la 2
bands.knowledge: Anajua taratibu na kawaida za eneo la kazi; anaweza kuwa na sifa ya awali ya elimu.
bands.autonomy: Hufanya kazi kwa taratibu zilizowekwa, huku usimamizi ukipatikana.
bands.leadership: Anaweza kuwaonyesha wafanyakazi wapya kazi za kila siku.
bands.accountability: Ubora na wakati wa kukamilisha kazi zake za kila siku.

bands.title: Daraja la 3
bands.knowledge: Ujuzi wa taratibu mbalimbali, baadhi zikiwa si za kawaida; kwa kawaida sifa ya kiwango cha 3 au uzoefu unaolingana.
bands.autonomy: Hufanya kazi ndani ya taratibu; huamua jinsi ya kupanga kazi yake; hupeleka matatizo juu.
bands.scope: Kazi yake na baadhi ya kazi za timu pana zaidi.
bands.leadership: Anaweza kugawa kazi za kila siku au kuwafunza wengine taratibu.
bands.accountability: Usahihi wa kazi yake na wa kumbukumbu anazotunza.

bands.title: Daraja la 4
bands.stage: Msaada na mtaalamu wa ngazi ya kuanza
bands.knowledge: Ujuzi wa kina wa eneo la kazi, kwa kawaida kutokana na stashahada, uanagenzi, au uzoefu unaolingana.
bands.autonomy: Hufanya kazi ndani ya miongozo; hutatua matatizo mengi ya kila siku; meneja anapatikana kwa ushauri.
bands.scope: Kazi yake na huduma au mchakato uliobainishwa.
bands.leadership: Anaweza kusimamia timu ndogo au kuratibu kazi za wengine.
bands.accountability: Utoaji wa huduma au mchakato uliobainishwa.

bands.title: Daraja la 5
bands.knowledge: Ujuzi wa kitaaluma au kiufundi, kwa kawaida kutokana na shahada au uzoefu unaolingana.
bands.autonomy: Hufanya kazi kuelekea malengo mapana ndani ya viwango vya kitaaluma; hupanga kazi yake mwenyewe.
bands.scope: Kazi yake ya kitaaluma ndani ya timu au bidhaa.
bands.leadership: Anaweza kuwaongoza na kukagua kazi za wafanyakazi wa msaada na wanagenzi.
bands.accountability: Ubora wa kazi yake ya kitaaluma.

bands.title: Daraja la 6
bands.knowledge: Ujuzi maalumu katika taratibu mbalimbali, uliojengwa kwa mafunzo ya ziada au uzoefu.
bands.autonomy: Hufanya kazi kwa kujitegemea; hufasiri sera kwa eneo lake; hutafuta ushauri kwa masuala magumu.
bands.scope: Bidhaa, huduma, au mkondo wa kazi.
bands.leadership: Anaweza kuongoza timu ndogo au kuwa mshauri wa wenzake.
bands.accountability: Matokeo ya mkondo wake wa kazi na ubora wa ushauri anaotoa.

bands.title: Daraja la 7
bands.knowledge: Ujuzi maalumu uliokuzwa sana, kwa kawaida hadi kiwango cha shahada ya uzamili au uzoefu unaolingana.
bands.autonomy: Hufanya kazi kwa sera ya taasisi; huamua jinsi matokeo yanavyofikiwa; ndiye mtaalamu wanayemshauriana naye wengine.
bands.scope: Bidhaa au huduma kadhaa, au kitengo maalumu.
bands.leadership: Huongoza timu au eneo la mazoezi ya kitaaluma.
bands.accountability: Utoaji wa huduma au kitengo maalumu, na bajeti yake ikiwa anaisimamia.

bands.title: Daraja la 8a
bands.knowledge: Ujuzi wa kitaalamu wa taaluma na usimamizi wake.
bands.autonomy: Hufasiri sera ya taasisi kwa huduma; huweka mwelekeo wa timu.
bands.scope: Eneo la huduma au taaluma katika taasisi nzima.
bands.leadership: Husimamia timu, au huongoza taaluma bila usimamizi wa moja kwa moja.
bands.accountability: Eneo la huduma, wafanyakazi wake, na bajeti yake.

bands.title: Daraja la 8b
bands.knowledge: Ujuzi wa kitaalamu katika taaluma kadhaa au huduma kubwa.
bands.autonomy: Huunda sera na mkakati wa eneo kubwa.
bands.scope: Huduma au timu kadhaa, au taaluma ya ngazi ya juu kabisa.
bands.leadership: Husimamia mameneja, au ni mamlaka kuu katika taaluma.
bands.accountability: Huduma kadhaa, wafanyakazi wake, na bajeti zake.

bands.title: Daraja la 8c
bands.knowledge: Ujuzi wa kitaalamu, pamoja na uelewa mpana wa taasisi na sekta.
bands.autonomy: Huweka mkakati wa kitengo; anawajibika kwa mkurugenzi.
bands.leadership: Huongoza kitengo kupitia ngazi kadhaa za usimamizi.
bands.accountability: Utendaji wa kitengo, nguvu kazi yake, na bajeti yake.

bands.title: Daraja la 8d
bands.knowledge: Ujuzi wa kimkakati katika vitengo mbalimbali na mfumo mpana wa afya na huduma.
bands.autonomy: Huunda mkakati wa taasisi nzima; humwakilisha mkurugenzi.
bands.leadership: Huongoza vitengo kadhaa au idara kubwa.
bands.accountability: Vitengo vikubwa, bajeti kubwa, na hatari za taasisi nzima.

bands.title: Daraja la 9
bands.knowledge: Utaalamu wa kimkakati na uongozi wa mfumo mzima.
bands.autonomy: Huweka mkakati wa taasisi pamoja na timu ya watendaji wakuu.
bands.scope: Taasisi, na washirika wake katika mfumo mzima.
bands.accountability: Matokeo, bajeti, na hatari za taasisi nzima.

factors.name: Ujuzi wa mawasiliano na kujenga mahusiano
factors.description: Ujuzi unaohitajika kuwasiliana na wafanyakazi wenzake, wagonjwa, umma na washirika, na kujenga mahusiano nao. Huzingatia ugumu, unyeti au utata wa taarifa, na vikwazo vya uelewa au ukubalifu.

levels.1: Hutoa na kupokea taarifa za kawaida kwa mdomo, hasa na wafanyakazi wenzake.
levels.2: Hutoa na kupokea taarifa za kawaida kwa mdomo, kwa maandishi au kielektroniki, na wafanyakazi wenzake na wengine.
levels.3: Hutoa taarifa za kawaida zinazohitaji busara au ushawishi, au taarifa tata au nyeti, au mafunzo rahisi kwa makundi.
levels.4: Hutoa taarifa tata, nyeti au zenye utata zinazohitaji ujuzi wa ushawishi, majadiliano au ufundishaji, au taarifa tata sana.
levels.5: Hutoa taarifa tata sana au zenye utata zinazohitaji ujuzi uliokuzwa wa ushawishi na majadiliano, hutoa mawasilisho kwa makundi makubwa, au huwasiliana palipo na vikwazo vikubwa vya ukubalifu.
levels.6: Hutoa taarifa tata sana na zenye utata mkubwa palipo na vikwazo vikubwa vya ukubalifu, kwa kutumia kiwango cha juu kabisa cha ujuzi wa mawasiliano.

factors.name: Maarifa, mafunzo na uzoefu
factors.description: Maarifa na uzoefu unaohitajika kufanya kazi, kutoka chanzo chochote, ikiwemo mafunzo rasmi, sifa za kitaaluma na uzoefu.

levels.1: Taratibu chache za kawaida, zinazojifunzwa kazini kwa kipindi kifupi cha utambulisho.
levels.2: Taratibu mbalimbali za kawaida, zinazojifunzwa kwa mafunzo kazini na utambulisho.
levels.3: Taratibu mbalimbali, baadhi zikiwa si za kawaida, zinazohitaji nadharia ya msingi (kwa mfano sifa ya kiwango cha 3 au uzoefu unaolingana).
levels.4: Taratibu mbalimbali, nyingi zikiwa si za kawaida, zinazohitaji nadharia ya kati (kwa mfano stashahada au uzoefu unaolingana).
levels.5: Utaalamu katika fani maalumu, unaoungwa mkono na nadharia au uzoefu wa vitendo (kiwango cha shahada au kinacholingana).
levels.6: Maarifa maalumu katika upana wa fani hiyo (kiwango cha stashahada ya uzamili au kinacholingana).
levels.7: Maarifa maalumu yaliyokuzwa sana katika upana wa fani hiyo (kiwango cha shahada ya uzamili au kinacholingana).
levels.8: Maarifa ya hali ya juu (shahada ya uzamivu pamoja na mafunzo ya ziada au yanayolingana), au maarifa maalumu katika fani zaidi ya moja yaliyojengwa kwa kipindi kirefu.

factors.name: Ujuzi wa uchambuzi na uamuzi
factors.description: Uchambuzi na uamuzi unaohitajika kuchakata taarifa, kutatua matatizo na kufanya maamuzi.

levels.1: Hufanya maamuzi kuhusu ukweli au hali rahisi.
levels.2: Hufanya maamuzi kuhusu ukweli au hali, nyingine zikihitaji uchambuzi.
levels.3: Hufanya maamuzi kuhusu ukweli au hali mbalimbali zinazohitaji uchambuzi au ulinganisho wa chaguzi.
levels.4: Hufanya maamuzi kuhusu ukweli au hali tata zinazohitaji uchambuzi, ufasiri na ulinganisho wa chaguzi.
levels.5: Hufanya maamuzi kuhusu ukweli au hali tata sana zinazohitaji uchambuzi, ufasiri na ulinganisho wa chaguzi.

factors.name: Ujuzi wa kupanga na kuratibu
factors.description: Upangaji na uratibu unaohitajika kuendesha shughuli, programu, huduma au mikakati.

levels.1: Hupanga kazi zake za kila siku.
levels.2: Hupanga kazi au shughuli rahisi, baadhi zikiendelea.
levels.3: Hupanga shughuli kadhaa tata, akirekebisha mipango inapohitajika.
levels.4: Hupanga shughuli au mikakati tata ya aina nyingi, akiirekebisha inapohitajika.
levels.5: Hutunga mipango ya kimkakati ya muda mrefu, yenye kutokuwa na uhakika na athari katika taasisi nzima.

factors.name: Ujuzi wa kimwili
factors.description: Ujuzi wa kimwili unaohitajika, kama vile ustadi wa mikono, uratibu wa viungo, ujuzi wa kibodi na kuendesha gari.

levels.1: Uhitaji mdogo wa ujuzi wa kimwili.
levels.2: Ujuzi unaopatikana kwa mazoezi, kama vile matumizi ya kawaida ya kibodi au kuendesha gari.
levels.3: Ujuzi uliokuzwa unaohitaji kasi au usahihi, kama vile matumizi ya hali ya juu ya kibodi.
levels.4: Ujuzi uliokuzwa sana unaohitaji usahihi au kasi na uratibu wa juu wa mikono na macho.
levels.5: Kiwango cha juu kabisa cha usahihi, kasi na uratibu.

factors.name: Wajibu wa huduma kwa wagonjwa na wateja
factors.description: Wajibu wa kutathmini, kutibu, kuhudumia au kushauri wagonjwa na wateja. Kwa nafasi nyingi za kidijitali na za kampuni, huu ni mawasiliano ya bahati tu.

levels.1: Huwasaidia wagonjwa, wateja au ndugu wakati wa mawasiliano ya bahati.
levels.2: Hutoa ushauri wa jumla usio wa kitabibu, taarifa au huduma moja kwa moja kwa wagonjwa au umma.
levels.3: Hutoa huduma binafsi, huduma za msingi za kiufundi za kitabibu, au ushauri wa msingi wa kitabibu.
levels.4: Hutekeleza huduma za kitabibu, hutoa huduma za kiufundi za kitabibu, au hushauri kuhusu huduma kwa wagonjwa.
levels.5: Hubuni programu za huduma, hutoa huduma maalumu za kiufundi za kitabibu, au hutoa ushauri maalumu kuhusu huduma kwa wagonjwa.
levels.6: Hubuni huduma maalumu, hutoa ushauri maalumu sana, au anawajibika kwa sehemu ya huduma ya kitabibu.
levels.7: Anawajibika kwa utoaji wa huduma ya kitabibu au ya matunzo.
levels.8: Wajibu wa kitaasisi kwa huduma za kitabibu au za matunzo.

factors.name: Wajibu wa sera na uendelezaji wa huduma
factors.description: Wajibu wa kuendeleza na kutekeleza sera na huduma, na ukubwa wa athari zake.

levels.1: Hufuata sera zilizowekwa na wengine; anaweza kutoa maoni kuhusu mabadiliko.
levels.2: Hutekeleza sera za eneo lake na kupendekeza mabadiliko ya mazoea yake.
levels.3: Hutekeleza sera za eneo lake na kupendekeza mabadiliko yanayoathiri maeneo mengine.
levels.4: Hutekeleza sera na kuendeleza sera au huduma kwa huduma moja au maeneo kadhaa.
levels.5: Hutekeleza na kuendeleza sera au huduma mbalimbali kwa kurugenzi.
levels.6: Wajibu wa kitaasisi kwa uendelezaji mkubwa wa sera au huduma ndani ya taasisi au zaidi ya taasisi.

factors.name: Wajibu wa rasilimali za fedha na mali
factors.description: Wajibu wa fedha, bajeti, vifaa, akiba ya bidhaa, majengo na mali nyingine.

levels.1: Hutunza binafsi vifaa na rasilimali zinazotumika katika kazi yake.
levels.2: Hushughulikia fedha taslimu au vitu vya thamani, hutunza vifaa vinavyotumiwa na wengine, hudhibiti akiba ya bidhaa, au huidhinisha malipo madogo.
levels.3: Huidhinisha malipo, hununua baadhi ya mali au vifaa, hufuatilia au husimamia bajeti iliyokabidhiwa, au hutunza mali.
levels.4: Husimamia au huweka bajeti ya idara au huduma, au hununua au hutunza mali zake.
levels.5: Husimamia au huweka bajeti, au hudhibiti mali, za huduma kadhaa.
levels.6: Wajibu wa kitaasisi kwa fedha au mali za taasisi.

factors.name: Wajibu kwa watu
factors.description: Wajibu wa kusimamia, kuongoza, kufunza au kuendeleza wafanyakazi, au wa kutoa huduma za rasilimali watu.

levels.1: Huonyesha taratibu zake za kazi kwa wenzake wapya au wenye uzoefu mdogo.
levels.2: Husimamia au huratibu wafanyakazi kila siku, hufunza wengine mara kwa mara, au hutoa ushauri wa msingi wa rasilimali watu.
levels.3: Husimamia kundi la wafanyakazi kila siku, hufundisha mafunzo ya msingi au maalumu, au hutoa ushauri wa msingi wa rasilimali watu.
levels.4: Husimamia kitengo au idara moja kwa moja, hubuni programu za mafunzo kama jukumu kuu, au hutoa huduma zote za rasilimali watu.
levels.5: Husimamia idara kadhaa moja kwa moja, au husimamia mafunzo au sehemu kubwa ya rasilimali watu katika taasisi nzima.
levels.6: Wajibu wa kitaasisi kwa watu wa taasisi au kitengo chake cha rasilimali watu.

factors.name: Wajibu wa rasilimali za taarifa
factors.description: Wajibu wa taarifa na mifumo ya taarifa, ya karatasi au ya kidijitali, ikiwemo kumbukumbu, data na mifumo inayozihifadhi.

levels.1: Hurekodi taarifa anazozalisha mwenye nafasi hiyo.
levels.2: Huingiza au huhifadhi data zilizokusanywa na wengine, au mara kwa mara huandika ripoti au hoja za data.
levels.3: Huandika muhtasari rasmi wa vikao, mara kwa mara huandika ripoti au hoja za data, au hutunza mifumo ya taarifa kama jukumu muhimu.
levels.4: Hurekebisha au hubuni mifumo ya taarifa kwa vigezo vya wengine, au huendesha mifumo ya taarifa ya idara kama jukumu kuu.
levels.5: Hubuni na kuendeleza mifumo mikubwa ya taarifa, au huendesha mifumo ya taarifa ya huduma kadhaa kama jukumu kuu.
levels.6: Husimamia na kuendeleza mifumo ya taarifa katika taasisi nzima kama jukumu kuu.
levels.7: Wajibu wa kitaasisi kwa mifumo ya taarifa ya taasisi.

factors.name: Wajibu wa utafiti na maendeleo
factors.description: Wajibu wa utafiti rasmi, maendeleo, tathmini, ukaguzi, majaribio na majaribio ya kitaalamu.

levels.1: Hufanya tafiti au ukaguzi kwa ajili ya kazi yake; mara kwa mara hushiriki katika utafiti au majaribio.
levels.2: Mara kwa mara hufanya utafiti, maendeleo, majaribio ya kitaalamu, au majaribio ya vifaa na mifumo kama sehemu ya kazi.
levels.3: Hufanya utafiti au maendeleo ndani ya programu rasmi kama jukumu kuu.
levels.4: Huratibu na kutekeleza programu za utafiti na maendeleo.
levels.5: Huanzisha na kuendeleza programu za utafiti na maendeleo zinazounga mkono malengo ya taasisi.
levels.6: Huanzisha na kuendeleza programu za utafiti na maendeleo zenye athari zaidi ya taasisi.

factors.name: Uhuru wa kutenda
factors.description: Kiwango ambacho mwenye nafasi huamua nini cha kufanya na jinsi gani, na jinsi kazi yake inavyosimamiwa kwa karibu.

levels.1: Hufanya kazi ndani ya taratibu zilizowekwa, huku usimamizi ukiwa karibu.
levels.2: Hufuata taratibu za kawaida na mifano ya awali; kwa kawaida kuna mtu wa kuuliza; kazi inaweza kukaguliwa.
levels.3: Hufuata sera na taratibu zilizobainishwa; kazi husimamiwa kwa uongozi badala ya ukaguzi wa karibu.
levels.4: Matokeo yamebainishwa, lakini mwenye nafasi huamua jinsi ya kuyafikia, ndani ya sera pana.
levels.5: Hufanya kazi ndani ya sera za jumla, na katika hali nyingi huamua jinsi ya kuzifasiri.
levels.6: Hufasiri sera na mkakati wa jumla ili kuweka malengo na viwango.

factors.name: Juhudi za kimwili
factors.description: Juhudi za kimwili zinazohitajika, kwa kuzingatia mara zinazotokea, muda na ukali.

levels.1: Kukaa, kusimama na kutembea, kwa juhudi ndogo ya kimwili.
levels.2: Kukaa au kusimama mara kwa mara katika nafasi finyu, au juhudi nyepesi hadi za wastani mara chache.
levels.3: Juhudi nyepesi mara kwa mara kwa muda mrefu, au juhudi za wastani mara kwa mara kwa muda mfupi.
levels.4: Juhudi nyepesi zinazoendelea, juhudi za wastani mara kwa mara kwa muda mrefu, au juhudi kali mara chache.
levels.5: Juhudi za wastani zinazoendelea, au juhudi kali mara kwa mara.

factors.name: Juhudi za kiakili
factors.description: Umakini unaohitajika, kwa kuzingatia mara zinazotokea, muda na jinsi kazi inavyoweza kutabirika.

levels.1: Umakini wa kawaida; umakini wa mara chache kwenye kazi inayotabirika.
levels.2: Umakini wa mara kwa mara kwenye kazi inayotabirika, au umakini wa mara chache kwenye kazi isiyotabirika.
levels.3: Umakini wa mara kwa mara kwenye kazi isiyotabirika, au umakini wa muda mrefu mara chache.
levels.4: Umakini wa muda mrefu mara kwa mara, au umakini mkali mara chache.

factors.name: Juhudi za kihisia
factors.description: Mahitaji ya kihisia ya kazi, kutokana na kukumbana moja kwa moja au kwa njia isiyo ya moja kwa moja na hali zenye kusikitisha, kama vile kusoma kumbukumbu za kesi zenye kuhuzunisha au kushughulikia matukio makubwa.

levels.1: Kukumbana mara chache, au kukumbana kwa njia isiyo ya moja kwa moja mara chache, na hali zenye kusikitisha.
levels.2: Kukumbana mara chache, au kukumbana kwa njia isiyo ya moja kwa moja mara kwa mara, na hali zenye kusikitisha.
levels.3: Kukumbana mara kwa mara na hali zenye kusikitisha, au kukumbana mara chache na hali zenye kusikitisha sana.
levels.4: Kukumbana mara chache na hali za kiwewe, au kukumbana mara kwa mara na hali zenye kusikitisha sana.

factors.name: Mazingira ya kazi
factors.description: Kukumbana na mazingira yasiyopendeza au hatari. Matumizi ya skrini karibu bila kikomo siku nyingi huhesabiwa kuwa kiwango cha 2.

levels.1: Kukumbana mara chache na mazingira yasiyopendeza.
levels.2: Mazingira yasiyopendeza mara chache, safari za mara kwa mara au kazi za nje, au matumizi ya skrini karibu bila kikomo siku nyingi.
levels.3: Mazingira yasiyopendeza mara kwa mara, au mazingira yasiyopendeza sana mara chache.
levels.4: Kukumbana kiasi na hatari, au mazingira yasiyopendeza sana mara kwa mara.

skills.name: Accessibility
skills.description: Accessibility involves ensuring your service can be used by as many people as possible, including those with impaired vision, motor difficulties, cognitive impairments, learning disabilities and deafness.

levels.awareness:
You can:
- understand accessibility and that users have different accessibility needs
- help fix accessibility issues under the direction of others
levels.working:
You can:
- understand users have different accessibility needs
- build user interfaces that meet accessibility standards and fix accessibility issues under the direction of others
levels.practitioner:
You can:
- build user interfaces that meet a predefined set of standards
- champion accessibility to internal stakeholders
- offer design feedback to mitigate the risk of failing accessibility testing
- offer recommendations on the best tools and methods to use when accessibility testing
levels.expert:
You can:
- show a strong understanding of accessibility and be an advocate for users with accessibility needs
- build user interfaces that meet a predefined set of standards
- champion accessibility to internal and external stakeholders
- offer design solutions to mitigate the risk of failing accessibility testing
- recommend the best tools and methods to use when accessibility testing

esco.label: test system accessibility for users with special needs

skills.name: Adapting to delivery methodologies
skills.description: Adapting to delivery methodologies involves contributing to discussions on the appropriate delivery methodology to use, and adapting your approach based on the delivery methodology of the team.

levels.awareness:
You can:
- explain the differences between delivery methodologies, such as scrum or kanban
- explain how your approach would change based on the delivery methodology
- explain why iteration is important
- explain how roles in a multidisciplinary team work together to support delivery
levels.working:
You can:
- explain how products and services are delivered through different methodologies
- follow an appropriate approach to complete your work within the delivery methodology used by your team
- adapt how you work and the work you produce based on your team's delivery methodology to ensure you deliver value
- adapt how you work with other roles in a multidisciplinary team in line with the delivery methodology
levels.practitioner:
You can:
- determine the approach for your role within the team's delivery methodology
- define and agree the scope of delivery for your role within a multidisciplinary team
- negotiate and agree delivery priorities with the team and relevant stakeholders
- clearly communicate the value of iterative delivery and realising benefits early
levels.expert:
You can:
- set and iterate standards for working within different delivery methodologies
- actively promote collaboration and agreement to ensure the team delivers value at the right time
- experiment with new and innovative ways of working to enhance delivery outcomes
- research new and evolving delivery methodologies and identify how your role would work within them

skills.name: Agile and Lean practices
skills.description: Agile and Lean practices involves encouraging teams to build incrementally, test and iterate their work based on regular feedback and other useful data.

levels.awareness:
You can:
- explain the basic principles of Agile and Lean methodology
- discuss ways to apply Agile and Lean principles in a multi-disciplinary team

levels.working:
Unaweza:
- kutengeneza nyaraka na mawasilisho yaliyopangwa vizuri kwa haraka na kwa usahihi
- kutumia majedwali kupanga, kuchuja na kufupisha data
- kutumia zana za ushirikiano kusimamia nyaraka zinazoshirikiwa na matoleo yake
levels.practitioner:
Unaweza:
- kujenga violezo, zana za ufuatiliaji na mtiririko rahisi wa kazi unaojiendesha
- kufanya nyaraka zifikike kwa kila mtu
- kuwasaidia wenzako kunufaika zaidi na zana za ofisi
levels.expert:
Unaweza:
- kuweka viwango vya violezo, usimamizi wa nyaraka na zana za ushirikiano
- kuongoza kupitishwa kwa zana mpya za ofisi katika taasisi nzima

skills.name: Kushughulikia kesi za mahusiano ya wafanyakazi
skills.description: Kusimamia kesi rasmi na zisizo rasmi za mahusiano ya wafanyakazi, kama vile mwenendo, uwezo, malalamiko, mahudhurio na heshima kazini, kwa haki na kwa mujibu wa sera na sheria ya ajira.

levels.awareness:
Unaweza:
- kueleza hatua kuu za taratibu za mwenendo, uwezo, malalamiko na mahudhurio
- kuchukua maelezo sahihi katika mikutano rasmi na kutunza kumbukumbu za kesi kwa siri
levels.working:
Unaweza:
- kuwashauri mameneja kuhusu kesi rahisi na hatua inayofuata katika utaratibu
- kusaidia uchunguzi, kuandaa nyaraka za kesi na kupanga vikao vya kusikiliza
- kufanya kazi kwa njia ya kujenga na wawakilishi wa wafanyakazi kwenye kesi za mtu binafsi
levels.practitioner:
Unaweza:
- kusimamia wingi wa kesi tata, ukishauri paneli za kusikiliza kuhusu matokeo ya haki
- kufanya au kuongoza uchunguzi, ikiwemo ule unaohusiana na matukio au ulinzi wa watu
- kutumia utatuzi wa mapema na usuluhishi kumaliza mizozo kabla haijakua
- kutambua mwelekeo katika kesi na kushughulikia visababishi vyake
levels.expert:
Unaweza:
- kuongoza mtazamo wa taasisi kuhusu mahusiano ya wafanyakazi na kufanya kazi kwa ushirikiano
- kushughulikia kesi nyeti zaidi au zenye hatari kubwa, ikiwemo madai ya ajira
- kujadili makubaliano ya pamoja na kutatua mizozo ya pamoja

skills.name: Sheria ya ajira
skills.description: Kutumia sheria ya ajira kwa sera za watu, mikataba, programu za mabadiliko na migogoro ya ajira ya taasisi.

levels.awareness:
Unaweza:
- kueleza haki kuu za ajira za wafanyakazi
- kutambua masuala ya ajira yanayohitaji ushauri wa kisheria
levels.working:
Unaweza:
- kusaidia kuandaa nyaraka za madai ya ajira na vikao vya kusikiliza
- kukagua mikataba ya ajira na sera dhidi ya violezo
levels.practitioner:
Unaweza:
- kushauri kuhusu mambo ya ajira, kama vile kufukuzwa kazi, ubaguzi, uhamishaji wa wafanyakazi na upangaji upya wa miundo
- kusimamia madai ya ajira na kujadili makubaliano ya suluhu
- kushauri kuhusu matumizi ya wakandarasi na hadhi ya ajira ya wataalamu wa kidijitali
levels.expert:
Unaweza:
- kuishauri bodi kuhusu mabadiliko makubwa ya nguvu kazi na hatari zake za kisheria
- kuongoza migogoro ya ajira yenye sifa kubwa au tata
- kuunda sera za watu ili zitimize wajibu wa kisheria na mazoezi mazuri

skills.name: Sheria ya ajira na sera za watu
skills.description: Kutumia sheria ya ajira na kuandika, kufasiri na kukagua sera za watu za taasisi ili wafanyakazi watendewe kihalali, kwa haki na kwa uthabiti.

levels.awareness:
Unaweza:
- kueleza sera kuu za watu na mahali pa kuzipata
- kutambua ni lini swali linahitaji ushauri wa mshauri wa rasilimali watu
levels.working:
Unaweza:
- kutumia sera za watu kwenye kesi za kawaida na kuzieleza kwa mameneja
- kubainisha kanuni za sheria ya ajira zilizo nyuma ya sera
- kutunza kumbukumbu za sera na kufuatilia tarehe za ukaguzi wa sera
levels.practitioner:
Unaweza:
- kufasiri sheria ya ajira na sera kwa kesi tata na kushauri kuhusu hatari
- kuandaa rasimu na kukagua sera za watu, pamoja na tathmini za athari za usawa
- kushauriana kuhusu mabadiliko ya sera na wawakilishi wa wafanyakazi
levels.expert:
Unaweza:
- kuweka mfumo wa sera za watu wa taasisi na mtazamo wake kuhusu hatari za kisheria
- kutarajia mabadiliko ya sheria ya ajira na kupanga majibu ya taasisi
- kuishauri bodi kuhusu hatari za ajira na dhima

levels.awareness: This skill level is currently not defined.
levels.working:
You can:
- work with risk owners to advise and give feedback
- advise on risk impact and whether it's within risk tolerance

levels.practitioner:

- apply different risk methodologies in proportion to the risk
levels.expert:

- be trusted by senior risk owners as an expert in security

skills.name: Enterprise architecture
skills.description: Enterprise architecture involves analysing how to achieve an organisation's objectives by designing and aligning its IT applications and technologies.

levels.awareness:
You can:
- explain how to turn an organisation's goals into clear objectives
- explain how an architecture that defines technology, people, process and other elements can be used to achieve the organisation’s objectives
levels.working:
You can:
- turn an organisation's goals into clear objectives, with limited direction
- design an architecture that defines the technology, people, process and other elements needed to achieve organisation objectives, with support
levels.practitioner:
You can:
- design an architecture that defines the technology, people, process and other elements needed to achieve organisation objectives
- work with others across the organisation to ensure your design is used to achieve the organisation’s objectives
levels.expert:
You can:
- lead others designing architectures defining the technology, people, process and other elements needed to achieve organisation objectives
- work with others beyond the organisation to influence organisational structures, technology, people and processes to achieve objectives
- ensure organisation-wide changes align with the architectural strategy

skills.name: Usawa, utofauti na ujumuishi
skills.description: Kuwatendea watu kwa haki, kuthamini tofauti, na kubuni huduma na maeneo ya kazi yanayomjumuisha kila mtu.

levels.awareness:
Unaweza:
- kuwatendea wenzako, wagonjwa na umma kwa heshima na utu
- kufuata sera za usawa na ujumuishi
levels.working:
Unaweza:
- kutambua na kupinga tabia inayowatenga wengine
- kuzingatia mahitaji tofauti unapopanga kazi yako
levels.practitioner:
Unaweza:
- kufanya tathmini za athari za usawa
- kujenga timu na mazoezi jumuishi
levels.expert:
Unaweza:
- kuweka mkakati wa ujumuishi na kuiwajibisha taasisi kuuhusu
- kuongoza mabadiliko ya utamaduni kuhusu usawa, utofauti na ujumuishi

skills.name: Utafiti wa kimaadili na wagonjwa na wafanyakazi wa matunzo
skills.description: Kupanga na kuendesha utafiti na wagonjwa, walezi, madaktari na wafanyakazi wa matunzo kwa usalama na kimaadili, ikiwemo ridhaa yenye ufahamu, ulinzi wa watu, utafiti na watu walio katika mazingira hatarishi, na kujua ni lini idhini rasmi ya kimaadili inahitajika.

levels.awareness:
Unaweza:
- kueleza kwa nini utafiti na wagonjwa na wafanyakazi wa matunzo unahitaji ridhaa yenye ufahamu, ulinzi wa watu na uangalifu na data binafsi
- kufuata taratibu za timu za ridhaa, ulinzi wa watu na ushughulikiaji wa data katika vikao vya utafiti
levels.working:
Unaweza:
- kupanga vikao vya utafiti vinavyopata ridhaa yenye ufahamu na kulinda ustawi na faragha ya washiriki
- kurekebisha vikao kwa watu wanaougua, wenye huzuni au walio katika mazingira hatarishi, na kujua ni lini kusimama
- kutambua na kuripoti masuala ya ulinzi wa watu yanayojitokeza katika utafiti
levels.practitioner:
Unaweza:
- kuhukumu ni lini utafiti unahitaji idhini rasmi ya kimaadili au ya usimamizi wa utafiti na kuandaa kinachohitajika
- kupanga utafiti salama na watu walio katika mazingira hatarishi, kama vile watoto, watu wenye shida ya akili na watu walio katika dharura
- kupanga utafiti katika mazingira ya kitabibu bila kuvuruga matunzo, kwa kushirikiana na viongozi wa kitabibu na wafanyakazi wa matunzo
- kuwasaidia watafiti kutunza ustawi wao baada ya vikao vyenye kuhuzunisha
levels.expert:
Unaweza:
- kuweka viwango vya taasisi vya utafiti wa kimaadili na wagonjwa, walezi na wafanyakazi wa matunzo
- kuhakikisha mazoezi ya utafiti katika timu zote na kushauri kuhusu utafiti wenye hatari kubwa
- kuwakilisha mazoezi ya utafiti kwa vyombo vya maadili, ulinzi wa watu na usimamizi

esco.label: apply research ethics and scientific integrity principles in research activities

skills.name: Evidence-based design
skills.description: Evidence-based design involves defining hypotheses and using qualitative evidence (such as insights from user research) and quantitative evidence (such as web analytics and management information) to inform design decisions.

levels.awareness:
You can:
- explain how quantitative and qualitative evidence inform user-centred design
- frame your ideas as design hypotheses to be tested
- identify common sources and types of data that inform user-centred design, such as web analytics and user interviews
levels.working:
You can:
- work with researchers and analysts to draw together, analyse and clearly explain commonly available evidence relevant to users or a service, for example, web analytics data
- use evidence to inform, develop and test a design idea, with support
levels.practitioner:
You can:
- independently find, analyse and synthesise evidence from trusted sources
- work collaboratively with researchers, analysts and other specialists to design appropriate research and analyse the results
- help your team use design hypotheses effectively
- use complex research and data to develop and test design ideas
levels.expert:
You can:
- embed a practice of hypothesis-driven design in a team
- guide the organisation in how to use evidence to improve content or services
- analyse, synthesise and use evidence to improve the way the organisation works
- ensure user insights are shared with and used by the wider organisation and across government

skills.name: Mipango ya kutoka na kurudisha data
skills.description: Kupanga na kusimamia mwisho wa mkataba, ikiwemo mpito kwa msambazaji mpya, kurudisha na kufuta data, na mwendelezo wa huduma kwa wagonjwa na wafanyakazi.

levels.awareness:
Unaweza:
- kueleza kwa nini kila mkataba unahitaji mpango wa kutoka
- kupata masharti ya kutoka na kurudisha data ya mkataba
levels.working:
Unaweza:
- kuweka mipango ya kutoka na madaftari ya mali na data yakiwa ya kisasa
- kufuatilia vipindi vya taarifa na hatua muhimu za kutoka
levels.practitioner:
Unaweza:
- kuandika mipango ya kutoka na mpito pamoja na viongozi wa kiufundi, data na kitabibu
- kuhakikisha data inarudishwa katika miundo inayotumika na ya kawaida kisha kufutwa kwa usalama
- kusimamia hatari za mpito ili matunzo yasivurugike
levels.expert:
Unaweza:
- kuweka viwango vya taasisi vya kutoka, mpito na kurudisha data
- kuongoza kutoka katika mikataba ya kimkakati ya kitabibu na ya teknolojia

esco.label: maintain plan for continuity of operations

skills.name: Mifumo ya fedha
skills.description: Kutumia, kusimamia na kuboresha mifumo ya fedha, ununuzi, mishahara na kuripoti ili data ya fedha iwe sahihi na michakato iwe na ufanisi.

levels.awareness:
Unaweza:
- kutumia mfumo wa fedha kwa kazi zako mwenyewe, ukifuata taratibu
- kuendesha ripoti za kawaida na kusafirisha data kwenda kwenye jedwali
levels.working:
Unaweza:
- kutumia majedwali vizuri, ikiwemo fomula, utafutaji na majedwali ya mzunguko
- kutunza data za mfumo wa fedha, kama vile vituo vya gharama, wasambazaji na waidhinishaji
- kuripoti na kusaidia kurekebisha matatizo ya mfumo
levels.practitioner:
Unaweza:
- kusimamia mfumo wa fedha au wa mishahara, ikiwemo ufikiaji, mtiririko wa kazi na kuripoti
- kubuni ripoti na dashibodi kwa wamiliki wa bajeti
- kujaribu mabadiliko na masasisho ya mfumo
- kuendesha kiotomatiki kazi za fedha zinazojirudia
levels.expert:
Unaweza:
- kumiliki mkakati na ramani ya mifumo ya fedha
- kuongoza ununuzi na utekelezaji wa mifumo ya fedha au ya mishahara
- kuhakikisha data ya fedha imeunganishwa na data ya nguvu kazi, ununuzi na utendaji

skills.name: Udhibiti wa fedha na ukaguzi
skills.description: Kubuni, kuendesha na kujaribu udhibiti wa fedha, kuzuia na kugundua udanganyifu, na kufanya kazi na wakaguzi wa ndani na wa nje.

levels.awareness:
Unaweza:
- kufuata taratibu za fedha za taasisi na miongozo ya ukasimishaji wa madaraka
- kutambua dalili za udanganyifu au kosa linalowezekana na kuviripoti
levels.working:
Unaweza:
- kuendesha udhibiti muhimu, kama vile utenganishaji wa majukumu na ukaguzi wa taarifa za benki za wasambazaji
- kutoa ushahidi kwa wakaguzi na kujibu maswali yao
- kukagua kama matumizi yameidhinishwa katika ngazi sahihi
levels.practitioner:
Unaweza:
- kujaribu na kuboresha udhibiti wa mchakato wa fedha
- kusimamia maombi ya ukaguzi kwa eneo na kukubaliana hatua kuhusu matokeo
- kuandika na kusasisha taratibu za fedha
- kufanya kazi na wataalamu wa kupambana na udanganyifu kupunguza hatari ya udanganyifu
levels.expert:
Unaweza:
- kumiliki kanuni za fedha na mpango wa ukasimishaji wa madaraka wa taasisi
- kuripoti kwa kamati ya ukaguzi kuhusu udhibiti wa fedha na hatua za ukaguzi
- kuongoza majibu kwa hitilafu kubwa za udhibiti au udanganyifu
- kujenga utamaduni ambapo wafanyakazi wanaelewa wajibu wao wa kutumia fedha za umma ipasavyo

skills.name: Financial management
skills.description: Financial management involves planning, organising and monitoring financial resources.

levels.awareness:
You can:
- understand the financial impact of the work you do and how cost and budgets are created
levels.working:
You can:
- balance cost versus value
- consider the impact of user needs
- report on financial delivery
- monitor cost and budget
- understand how and when to escalate issues
levels.practitioner:
You can:
- negotiate, influence or set budgets in complex environments
- write or input into business cases and can communicate business-value propositions
levels.expert:
You can:
- influence or create complex budgets across an organisation, programme or product view
- manage the budget you are given and make it work

skills.name: Financial ownership
skills.description: Financial ownership involves securing funding and prioritising how it is spent to ensure quality and value for money.

levels.awareness:
You can:
- explain what is important when deciding how to allocate money
- explain what is important to include in a business case, and why it is important
- explain the value of supplier relationships in relation to financial ownership
levels.working:
You can:
- contribute to a business case that provides sustainable funding
- communicate how you make a decision, balancing quality outcomes and value for money
- support conversations on how money is allocated
- support relationships with suppliers
- identify financial and commercial risk, with support
levels.practitioner:
You can:
- develop a business case that provides sustainable funding
- recommend how money is allocated across competing priorities
- support the management of contracts
- develop and grow relationships with suppliers to increase quality and good value outcomes
- identify financial and commercial risk and escalate it when required
levels.expert:
You can:
- ensure a business case is in place that provides sustainable funding
- identify measurable benefits that represent good value for money
- allocate money and make spending decisions across competing priorities
- enhance and own relationships with suppliers to increase quality and deliver good value outcomes
- act as an escalation point and work with stakeholders to manage financial and commercial risk

skills.name: Mipango ya fedha na utabiri
skills.description: Kujenga bajeti, utabiri na mipango ya fedha ya muda wa kati inayounganisha fedha na vipaumbele na programu za taasisi.

levels.awareness:
Unaweza:
- kueleza mzunguko wa kila mwaka wa kuweka bajeti na tofauti kati ya bajeti na utabiri
- kukusanya taarifa za utabiri kutoka kwa wamiliki wa bajeti
levels.working:
Unaweza:
- kujenga bajeti na utabiri kwa kituo cha gharama au mradi, ikiwemo gharama za wafanyakazi
- kusasisha utabiri kila mwezi kwa mabadiliko na hatari zinazojulikana
- kugawa bajeti kwa vipindi ili wasifu wa matumizi ulingane na mipango ya utoaji
levels.practitioner:
Unaweza:
- kuongoza uwekaji bajeti na utabiri kwa kurugenzi au programu kubwa
- kuunda miundo ya matukio na unyeti, kama vile mfumuko wa bei, ucheleweshaji au mabadiliko ya ufadhili
- kujenga utabiri wa miaka mingi kwa programu za kidijitali, ikiwemo gharama za uendeshaji zinazofuata uwekezaji
- kuwasilisha utabiri na hatari kwa mameneja wakuu
levels.expert:
Unaweza:
- kuongoza mpango wa fedha wa muda wa kati wa taasisi
- kuoanisha mipango ya fedha na mkakati, nguvu kazi na mipango ya uwekezaji
- kuishauri bodi kuhusu uendelevu wa kifedha na chaguzi zinazohitajika ili kubaki ndani ya ufadhili
- kuweka dhana na mbinu za mipango zinazotumika katika taasisi nzima

skills.name: Kuripoti fedha na hesabu za kisheria
skills.description: Kuandaa taarifa sahihi za fedha na ritani za kisheria zinazofuata viwango vya uhasibu vinavyotumika na kanuni za kuripoti za sekta ya umma.

levels.awareness:
Unaweza:
- kueleza kusudi la taarifa kuu za fedha
- kuandaa karatasi za kazi na ulinganisho unaounga mkono kufunga mwezi na mwaka
levels.working:
Unaweza:
- kuandaa maingizo ya mwisho wa mwezi na mwisho wa mwaka, kama vile gharama zilizokusanywa, malipo ya awali na makadirio ya akiba
- kuandaa sehemu za hesabu za mwaka na maelezo yanayoziunga mkono
- kutumia viwango vya uhasibu kwenye miamala ya kawaida, kama vile kuweka programu na vifaa kama mali
levels.practitioner:
Unaweza:
- kuandaa hesabu za mwaka na ritani za kisheria kwa kufuata ratiba
- kutumia viwango vya uhasibu kwenye maeneo tata, kama vile ukodishaji, mipango ya kompyuta ya wingu na mali zisizoshikika
- kuandika karatasi za uhasibu zinazoeleza hukumu na makadirio
- kusimamia ukaguzi wa nje wa hesabu na kujibu matokeo
levels.expert:
Unaweza:
- kumiliki ripoti na hesabu za mwaka za taasisi na sera za uhasibu zilizo nyuma yake
- kuishauri bodi na kamati ya ukaguzi kuhusu hukumu muhimu na viwango vipya
- kuongoza majibu kwa maoni ya ukaguzi yenye masharti au makosa makubwa ya kuripoti
- kuhakikisha kuripoti kunatimiza kanuni za uwajibikaji wa umma

skills.name: Miamala ya fedha na leja
skills.description: Kuchakata na kurekodi ankara, malipo, risiti, majarida ya hesabu na ulinganisho wa hesabu kwa usahihi katika leja, kwa kufuata udhibiti wa fedha.

levels.awareness:
Unaweza:
- kueleza michakato ya kununua-hadi-kulipa na kuagiza-hadi-kupokea fedha na sehemu yako ndani yake
- kuingiza ankara, risiti na malipo kwa usahihi, ukifuata taratibu zilizowekwa
- kukagua kama muamala una idhini sahihi na nyaraka za kuunga mkono
levels.working:
Unaweza:
- kuchakata miamala mbalimbali, ikiwemo hati za mkopo, marejesho na majarida ya hesabu
- kulinganisha taarifa za wasambazaji, akaunti za benki na akaunti za udhibiti
- kutatua maswali ya kawaida kutoka kwa wasambazaji, wateja na wamiliki wa bajeti
- kutambua miamala iliyorudiwa, isiyo ya kawaida au isiyoidhinishwa na kuyaibua
levels.practitioner:
Unaweza:
- kusimamia leja au mchakato wa miamala na kuuweka sahihi na wa kisasa
- kuchunguza na kusafisha vipengee tata vya ulinganisho na salio la zamani
- kuboresha michakato ya miamala, kwa mfano kwa kuendesha kiotomatiki ulinganishaji au idhini
- kuwafunza wafanyakazi wengine na kukagua kazi zao
levels.expert:
Unaweza:
- kubuni michakato ya miamala ya taasisi na udhibiti ndani yake
- kuweka viwango vya utendaji, kama vile muda wa malipo na malengo ya kukusanya madeni

skills.name: Usanifu na utoaji wa mafunzo

levels.working:
Unaweza:

skills.name: Utawala wa kisheria
skills.description: Kuendesha michakato ya kiutawala ya timu ya kisheria, ikiwemo usimamizi wa mambo, udhibiti wa nyaraka, kumbukumbu, tarehe za mwisho na utoaji wa ankara.

levels.awareness:
Unaweza:

levels.working:

levels.practitioner:

- kuendesha utawala wa timu ya kisheria na kuboresha michakato yake

- kusimamia teknolojia ya kisheria, kama vile usimamizi wa mambo na zana za sahihi za kielektroniki
levels.expert:
Unaweza:
- kubuni mfumo wa uendeshaji wa kisheria kwa taasisi
- kuongoza uchaguzi na matumizi ya teknolojia ya kisheria
- kuweka viwango vya huduma na vipimo vya utendaji kwa huduma za kisheria

skills.name: Ushauri wa kisheria
skills.description: Kutoa ushauri wa kisheria ulio wazi, wa vitendo na sahihi unaowasaidia wenzako kufanya maamuzi halali na kusimamia hatari za kisheria.

levels.awareness:
Unaweza:

levels.working:

levels.practitioner:

- kushauri kuhusu maamuzi yenye athari za kisheria, kama vile utoaji wa mikataba, ushirikishaji wa data na mabadiliko ya huduma
- kuamua ni lini kuwaagiza mawakili au wanasheria wa nje
levels.expert:

- kuishauri bodi na watendaji wakuu kuhusu hatari kubwa zaidi za kisheria za taasisi

They might prepare reports in the form of visualisations such as graphs, charts, and dashboards.

occupations.label: human resources assistant
occupations.description: Human resources assistants provide support in all the processes and efforts carried by human resources managers. They help in the preparation of recruitment processes by scanning CVs and narrowing the selection to the most suitable candidates. They perform administrative tasks, prepare communications and letters, and perform the tabulation of the surveys and assessments carried out by the department.

optional.label: ensure gender equality in the workplace
support employability of people with disabilities

occupations.label: ICT network architect
occupations.description: ICT network architects design the topology and connectivity of ICT network such as hardware, infrastructure, communication and hardware components.

occupations.label: ICT system architect
occupations.description: ICT system architects design architecture, components, modules, interfaces, and data for a multi-components system to meet specified requirements.

occupations.label: accountant
occupations.description: Accountants review and analyse financial statements, budgets, financial reports, and business plans in order to check for irregularities resulting from error or fraud, and provide their clients with financial advice in matters such as financial forecasting and risk analysis. They may audit financial data, resolve insolvency cases, prepare tax returns and provide other tax-related advice in reference to current legislation.

essential.label: analyse financial performance of a company
attach accounting certificates to accounting transactions

occupations.label: document management officer
occupations.isco08Label: Professional services managers not elsewhere classified
occupations.description: Document management officers ensure that the documents required for their organisation's functioning and daily operations are registered, classified and archived correctly and are made available to the different services or to the public upon request. They oversee the implementation of internal procedures and promote proper document management practices within the organisation, providing training to other employees on document management procedures. They may operate electronic records management systems (ERMS), electronic document management systems (EDMS) and archives management systems (AMS) and provide support in defining related technical requirements.

essential.label: monitor developments in field of expertise

optional.label: propose ICT solutions to business problems

occupations.label: clinical informatics manager
occupations.description: Clinical informatics managers oversee the daily operations of information systems used in a medical institutions. They also carry out research, using their understanding of clinical practices to find ways to improve healthcare services.

essential.label: comply with quality standards related to healthcare practice
contribute to continuity of health care
use foreign languages for health-related research

optional.label: communicate in foreign languages with health service providers
comply with legislation related to health care
conditions for professional practice of clinical psychology
data extraction, transformation and loading tools
inform policy makers on health-related challenges
participate in medical records' auditing activities

occupations.label: ICT operations manager
occupations.isco08Label: Information and communications technology service managers
occupations.description: ICT operations managers coordinate ICT services and infrastructure ensuring that the organisation has the required infrastructural resources. They also plan and monitor stages of either a business process or a computer process, negotiate contracts and take mitigation action in case of non-fulfilment of agreements. They oversee the day-to-day tasks involving infrastructure components, ICT systems and software.

occupations.label: software developer
occupations.description: Software developers implement or program all kinds of software systems based on specifications and designs by using programming languages, tools, and platforms.

optional.label: adapt to changes in technological development plans

occupations.label: human resources manager
occupations.description: Human resources managers plan, design and implement processes related to the human capital of companies. They develop programs for recruiting, interviewing, and selecting employees based on a previous assessment of the profile and skills required in the company. Moreover, they manage compensation and development programs for the company's employees comprising trainings, skill assessment and yearly evaluations, promotion, expat programs, and general assurance of the well-being of the employees in the workplace.

essential.label: ensure gender equality in the workplace
plan medium to long term objectives
promote gender equality in business contexts
support employability of people with disabilities

optional.label: create a work atmosphere of continuous improvement
manage stress in the work place
provide advice on breaches of regulation

occupations.label: user experience analyst
occupations.description: User experience analysts assess client interaction and experience and analyse users' behaviours, attitudes, and emotions about the usage of a particular product, system or service. They make proposals for the improvement of the interface and usability of products, systems or services. In doing so, they take into consideration the practical, experiential, affective, meaningful and valuable aspects of human–computer interaction and product ownership, as well as the person's perceptions of system aspects such as utility, ease of use and efficiency, and user experience dynamics.

essential.label: assess users' interaction with ICT applications
create prototype of user experience solutions

optional.label: test system accessibility for users with special needs

occupations.label: corporate lawyer
occupations.description: Corporate lawyers provide legal consulting services and representation to corporations and organisations. They give advice on matters relating to taxes, legal rights and patents, international trade, trademarks, and legal financial issues arising from operating a business.

optional.label: advise on participation in financial markets

occupations.label: ICT business analyst
occupations.description: ICT business analysts are in charge of analysing and designing an organisation's processes and systems, assessing the business model and its integration with technology. They also identify change needs, assess the impact of the change, capture and document requirements and then ensure that these requirements are delivered whilst supporting the business through the implementation process.

essential.label: analyse the context of an organisation
interact with users to gather requirements
propose ICT solutions to business problems

roles.title: Msanidi programu
roles.summary: Wasanidi wa programu hujenga, hujaribu na kutunza programu iliyo nyuma ya huduma za afya za kidijitali za taasisi, kama vile programu tumizi zinazowalenga wagonjwa, mifumo ya kitabibu, huduma za uunganishaji na majukwaa ya data. Hufanya kazi katika timu za bidhaa za fani mbalimbali, huandika msimbo salama, wa kuhifadhiwa, unaofikika na unaotunzika, na kusaidia huduma zao katika uendeshaji wa moja kwa moja.
healthContext: Programu inaweza kuathiri matunzo ya wagonjwa, hivyo wasanidi hufuata mchakato wa usimamizi wa hatari za kitabibu na kuchangia ushahidi kwa hoja za usalama.
Msimbo mara nyingi hushughulikia taarifa za siri za afya, hivyo wasanidi hutumia usimamizi wa taarifa na mazoezi ya uandishi salama wa msimbo kama kawaida.
Huduma nyingi hubadilishana data na mifumo mingine ya afya na matunzo, kwa kutumia viwango huria vya ushirikiano wa mifumo kama HL7 FHIR.
Baadhi ya programu zinaweza kudhibitiwa kama kifaa tiba, hivyo wasanidi wanahitaji kujua ni lini kuomba ushauri wa udhibiti.

pcfRole.name: Software developer
pcfRole.description:
A software developer designs, runs and improves software that meets user needs.

In this role, you will:
- be responsible for writing clean, secure code following a test-driven approach
- create code that is open by default and easy for others to reuse

levels.title: Mwanagenzi msanidi wa programu
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
An apprentice developer attends certified training and develops skills on the job.

At this role level, you will:
- spend a substantial portion of time shadowing others
- work with other developers to write code and tests
- build your knowledge
- follow a test-driven approach
- write code that is automatically tested
responsibilities: Kujifunza lugha, zana na njia za kufanya kazi za timu kupitia mafunzo yaliyopangwa na kufanya kazi kwa jozi.
Kuandika na kujaribu vipande vidogo vilivyobainishwa vizuri vya msimbo chini ya usimamizi wa karibu.
Kufuata taratibu za uandishi salama wa msimbo, usimamizi wa taarifa na usalama wa kitabibu.
Kushiriki katika taratibu za timu kama vile mikutano ya kusimama, mipango na tafakari.
Kujitahidi kupata uanagenzi au sifa inayolingana.
qualifications: Amesajiliwa katika, au anaelekea kukamilisha, uanagenzi wa uundaji wa programu au unaolingana nao.
levels.jobEvaluationNotes: Maarifa yamepewa alama ya kiwango ambacho kazi inahitaji mara mafunzo yanapokuwa yamekamilika vya kutosha kufanya kazi; rasilimali za taarifa zinaakisi kazi kwenye mifumo iliyobuniwa na wengine.

levels.title: Msanidi mdogo wa programu
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A junior developer learns on the job by delivering software components.

At this role level, you will:
- develop skills while working under supervision to deliver stories in a multidisciplinary team
- understand and be proficient in different types of testing
- be aware of but not responsible for security
- coach and mentor more junior colleagues
responsibilities: Kujenga na kujaribu vipengele vya bidhaa za timu, akifanya kazi kutoka hadithi za watumiaji kwa mwongozo.
Kuandika majaribio ya kiotomatiki na kurekebisha kasoro, ikiwemo katika huduma zinazounga mkono matunzo ya wagonjwa.
Kuchangia ushahidi kwa hoja za usalama wa kitabibu, kama vile matokeo ya majaribio na kumbukumbu za mabadiliko.
Kushughulikia data za afya kwa usalama, akifuata kanuni za usimamizi wa taarifa.
Kusaidia huduma za moja kwa moja, kwa mwongozo, kama sehemu ya mipango ya msaada ya timu.
qualifications: Shahada katika kompyuta au somo linalohusiana, uanagenzi uliokamilika, au uzoefu unaolingana.

levels.title: Msanidi wa programu
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A developer delivers software components that form part of a product.

At this role level, you will:
- develop software to meet user needs
- follow best practice guidelines and help to improve those guidelines
- write clean, secure and well-tested code
- coach and mentor more junior colleagues
- operate the services you build and identify issues in production
responsibilities: Kubuni, kujenga na kujaribu vipengele na huduma kwa kujitegemea, akichagua njia zinazofaa.
Kukagua msimbo na kusaidia kutunza viwango vya uhandisi vya timu.
Kujenga miunganisho na mifumo mingine ya afya na matunzo kwa kutumia viwango huria kama HL7 FHIR.
Kushiriki katika utambuzi wa hatari na kusaidia kuweka udhibiti wa usalama wa kitabibu ndani ya msimbo na majaribio.
Kuchunguza na kurekebisha matatizo katika huduma za moja kwa moja, ikiwemo msaada nje ya saa za kazi pale huduma inapohitaji.
Kuwa mshauri wa wasanidi wadogo na wanagenzi.
qualifications: Shahada katika kompyuta au somo linalohusiana, au uzoefu unaolingana.
Uzoefu wa kujenga na kusaidia programu za uzalishaji.

levels.title: Msanidi mwandamizi wa programu
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A senior developer delivers and integrates software to form a complete service.

At this role level, you will:
- plan and lead development on sets of related stories
- have an understanding of the whole system and take responsibility for teaching this to others
- work with other disciplines to understand what needs to be built
- coach and mentor more junior colleagues
- operate the production services you build
- find ways to improve system robustness, resilience and stability
There are 2 different roles at this level - a technical role and a management role.
responsibilities: Kuongoza usanifu wa kiufundi na utoaji wa vipengele na huduma muhimu.
Kuweka na kutunza viwango vya uhandisi vya timu, ikiwemo majaribio, usalama na ufikivu.
Kufanya maamuzi ya kiufundi yanayosawazisha mahitaji ya watumiaji, usalama wa kitabibu, usalama na gharama.
Kuongoza uchunguzi wa matukio kwa huduma za timu na kusukuma marekebisho.
Kufanya kazi na maafisa wa usalama wa kitabibu kuhakikisha udhibiti wa usalama umebuniwa ndani na kujaribiwa.
Kuwaongoza na kuwaendeleza wasanidi katika timu.
qualifications: Uzoefu mkubwa wa kubuni, kujenga na kusaidia programu za uzalishaji, katika kiwango kinacholingana na shahada ya uzamili.

levels.title: Msanidi kiongozi wa programu
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A lead developer leads development on one or a small number of related project teams.

At this role level, you will:
- guide the ways in which the team works
- be proficient in a wide range of technical systems
- be involved in identifying appropriate technology and approaches, deciding when software should be written
- contribute to the developer community
- provide technical leadership, coaching and mentoring your team
- promote knowledge sharing and adoption of good practice
There are 2 different roles at this level - a technical role and a management role.
responsibilities: Kuongoza uhandisi wa bidhaa au kundi la timu, akiweka mwelekeo wa kiufundi.
Kuhakikisha programu inabuniwa kwa usalama, ulinzi, ustahimilivu na ushirikiano wa mifumo.
Kufanya kazi na wasanifu, mameneja wa bidhaa na viongozi wa kitabibu kuunda ramani ya njia ya bidhaa.
Kuongoza jumuiya ya mazoezi ya uendelezaji na kuweka viwango katika timu.
Kusimamia moja kwa moja au kuongoza wasanidi, akisaidia maendeleo na utendaji wao.
qualifications: Uzoefu mpana wa kuongoza uhandisi wa programu kwa huduma tata.
levels.jobEvaluationNotes: UK GDaD PCF inaorodhesha msanidi kiongozi na mkuu kwa kawaida katika G7 au G6; marejeleo haya yanaweka kiongozi katika Daraja la 8a na mkuu katika Daraja la 8b.

levels.title: Msanidi mkuu wa programu
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A principal developer leads and plans development across large or multiple teams.

At this role level, you will:
- be an expert in many technical areas or a specialist with very deep knowledge in a particular technical area
- use this knowledge, and work with related disciplines, to keep multiple teams working effectively
- develop capability by facilitating internal mobility, shaping career paths and recruiting talent, ensuring they collaborate
- identify, test and champion the adoption of emerging technologies
There are 2 different roles at this level - a technical role and a management role.
responsibilities: Kuweka mkakati, viwango na mazoezi ya uhandisi kwa uendelezaji wa programu wa taasisi.
Kuwashauri viongozi wakuu kuhusu uchaguzi wa teknolojia, hatari na uwekezaji.
Kuongoza utatuzi wa matatizo tata zaidi ya kiufundi katika huduma.
Kuiwakilisha taasisi katika jumuiya za uhandisi za taasisi mbalimbali na za chanzo huria.
Kuongoza na kuendeleza wasanidi viongozi na kukuza uwezo wa uhandisi wa taasisi.
qualifications: Uzoefu mpana wa kuongoza uhandisi katika timu au taasisi nyingi.

roles.title: Msanidi wa sehemu ya mbele
roles.summary: Waendelezaji wa sehemu ya mbele hujenga violesura vya watumiaji vya huduma za afya za kidijitali za taasisi, kama vile tovuti na programu tumizi zinazowalenga wagonjwa, fomu za mtandaoni, na skrini ambazo madaktari na wafanyakazi wa matunzo hutumia wakati wa matunzo. Huandika msimbo unaofikika, wa haraka na salama unaofanya kazi kwa kila mtu, ikiwemo watu wanaougua, wenye wasiwasi, au wanaotumia vifaa vya zamani, na hufanya kazi katika timu za bidhaa za fani mbalimbali pamoja na wabunifu, watafiti na madaktari.
healthContext: Watumiaji wengi ni wagonjwa, wana maumivu, ni wazee au walemavu, hivyo ufikivu na violesura rahisi na tulivu ni muhimu badala ya hiari.

Maonyesho yenye kuchanganya au yasiyo sahihi ya taarifa za kitabibu, kama vile dozi ya dawa, matokeo au muda wa miadi, yanaweza kuwadhuru wagonjwa, hivyo kazi ya sehemu ya mbele hufuata mchakato wa usimamizi wa hatari za kitabibu.
Violesura mara nyingi huonyesha taarifa za siri za afya, hivyo waendelezaji husanifu kwa ajili ya faragha, kwa mfano kwenye vifaa vinavyoshirikiwa na katika maeneo yenye shughuli nyingi za kitabibu.
Madaktari hutumia violesura chini ya shinikizo la muda na kukatizwa mara kwa mara, hivyo skrini lazima ziwe za haraka, zinazotabirika na ngumu kusomwa vibaya.
Wagonjwa hufikia huduma kwa vifaa na miunganisho mbalimbali, hivyo huduma hutumia uboreshaji wa taratibu na hufanya kazi kwenye mitandao ya polepole.

pcfRole.name: Frontend developer
pcfRole.description:
A frontend developer designs, builds and improves website software that meets user needs.

In this role, you will:
- be responsible for writing clean, accessible code following a progressive enhancement approach
- create code that is open by default and easy for others to reuse
- design software which meets user needs and creates meaningful interactions and relationships with users
- have an understanding of the three fundamental frontend technologies (HTML, CSS and JavaScript)

levels.title: Mwanagenzi mwendelezaji wa sehemu ya mbele
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
An apprentice frontend developer attends certified training and develops skills on the job.

At this role level, you will:
- spend a substantial portion of time shadowing others
- work with other developers to write code and tests
- write code that follows web standards
- build your understanding of accessibility
- build your knowledge
- develop software which meets user needs
responsibilities: Kujifunza mfumo wa usanifu wa timu, lugha na zana kupitia mafunzo yaliyopangwa na kufanya kazi kwa jozi.
Kujenga vijenzi vidogo vya kiolesura chini ya usimamizi wa karibu, akifuata mfumo wa usanifu wa taasisi.
Kujaribu vijenzi kwa teknolojia saidizi, kama vile visoma skrini, kwa msaada wa wenzake.
Kufuata taratibu za usimamizi wa taarifa na usalama wa kitabibu anapofanya kazi na data za majaribio na za moja kwa moja.
Kujitahidi kupata uanagenzi au sifa inayolingana.
qualifications: Amesajiliwa katika, au anaelekea kukamilisha, uanagenzi wa uundaji wa programu au unaolingana nao.
levels.jobEvaluationNotes: Maarifa yamepewa alama ya kiwango ambacho kazi inahitaji mara mafunzo yanapokuwa yamekamilika vya kutosha kufanya kazi.

levels.title: Mwendelezaji mdogo wa sehemu ya mbele
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A junior frontend developer learns on the job by delivering software components.

At this role level, you will:
- work independently, with guidance from more senior developers, to identify user issues and needs
- write clean code that follows web standards
- build your understanding of accessibility
- build your knowledge
- develop software which meets user needs
responsibilities: Kujenga na kujaribu vipengele vya kiolesura kwa huduma zinazowalenga wagonjwa na wafanyakazi, akifanya kazi kutoka hadithi za watumiaji kwa mwongozo.
Kutumia mfumo wa usanifu na mifumo ya taasisi ili huduma zionekane na kufanya kazi kwa uthabiti.
Kurekebisha kasoro za ufikivu na kukagua kurasa dhidi ya viwango vya ufikivu kama WCAG.
Kuhakikisha taarifa za kitabibu, kama vile tarehe, dozi na matokeo, zinaonyeshwa kama zilivyobainishwa hasa.
Kuchangia ushahidi kwa hoja za usalama wa kitabibu, kama vile matokeo ya majaribio na picha za skrini za mabadiliko.
qualifications: Shahada katika kompyuta au somo linalohusiana, uanagenzi uliokamilika, au uzoefu unaolingana.

levels.title: Mwendelezaji wa sehemu ya mbele
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A frontend developer builds software components, primarily in the form of user interfaces.

At this role level, you will:
- collaborate and work closely with other disciplines to develop designs and working prototypes based on user needs and in support of organisational aims
- develop software components that form part of a product to meet user needs
- write clean, well-tested code that follows web standards
- coach and mentor more junior colleagues
responsibilities: Kubuni na kujenga violesura vinavyofikika na vinavyojirekebisha kwa huduma za afya kwa kujitegemea, akichagua njia zinazofaa.
Kufanya kazi na wabunifu na watafiti wa watumiaji kujaribu mifano na wagonjwa, madaktari na wafanyakazi wa matunzo.
Kujenga violesura vinavyoita API za data za afya, kama vile huduma za HL7 FHIR, na kushughulikia makosa na data zinazokosekana kwa usalama.
Kushiriki katika warsha za hatari na kujenga udhibiti wa usalama ndani ya kiolesura, kama vile hatua za uthibitisho na maonyo wazi.
Kulinda taarifa za siri kwenye kivinjari, kwa mfano kwa kusimamia vipindi na uhifadhi wa muda kwa uangalifu kwenye vifaa vinavyoshirikiwa.
Kukagua msimbo na kuwa mshauri wa waendelezaji wadogo na wanagenzi wa sehemu ya mbele.
qualifications: Shahada katika kompyuta au somo linalohusiana, au uzoefu unaolingana.
Uzoefu wa kujenga na kusaidia huduma za wavuti zinazofikika za uzalishaji.

levels.title: Mwendelezaji mwandamizi wa sehemu ya mbele
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A senior frontend developer is an experienced developer who works with minimal support and can influence and mentor others.

At this role level, you will:
- help set direction and embed good practice within teams
- make decisions based on research
- plan and lead development on sets of related stories, working with other disciplines to understand what needs to be built
- have an understanding of the whole system
- teach and mentor others
responsibilities: Kuongoza usanifu na utoaji wa sehemu ya mbele wa vipengele muhimu, kama vile uwekaji miadi, matokeo, au skrini za mtiririko wa kazi za kitabibu.
Kuweka na kutunza viwango vya sehemu ya mbele kwa timu, ikiwemo ufikivu, utendaji, usalama na majaribio.
Kuchangia vijenzi na mifumo kwenye mfumo wa usanifu wa taasisi na kuhakikisha ni salama na vinafikika.
Kufanya kazi na maafisa wa usalama wa kitabibu kuhakikisha hatari za kiolesura zinatambuliwa, kudhibitiwa na kujaribiwa.
Kuhakikisha huduma zinafanya kazi vizuri kwenye miunganisho ya polepole, vifaa vya zamani na teknolojia saidizi.
Kuwaongoza na kuwaendeleza waendelezaji wa sehemu ya mbele katika timu.
qualifications: Uzoefu mkubwa wa kubuni, kujenga na kusaidia huduma za wavuti zinazofikika za uzalishaji, katika kiwango kinacholingana na shahada ya uzamili.

levels.title: Mwendelezaji kiongozi wa sehemu ya mbele
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A lead frontend developer is an expert practitioner who influences and mentors others.

At this role level, you will:
- set direction and assure the quality of development across teams
- lead multiple or highly complex services
- contribute to the community, providing technical leadership, coaching and mentoring
- promote knowledge sharing and adoption of good practice
- be proficient in a wide range of technical systems and able to identify appropriate technology and approaches
responsibilities: Kuongoza uhandisi wa sehemu ya mbele katika kundi la timu au huduma kubwa inayowalenga wagonjwa.
Kumiliki mwelekeo wa kiufundi wa mfumo wa usanifu wa taasisi na maktaba za sehemu ya mbele.
Kuhakikisha violesura katika huduma zote vinatimiza viwango vya ufikivu na vimehakikishwa kwa usalama wa kitabibu.
Kufanya kazi na wasanifu, wabunifu na viongozi wa kitabibu kuunda ramani za njia za bidhaa na uchaguzi wa teknolojia ya sehemu ya mbele.
Kuongoza jumuiya ya mazoezi ya sehemu ya mbele na kusimamia moja kwa moja au kuongoza waendelezaji wa sehemu ya mbele.
qualifications: Uzoefu mpana wa kuongoza uhandisi wa sehemu ya mbele kwa huduma tata zinazofikika.

levels.title: Mkuu wa uendelezaji wa sehemu ya mbele
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A head of frontend development is an expert practitioner with broad industry experience. They are an expert in many technical areas, or specialists with very deep knowledge in a particular technical area.

At this role level, you will:
- define and assure best practice while influencing, leading and mentoring others
- influence and develop organisational strategy and priorities, collaborating with counterpart colleagues across government
- ensure the right conditions and environment for frontend developers to work effectively
- develop departmental capability by facilitating internal mobility, shaping career paths and recruiting talent
responsibilities: Kuweka mkakati, viwango na mazoezi ya sehemu ya mbele kwa huduma zote za kidijitali za taasisi.
Kuwajibika kwa ufikivu na urahisi wa matumizi wa violesura vya taasisi kwa wagonjwa na wafanyakazi.
Kuwashauri viongozi wakuu kuhusu teknolojia ya sehemu ya mbele, uwekezaji wa mfumo wa usanifu na hatari za violesura duni kwa matunzo.
Kuiwakilisha taasisi katika jumuiya za mifumo ya usanifu na ufikivu za taasisi mbalimbali.
Kuongoza na kuendeleza waendelezaji wa sehemu ya mbele katika taasisi, ikiwemo uajiri na njia za taaluma.
qualifications: Uzoefu mpana wa kuongoza uendelezaji wa sehemu ya mbele katika timu au taasisi nyingi.

roles.title: Mhandisi wa DevOps
roles.summary: Wahandisi wa DevOps hujenga na kuendesha zana, mifereji, mazingira na majukwaa yanayoziwezesha timu za taasisi kutoa huduma za afya za kidijitali kwa usalama na mara kwa mara. Huendesha kiotomatiki ujenzi, majaribio, matoleo na miundombinu, hufanya huduma zionekane na kustahimili, na kuzisaidia timu kuweka mifumo ya kitabibu ikipatikana wagonjwa na madaktari wanapoihitaji.
healthContext: Huduma nyingi zinaunga mkono matunzo saa nzima, hivyo usambazaji, ufuatiliaji na urejeshaji lazima vipunguze muda wa kutopatikana, ikiwemo nje ya saa za kazi.
Mifereji ya matoleo hutoa ushahidi kwa hoja za usalama wa kitabibu, kama vile matokeo ya majaribio, kumbukumbu za mabadiliko na toleo kamili lililosambazwa.
Mazingira yanaweza kushikilia taarifa za siri za afya, hivyo wahandisi hudhibiti ufikiaji, hulinda siri na kuweka data halisi nje ya mazingira ya majaribio.
Huduma za afya ni walengwa wa kawaida wa mashambulizi ya mtandao, hivyo mifereji na majukwaa hujenga ndani uchanganuzi wa usalama, uwekaji wa marekebisho na nakala rudufu zilizojaribiwa.
Baadhi ya huduma lazima zitimize viwango vikali vya upatikanaji na urejeshaji baada ya maafa, vilivyokubaliwa na viongozi wa kitabibu na wa kiutendaji.

pcfRole.name: Development operations (DevOps) engineer
pcfRole.description:
Commonly referred to as ‘DevOps engineers’, development operations engineers support the development and operation of software through tools, environments and practices.

In this role, you will be responsible for underpinning good development processes including managing tools and testing environments, central code control, maintaining development standards and writing software that automates systems.

levels.title: Mhandisi mwanagenzi wa DevOps
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
An apprentice DevOps engineer attends certified training and develops skills on the job.

At this role level, you will:
- spend a significant proportion of your time shadowing others
- be involved in implementation but not planning
- build on your knowledge
responsibilities: Kujifunza mifereji, majukwaa ya wingu na zana za timu kupitia mafunzo yaliyopangwa na kuwafuata wenye uzoefu.
Kufanya mabadiliko madogo yaliyobainishwa vizuri kwenye hati, mifereji na usanidi chini ya usimamizi wa karibu.
Kufuata taratibu za mabadiliko, usalama na usimamizi wa taarifa kwa kila mazingira.
Kusaidia kufuatilia huduma na kuripoti tahadhari kwa wenzake wenye uzoefu.
Kujitahidi kupata uanagenzi au sifa inayolingana.
qualifications: Amesajiliwa katika, au anaelekea kukamilisha, uanagenzi wa DevOps, programu au miundombinu au unaolingana nao.
levels.jobEvaluationNotes: Maarifa yamepewa alama ya kiwango ambacho kazi inahitaji mara mafunzo yanapokuwa yamekamilika vya kutosha kufanya kazi.

levels.title: Mhandisi mdogo wa DevOps
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A junior DevOps engineer learns on the job by building software components.

At this role level, you will:
- assist in the building of a complex story
- work under supervision
- be involved in implementation but not planning
responsibilities: Kujenga na kutunza sehemu za mifereji ya ujenzi, majaribio na usambazaji kwa mwongozo.
Kuandika miundombinu kama msimbo na hati za uendeshaji kiotomatiki, na kuzijaribu kabla ya matumizi.
Kuweka mazingira ya majaribio bila data halisi za wagonjwa na kusimamia siri kwa usalama.
Kujibu tahadhari za ufuatiliaji na kusaidia majibu kwa matukio kwa mwongozo.
Kurekodi usambazaji na mabadiliko ili yaunge mkono usalama wa kitabibu na ushahidi wa ukaguzi.
qualifications: Shahada katika kompyuta au somo linalohusiana, uanagenzi uliokamilika, au uzoefu unaolingana.
levels.jobEvaluationNotes: UK GDaD PCF inapendekeza Daraja la 4 kwa ngazi zote mbili za mwanagenzi na mdogo; marejeleo haya yanaweka ngazi ya mdogo katika Daraja la 5 ili kuepuka ngazi mbili katika daraja moja, kwa sababu kazi inajenga vijenzi vya mifereji kwa usimamizi mdogo.

levels.title: Mhandisi wa DevOps
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A DevOps engineer delivers automated software components that form part of a development operations toolchain.

At this role level, you will:
- transform technical requirements into DevOps processes
- build complex stories without additional support
- manage live test environments
- identify and resolve issues that are preventing delivery
responsibilities: Kubuni na kujenga mifereji, mazingira na vijenzi vya jukwaa kwa kujitegemea.
Kuendesha kiotomatiki ukaguzi wa usalama, kama vile uchanganuzi wa utegemezi na vyombo, na kuchukua hatua juu ya matokeo.
Kujenga ufuatiliaji, uandishi wa kumbukumbu na tahadhari ili timu ziyaone matatizo kabla hayajaathiri wagonjwa na wafanyakazi.
Kupanga na kujaribu nakala rudufu, kuhamia mfumo mbadala na urejeshaji kwa huduma zinazounga mkono matunzo.
Kuchunguza na kurekebisha matatizo katika huduma za moja kwa moja, ikiwemo msaada nje ya saa za kazi pale huduma inapohitaji.
Kuwa mshauri wa wahandisi wadogo na wanagenzi wa DevOps.
qualifications: Shahada katika kompyuta au somo linalohusiana, au uzoefu unaolingana.
Uzoefu wa kujenga na kuendesha mifereji ya utoaji ya kiotomatiki na miundombinu ya wingu.

levels.title: Mhandisi mwandamizi wa DevOps
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A senior DevOps engineer delivers and integrates software to form a complete DevOps toolchain. They are responsible for planning and designing large groups of stories.

At this role level, you will:
- transform technical requirements into an effective DevOps toolchain to enable product delivery
- provide coaching and mentoring to more junior colleagues
- ensure that deployment strategies for products are repeatable, scalable and highly available
- have deep technical knowledge, providing support to delivery teams and solving complex problems
There are 2 different roles at this level - a technical role and a management role.
responsibilities: Kuongoza usanifu wa mnyororo wa zana za utoaji na jukwaa kwa bidhaa au kundi la huduma.
Kuweka viwango vya matoleo, ili usambazaji kwa huduma za kitabibu uweze kurudiwa, kubatilishwa na kuwa na ushahidi mzuri.
Kukubaliana malengo ya upatikanaji, muda wa kurejesha na hatua ya kurejesha na wamiliki wa huduma na viongozi wa kitabibu, na kubuni kuyatimiza.
Kuongoza majibu ya kiufundi kwa matukio na mapitio baada ya matukio kwa majukwaa ambayo timu inaendesha.
Kuhakikisha majukwaa yanatimiza mahitaji ya usalama na usimamizi wa taarifa, ikiwemo udhibiti wa ufikiaji na uandishi wa kumbukumbu za ukaguzi.
Kuwaongoza na kuwaendeleza wahandisi wa DevOps katika timu.
qualifications: Uzoefu mkubwa wa kubuni na kuendesha minyororo ya zana za utoaji na majukwaa, katika kiwango kinacholingana na shahada ya uzamili.

levels.title: Mhandisi kiongozi wa DevOps
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A lead DevOps engineer leads one or a small number of related project teams and contributes to the development of the strategic direction.

At this role level, you will:
- act as a technical product owner, developing medium to long term strategies for product lines
- provide technical leadership and guidance through coaching and mentoring
- lead the sharing of knowledge and good practice
There are 2 different roles at this level - a technical role and a management role.
responsibilities: Kuongoza uhandisi wa DevOps na wa jukwaa kwa kundi la timu, akiwa mmiliki wa kiufundi wa jukwaa linaloshirikiwa.
Kuweka ramani ya njia ya muda wa kati kwa zana za utoaji, uhifadhi na ufuatiliaji wa taasisi.
Kuhakikisha majukwaa yanayoshirikiwa ni thabiti, salama na yanaweza kutimiza mahitaji ya upatikanaji ya huduma za kitabibu.
Kusimamia gharama na uwezo wa jukwaa pamoja na idara ya fedha na wamiliki wa huduma.
Kuongoza jumuiya ya mazoezi ya DevOps na kusimamia moja kwa moja au kuongoza wahandisi wa DevOps.
qualifications: Uzoefu mpana wa kuongoza uhandisi wa DevOps au wa jukwaa kwa huduma tata.

levels.title: Mhandisi mkuu wa DevOps
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A principal DevOps engineer leads and plans development across large or multiple teams, defining the strategic vision for delivery.

At this role level, you will:
- identify, test and champion the adoption of emerging technologies
- ensure that security, stability and capacity are embedded in the development and deployment of services
- develop a team’s capability by rewarding high performers
- shape career paths and recruit the right talent
- identify skills gaps and important dependencies within technical teams
There are 2 different roles at this level - a technical role and a management role.
responsibilities: Kuweka mkakati wa jinsi taasisi inavyojenga, kutoa matoleo, kuhifadhi na kuendesha huduma zake za afya za kidijitali.
Kuwashauri viongozi wakuu kuhusu uhifadhi, ustahimilivu, usalama wa mtandao na uwekezaji wa jukwaa.
Kuhakikisha mipango ya mwendelezo wa biashara na urejeshaji baada ya maafa kwa huduma muhimu za kitabibu ni halisi na imejaribiwa.
Kutathmini na kuhimiza teknolojia na mazoezi mapya, akisawazisha uvumbuzi dhidi ya usalama na uthabiti.
Kukuza uwezo wa DevOps wa taasisi, ikiwemo uajiri, njia za taaluma na mipango ya ujuzi.
qualifications: Uzoefu mpana wa kuongoza uhandisi wa DevOps na wa jukwaa katika timu au taasisi nyingi.

roles.title: Mhandisi wa uunganishaji (ushirikiano wa mifumo ya afya)
roles.summary: Wahandisi wa uunganishaji huunganisha mifumo ya kitabibu na ya biashara ya taasisi ili taarifa za afya na matunzo zitiririke kwa usalama hadi mahali zinapohitajika. Husanifu, hujenga, hujaribu na kusaidia violesura, API na mitiririko ya ujumbe kwa kutumia viwango kama HL7 FHIR na HL7 toleo la 2, huchora ramani ya data na misimbo ya kitabibu kati ya mifumo, na kuweka miunganisho ikifanya kazi katika huduma ya moja kwa moja.
healthContext: Ujumbe uliopotea, uliochelewa, uliorudiwa, au uliolinganishwa vibaya, kama vile matokeo ya kipimo au rufaa, unaweza kusababisha madhara moja kwa moja, hivyo kazi ya uunganishaji hufuata mchakato wa usimamizi wa hatari za kitabibu.
Miunganisho hubeba kiasi kikubwa cha taarifa za siri za afya kati ya taasisi, hivyo kila mtiririko unahitaji msingi halali, usafirishaji salama na ukaguzi.
Mifumo ya afya hutumia viwango na matoleo mengi, kuanzia ujumbe wa HL7 toleo la 2 hadi API za HL7 FHIR na wasifu wa IHE, mara nyingi zenye tofauti za ndani.
Maana ya kitabibu lazima iendelee kuwepo katika safari, hivyo wahandisi huchora ramani ya istilahi za kitabibu kama SNOMED CT kwa usahihi na kulinganisha wagonjwa kwa uaminifu.
Miunganisho mingi inaunga mkono matunzo saa nzima, hivyo inahitaji ufuatiliaji, tahadhari na njia wazi za kutatua ujumbe ulioshindwa.

levels.title: Mhandisi mdogo wa uunganishaji
levels.summary: Mhandisi mdogo wa uunganishaji hujenga, hujaribu na kusaidia miunganisho kati ya mifumo ya afya na matunzo, akifanya kazi kutoka vipimo na kwa mwongozo wa wahandisi wenye uzoefu zaidi.
responsibilities: Kujenga na kubadilisha ramani za ujumbe, ubadilishaji na miito ya API kutoka vipimo vilivyokubaliwa.
Kujaribu miunganisho dhidi ya vipimo na ujumbe wa sampuli, ikiwemo makosa na hali za pembezoni.
Kufuatilia mitiririko ya ujumbe, kuchunguza ujumbe ulioshindwa au kukataliwa, na kuutatua au kuupeleka juu.
Kushughulikia data za afya kwa usalama, akifuata kanuni za usimamizi wa taarifa kwa data za moja kwa moja na za majaribio.
Kurekodi mabadiliko na matokeo ya majaribio ili yatumike kama ushahidi wa usalama wa kitabibu.
qualifications: Shahada katika kompyuta au somo linalohusiana, uanagenzi uliokamilika, au uzoefu unaolingana.

levels.title: Mhandisi wa uunganishaji
levels.summary: Mhandisi wa uunganishaji husanifu, hujenga na kusaidia miunganisho kati ya mifumo ya afya na matunzo kwa kujitegemea, na husaidia kufafanua jinsi mifumo inavyopaswa kubadilishana data.
responsibilities: Kubuni na kujenga miunganisho, API na mitiririko ya ujumbe kwa kutumia HL7 FHIR, HL7 toleo la 2 na mifumo ya ujumbe.
Kuchambua mifumo chanzo na lengwa na kuandika vipimo vya violesura na ramani za data, ikiwemo misimbo ya kitabibu.
Kujenga ulinganishaji wa wagonjwa, uthibitishaji na ushughulikiaji wa makosa ili taarifa zifike kwenye rekodi sahihi.
Kushiriki katika warsha za hatari na kujenga udhibiti wa usalama ndani ya miunganisho, kama vile tahadhari kwa ujumbe ulioshindwa au kuchelewa.
Kufanya kazi na wasambazaji na taasisi washirika kujaribu na kuanza kutumia miunganisho mipya.
Kuchunguza na kurekebisha matatizo katika miunganisho ya moja kwa moja, na kuwa mshauri wa wahandisi wadogo wa uunganishaji.
qualifications: Shahada katika kompyuta au somo linalohusiana, au uzoefu unaolingana.
Uzoefu wa kujenga na kusaidia miunganisho kati ya mifumo ya uzalishaji.

levels.title: Mhandisi mwandamizi wa uunganishaji
levels.summary: Mhandisi mwandamizi wa uunganishaji huongoza usanifu na utoaji wa miunganisho tata katika mifumo na taasisi nyingi, na huweka viwango vya uunganishaji kwa eneo lake.
responsibilities: Kuongoza usanifu wa kiufundi wa miunganisho tata, kama vile kumbukumbu za matunzo zinazoshirikiwa, matokeo na rufaa kati ya taasisi.
Kuandika na kutunza wasifu wa FHIR, miongozo ya utekelezaji na viwango vya violesura vya taasisi.
Kubuni miunganisho iwe salama, thabiti na inayoonekana, yenye njia wazi za kutatua hitilafu.
Kufanya kazi na maafisa wa usalama wa kitabibu kutambua hatari za uunganishaji na kuhakikisha udhibiti umebuniwa ndani na kujaribiwa.
