Kuhakikisha kila mtiririko wa data una msingi halali uliokubaliwa na mipango ya ushirikishaji wa data, akifanya kazi na wenzake wa usimamizi wa taarifa.
Kuwaongoza na kuwaendeleza wahandisi wa uunganishaji katika timu.
qualifications: Uzoefu mkubwa wa kubuni na kusaidia miunganisho ya afya au tata nyingine, katika kiwango kinacholingana na shahada ya uzamili.

levels.title: Mhandisi kiongozi wa uunganishaji
levels.summary: Mhandisi kiongozi wa uunganishaji huongoza uhandisi wa uunganishaji wa taasisi, huweka mwelekeo na viwango vyake vya kiufundi, na huhakikisha miunganisho muhimu katika mifumo mingi.
responsibilities: Kuongoza uhandisi wa uunganishaji katika taasisi, akiweka mwelekeo, mifumo na viwango.
Kuhakikisha usanifu wa miunganisho muhimu, kama ile inayobeba matokeo, dawa au tahadhari.
Kuunda ramani ya njia ya jukwaa la uunganishaji pamoja na wasanifu, mameneja wa bidhaa na wasambazaji.
Kuiwakilisha taasisi katika kazi ya ushirikiano wa mifumo na viwango ya taasisi mbalimbali.
Kusimamia moja kwa moja au kuongoza wahandisi wa uunganishaji na kukuza jumuiya ya mazoezi ya uunganishaji.
qualifications: Uzoefu mpana wa kuongoza uhandisi wa uunganishaji kwa mifumo tata ya afya au matunzo.

roles.title: Msanifu wa taasisi
roles.summary: Wasanifu wa taasisi huipa taasisi mtazamo ulioungana wa huduma, taarifa, programu na teknolojia zake, na kuutumia kugeuza mkakati wa afya na matunzo kuwa mpango thabiti wa mabadiliko. Huweka kanuni za usanifu, viwango na ramani za njia, huongoza maamuzi ya uwekezaji, na kuhakikisha mabadiliko ya kidijitali yanaunga mkono matunzo salama na yaliyounganishwa kwa wagonjwa katika taasisi mbalimbali.
healthContext: Njia za matunzo huvuka taasisi na mifumo mingi, hivyo usanifu lazima uunge mkono ushirikishaji wa kumbukumbu, matokeo na rufaa kuvuka mipaka.
Mkusanyiko mara nyingi hujumuisha mifumo ya kitabibu ya muda mrefu, vifaa tiba na mikataba ya wasambazaji ambayo ni vigumu kubadilisha, hivyo ramani za njia lazima zipange mpito kwa uangalifu.
Maamuzi ya usanifu huathiri usalama wa mgonjwa, faragha na ustahimilivu wa huduma zinazofanya kazi saa nzima.
Viwango huria kama HL7 FHIR, SNOMED CT na wasifu wa IHE ni muhimu ili kuepuka kufungwa kwa muuzaji mmoja na kuwezesha ushirikiano wa mifumo.
Ufadhili una vikwazo na unachunguzwa kwa karibu, hivyo wasanifu lazima waonyeshe thamani ya fedha na utumiaji tena wa majukwaa yanayoshirikiwa pale yanapokuwepo.

pcfRole.name: Enterprise architect
pcfRole.description:
Enterprise architects are leaders working across different levels within an organisation to translate the business strategy into business change and technical delivery.

In this role, you will:
- identify priorities for change to enable delivery at pace
- lead and influence the delivery of cross-cutting capabilities that enable change
- own the enterprise architecture vision, strategy and roadmaps from a business, technology and data perspective, including ‘as is’, ‘to be’ and transitional states
- consult and support collaboration across the business
- understand the organisation’s ecosystem and its interdependencies, including reference architectures
- take a strategic view across all architectural domains, portfolios and programmes
- guide the organisation to make appropriate business, technology and data decisions by recommending reuse, sustainability and scalability, to achieve value for money and reduce risk
- establish architectural principles, policies and standards
- collaborate and consult with stakeholders to assure business, technology and data decisions are aligned with enterprise architecture strategy
- develop the architecture community
- carry out horizon scanning across industry, identifying emerging trends and their potential impact and opportunity for the organisation

levels.title: Msanifu wa taasisi
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
An enterprise architect supports other architects in developing the strategy.

At this role level, you will:
- network and communicate with stakeholders across domains or enterprises, and identify opportunities for improvement
- use best practice
- use emerging technologies and approaches
- learn to identify influences or risks
- play a part in successful delivery of the team’s objectives
responsibilities: Kuunda miundo ya huduma, taarifa, programu na teknolojia za sasa na lengwa za taasisi kwa eneo, kama vile uchunguzi wa kitabibu au matunzo ya jamii.
Kuweka hazina ya usanifu ikiwa ya kisasa, ikiwemo katalogi za programu na mtiririko wa data.
Kukagua mapendekezo dhidi ya kanuni na viwango vya usanifu, na kutoa mapendekezo kwa mamlaka za usanifu.
Kutambua mahali mifumo inapojirudia uwezo au kutegemea teknolojia isiyoungwa mkono, na kuibua hatari.
Kufanya kazi na wasanifu wa suluhisho na viongozi wa kitabibu kuelewa jinsi njia za matunzo zinavyotumia mifumo.
Kuwaongoza wasanifu wa suluhisho jinsi miundo inavyolingana na usanifu wa eneo.
qualifications: Uzoefu mkubwa wa usanifu, uchambuzi au usanifu wa kiufundi katika taasisi tata, katika kiwango kinacholingana na shahada ya uzamili.
Ujuzi wa mfumo wa usanifu wa taasisi, kama vile TOGAF, au uzoefu unaolingana.
levels.jobEvaluationNotes: Imewekwa katika daraja la juu zaidi ya pendekezo la daraja la UK GDaD PCF (Daraja la 6): matangazo ya sekta ya afya yanaweka nafasi hii katika Daraja la 8a. Maarifa, uchambuzi, mipango, sera na uhuru wa kutenda vimepewa alama za wasifu wa Daraja la 8a kwa sababu kazi inaunda usanifu lengwa na kushauri mamlaka za usanifu kwa eneo zima.

levels.title: Msanifu mwandamizi wa taasisi
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A senior enterprise architect supports lead architects in ensuring the strategy is developed, agreed and followed.

At this role level, you will:
- network and communicate with stakeholders across domains or enterprises
- identify opportunities for improvement
- support a community or team
- use best practice
- use emerging technologies and approaches
- play an active part in the team and understand how to deliver the team’s objectives to meet organisational goals
- identify influences or risks
- play a part in successful delivery of the long-term strategy
responsibilities: Kuendeleza usanifu lengwa na ramani za njia za mpito kwa eneo moja au zaidi la taasisi.
Kuunda hoja za kibiashara ili uwekezaji ulingane na usanifu lengwa na kutumia tena majukwaa yanayoshirikiwa.
Kuongoza ukaguzi wa usanifu katika mamlaka za usanifu na kutoa mapendekezo kuhusu mapendekezo muhimu.
Kupanga kubadilisha au kustaafisha mifumo ya zamani ya kitabibu na ya kampuni, ikiwemo uhamishaji wa data na hatari za usalama.
Kuhakikisha mahitaji ya ushirikiano wa mifumo, usalama na usimamizi wa taarifa yanajengwa ndani ya ramani za njia.
Kuwaongoza wasanifu wa taasisi na wa suluhisho.
qualifications: Uzoefu mpana wa usanifu wa taasisi au wa suluhisho katika maeneo kadhaa.
Ujuzi wa mfumo wa usanifu wa taasisi, kama vile TOGAF, au uzoefu unaolingana.
levels.jobEvaluationNotes: Imewekwa katika daraja la juu zaidi ya pendekezo la daraja la UK GDaD PCF (Daraja la 7): matangazo ya sekta ya afya yanaweka nafasi hii katika Daraja la 8b. Mipango ni kiwango cha 5 kwa ramani za njia za muda mrefu zenye athari katika taasisi nzima; maarifa ni kiwango cha 8 kwa maarifa ya usanifu wa biashara, taarifa, programu na teknolojia.

levels.title: Msanifu kiongozi wa taasisi
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A lead enterprise architect plays a high level role in ensuring the strategy is developed, agreed and followed.

At this role level, you will:
- network and communicate with senior stakeholders across enterprises, and seek opportunities for improvement
- support at least one community or team, or a combination of both
- find and use best practice and emerging technologies and approaches
- lead teams including enterprise architects and help them understand how to deliver the team’s objectives to meet organisational goals
- horizon scan for influences or risks
- support successful delivery of the long-term strategy
- take a leading role in the overall direction of business and digital capabilities
responsibilities: Kumiliki usanifu wa taasisi kwa sehemu kubwa ya taasisi, kama vile mifumo ya kitabibu au miundombinu inayoshirikiwa.
Kuongoza au kuwa mwenyekiti wa mamlaka ya usanifu na kuweka viwango ambavyo miradi lazima itimize.
Kuwashauri wakurugenzi kuhusu vipaumbele vya uwekezaji, mkakati wa wasambazaji na hatari za teknolojia.
Kufanya kazi na taasisi washirika kuoanisha usanifu katika njia za matunzo na kumbukumbu zinazoshirikiwa.
Kuongoza na kuendeleza wasanifu wa taasisi na kukuza jumuiya ya mazoezi ya usanifu.
qualifications: Uzoefu mpana wa usanifu wa taasisi katika taasisi tata.
levels.jobEvaluationNotes: Imewekwa katika daraja la juu zaidi ya pendekezo la daraja la UK GDaD PCF (Daraja la 8b): matangazo ya sekta ya afya yanaweka nafasi hii katika Daraja la 8c. Rasilimali za taarifa ni kiwango cha 6 kwa sababu kazi inasimamia usanifu wa mifumo ya taarifa katika sehemu kubwa ya taasisi; sera na watu viko juu ya wasifu wa Daraja la 8b kwa sababu inaweka viwango kwa miradi yote na kuongoza wasanifu wa taasisi.

levels.title: Msanifu mkuu wa taasisi
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A principal enterprise architect leads at the highest level and is responsible for ensuring the strategy is developed, agreed and followed.

At this role level, you will:
- network and communicate with senior stakeholders across enterprises, and actively seek opportunities for improvement
- support multiple communities and teams
- find and use best practice
- find and use emerging technologies and approaches
- inspire other enterprise architects and help them understand how to meet organisational goals
- horizon scan for external influences or risks
- support successful delivery of the long-term strategy
- be responsible for the overall direction of business and digital capabilities
- be responsible for the creation, maintenance and consumption of a Digital Twin
responsibilities: Kuweka maono, kanuni na mkakati wa usanifu wa taasisi, ulioambatana na mkakati wake wa afya na matunzo.
Kuishauri timu ya watendaji na bodi kuhusu usanifu, hatari na thamani ya uwekezaji mkubwa wa kidijitali.
Kuongoza mazoezi ya usanifu, usimamizi na viwango vya taasisi.
Kuiwakilisha taasisi katika majukwaa ya usanifu na ushirikiano wa mifumo ya taasisi mbalimbali.
Kujenga uwezo wa usanifu katika taasisi, ikiwemo uajiri na njia za taaluma.
qualifications: Uzoefu mpana wa kuongoza usanifu wa taasisi katika taasisi mbalimbali.
levels.jobEvaluationNotes: Imewekwa katika daraja la juu zaidi ya pendekezo la daraja la UK GDaD PCF (Daraja la 8c): matangazo ya sekta ya afya yanaweka nafasi hii katika Daraja la 8d. Sera na uhuru wa kutenda ni kiwango cha 6 kwa sababu kazi inashikilia wajibu wa kitaasisi kwa maono, kanuni na mkakati wa usanifu wa taasisi.

roles.title: Msanifu wa suluhisho
roles.summary: Wasanifu wa suluhisho husanifu jinsi huduma mpya au iliyobadilishwa itakavyofanya kazi kutoka mwanzo hadi mwisho, kuanzia mahitaji ya watumiaji na mtiririko wa kazi za kitabibu hadi programu, data, miunganisho, uhifadhi na usalama. Huhakikisha kila suluhisho linalingana na usanifu wa taasisi, linatimiza mahitaji yake ya usalama, faragha na ushirikiano wa mifumo, na linaweza kujengwa, kuendeshwa na kusaidiwa kwa gharama nafuu.
healthContext: Suluhisho mara nyingi huchanganya mifumo ya kitabibu iliyonunuliwa, huduma za ndani na majukwaa yanayoshirikiwa, hivyo wasanifu lazima wabuni kuvuka mipaka ya wasambazaji.
Uchaguzi wa usanifu unaweza kuleta hatari za kitabibu, kama vile matokeo yaliyopotea au ulinganishaji usio sahihi wa wagonjwa, hivyo miundo ya suluhisho huingia kwenye hoja ya usalama wa kitabibu.
Kila mtiririko mpya wa data za wagonjwa unahitaji msingi halali na tathmini ya athari za ulinzi wa data, hivyo wasanifu hufanya kazi kwa karibu na usimamizi wa taarifa.
Ushirikiano wa mifumo na taasisi nyingine za afya na matunzo, kwa kutumia viwango kama HL7 FHIR, kwa kawaida ni hitaji kuu.
Baadhi ya suluhisho hujumuisha programu ambayo ni kifaa tiba, jambo linalobadilisha mahitaji ya usanifu, uhakikisho na wasambazaji.

pcfRole.name: Solution architect
pcfRole.description:
A solution architect designs solutions for problems that affect the organisation.

In this role, you will:
- ensure a problem and the desired outcomes are properly defined
- ensure the scope of a solution meets the organisation's requirements
- stay up to date on technology trends and approaches
- understand organisational objectives and external drivers, for example, legislation or financial constraints
- work with others to develop business and technical strategies
- work within business and technical constraints
- design and document solutions so they can be implemented by the organisation
- comply with standards and governance
- communicate and work effectively with stakeholders
- manage risks and decisions in a transparent way

levels.title: Msanifu msaidizi wa suluhisho
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
An associate solution architect supports other solution architects to design solutions. You will usually work under supervision.

At this role level, you will:
- support the design of solutions by working with stakeholders
- help your team achieve its objectives
responsibilities: Kukusanya mahitaji kutoka kwa timu za bidhaa, madaktari na wasambazaji ili kuongoza miundo ya suluhisho.
Kuchora michoro ya hali ya sasa na lengwa, kama vile mitazamo ya muktadha, mtiririko wa data na uunganishaji.
Kuandaa rasimu za sehemu za miundo ya suluhisho na kumbukumbu za maamuzi chini ya usimamizi.
Kukagua miundo dhidi ya viwango vya usanifu na mahitaji ya usalama na usimamizi wa taarifa.
Kusaidia kuandaa miundo kwa ukaguzi katika mamlaka za usanifu.
qualifications: Maarifa maalumu ya usanifu wa suluhisho, katika kiwango cha shahada ya uzamili au uzoefu unaolingana.
Uzoefu wa uchambuzi, uendelezaji, au usanifu wa kiufundi.
levels.jobEvaluationNotes: Imewekwa katika daraja la juu zaidi ya pendekezo la daraja la UK GDaD PCF (Daraja la 6): matangazo ya sekta ya afya yanaweka nafasi hii katika Daraja la 7. Maarifa yamepewa alama ya kiwango cha shahada ya uzamili au kinacholingana, kwa sababu kazi inasanifu kuvuka programu, data, uunganishaji na usalama.

levels.title: Msanifu wa suluhisho
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A solution architect is responsible for a single solution. They usually work independently on solutions where risk is low. They also often support or contribute to work led by more senior solution architects.

At this role level, you will:
- build relationships with stakeholders across different business or technical areas in the organisation
- be proactive in identifying opportunities to improve the organisation
- follow best practice for solution design
- use emerging technologies and approaches
- help your team achieve its objective
responsibilities: Kubuni suluhisho za mwanzo hadi mwisho kwa huduma zenye hatari ndogo, kama vile zana za wafanyakazi au huduma rahisi zinazowalenga wagonjwa.
Kulinganisha chaguzi, ikiwemo kununua, kujenga na kutumia tena majukwaa yanayoshirikiwa, na kupendekeza moja kwa sababu wazi.
Kubuni miunganisho, mtiririko wa data, na utambulisho na ufikiaji wa suluhisho, akitumia viwango huria vinapokuwepo.
Kuchangia utambuzi wa hatari na tathmini za athari za ulinzi wa data kwa suluhisho.
Kuwasilisha miundo kwa mamlaka za usanifu na kuzisaidia timu za utoaji kupitia ujenzi na kuanza kutumika.
Kuwaongoza na kukagua kazi ya wasanifu wasaidizi wa suluhisho.
qualifications: Uzoefu mkubwa wa usanifu wa suluhisho au uhandisi wa programu, katika kiwango kinacholingana na shahada ya uzamili.
levels.jobEvaluationNotes: Imewekwa katika daraja la juu zaidi ya pendekezo la daraja la UK GDaD PCF (Daraja la 7): matangazo ya sekta ya afya yanaweka nafasi hii katika Daraja la 8a. Mipango, sera na uhuru wa kutenda vimepewa alama za juu zaidi ya wasifu wa Daraja la 7 kwa sababu kazi inamiliki miundo ya mwanzo hadi mwisho na kupendekeza chaguzi kwa mamlaka za usanifu.

levels.title: Msanifu mwandamizi wa suluhisho
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A senior solution architect is responsible for a single, more complex, solution. They usually work on solutions where the risk is moderate. They may lead and coach other solution architects.

At this role level, you will:
- build relationships with senior stakeholders across different business or technical areas in the organisation
- be proactive in identifying opportunities to improve the organisation
- support multiple architecture projects
- find and use emerging technologies and approaches
- support others to follow best practice for solution architecture
responsibilities: Kubuni suluhisho tata zenye hatari ya wastani, kama vile mifumo ya kitabibu au huduma zinazotumika katika taasisi kadhaa.
Kuongoza tathmini ya kiufundi ya bidhaa za wasambazaji katika ununuzi, ikiwemo ushirikiano wa mifumo, usalama na usalama wa kitabibu.
Kubuni kwa ustahimilivu na mwendelezo wa biashara pale suluhisho linapounga mkono matunzo saa nzima.
Kufanya kazi na maafisa wa usalama wa kitabibu ili maamuzi ya usanifu na udhibiti wa hatari virekodiwe katika hoja ya usalama.
Kuwaongoza na kukagua kazi ya wasanifu wengine wa suluhisho.
qualifications: Uzoefu mpana wa kubuni suluhisho tata katika taaluma kadhaa, katika kiwango kinachozidi shahada ya uzamili.
levels.jobEvaluationNotes: Imewekwa katika daraja la juu zaidi ya pendekezo la daraja la UK GDaD PCF (Daraja la 8a): matangazo ya sekta ya afya yanaweka nafasi hii katika Daraja la 8b. Maarifa yamepewa alama ya kiwango cha 8 kwa maarifa maalumu katika taaluma kadhaa, kama vile programu, data, uunganishaji, usalama na usalama wa kitabibu.

levels.title: Msanifu kiongozi wa suluhisho
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A lead solution architect is responsible for a group of solution architecture projects, or a single more complex area. They may lead teams of more junior solution architects.

At this role level, you will:
- build relationships with senior stakeholders across multiple business or technical areas in the organisation
- be proactive in identifying opportunities to improve the organisation
- support multiple architecture projects or programmes
- find and use emerging technologies and approaches
- develop best practice for solution architecture
responsibilities: Kuongoza usanifu wa suluhisho kwa programu au eneo tata, kama vile kubadilisha rekodi ya mgonjwa ya kielektroniki.
Kuhakikisha suluhisho katika programu zinaendana, zinashirikiana na kuoanishwa na usanifu lengwa.
Kuzishauri bodi za programu kuhusu hatari za usanifu, utegemezi, uchaguzi wa wasambazaji na gharama.
Kuhakikisha miundo ya wasanifu wengine wa suluhisho katika mamlaka za usanifu.
Kuongoza na kuendeleza timu ya wasanifu wa suluhisho.
qualifications: Uzoefu mpana wa kuongoza usanifu wa suluhisho kwa programu tata.
levels.jobEvaluationNotes: Imewekwa katika daraja la juu zaidi ya pendekezo la daraja la UK GDaD PCF (Daraja la 8b): matangazo ya sekta ya afya yanaweka nafasi hii katika Daraja la 8c. Mipango, sera na watu vimepewa alama za juu zaidi ya wasifu wa Daraja la 8b kwa sababu kazi inapanga usanifu wa programu nzima na kuongoza timu ya wasanifu wa suluhisho.

levels.title: Msanifu mkuu wa suluhisho
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A principal solution architect can be responsible for a large programme or group of solution architecture projects, or a single, very complex or critical business area.

At this role level, you will:
- lead teams of more junior solution architects
- lead multiple architecture projects or programmes
- build relationships with senior stakeholders across multiple business or technical areas in the organisation and its partners
- be proactive in identifying opportunities to improve the organisation and its partners
- work with technology partners to inform their roadmaps
- take a leading role in the overall direction of business and digital capabilities
- inspire other architects and help them understand how to meet organisational goals
responsibilities: Kuongoza usanifu wa suluhisho kwa programu kubwa zaidi au muhimu zaidi za taasisi.
Kuweka viwango, mifumo na mbinu za usanifu wa suluhisho kwa taasisi.
Kuwashauri wakurugenzi na taasisi washirika kuhusu usanifu wa huduma muhimu za afya na matunzo zinazoshirikiwa.
Kutatua migongano migumu zaidi ya usanifu kati ya programu, wasambazaji na taasisi washirika.
Kuongoza mazoezi ya usanifu wa suluhisho na kuendeleza watu wake.
qualifications: Uzoefu mpana wa kuongoza usanifu wa suluhisho katika programu au taasisi nyingi.
levels.jobEvaluationNotes: Imewekwa katika daraja la juu zaidi ya pendekezo la daraja la UK GDaD PCF (Daraja la 8c): matangazo ya sekta ya afya yanaweka nafasi hii katika Daraja la 8d. Uhuru wa kutenda ni kiwango cha 6 kwa sababu kazi inaweka viwango vya usanifu wa suluhisho vya taasisi; rasilimali za fedha na watu ni kiwango cha 4 kwa sababu inaongoza mazoezi na bajeti yake.

roles.title: Msanifu wa kiufundi
roles.summary: Wasanifu wa kiufundi husanifu muundo wa kiufundi wa huduma za afya za kidijitali za taasisi: vijenzi, majukwaa, uhifadhi, mifumo ya uunganishaji, na sifa zisizo za kiutendaji kama usalama, utendaji na ustahimilivu. Hufanya kazi kwa karibu na wasanidi na wahandisi wa DevOps, hutoa uongozi wa kiufundi kwa timu za utoaji, na kuhakikisha huduma zinajengwa kudumu na ni salama kuendesha.
healthContext: Huduma za kitabibu mara nyingi zinahitaji upatikanaji wa juu na urejeshaji wa haraka, hivyo miundo ya kiufundi lazima ipange kwa ajili ya kushindwa na kuendesha kwa kiwango kilichopungua.
Miundo lazima ilinde taarifa za siri za afya kwa usimbaji fiche, udhibiti wa ufikiaji na ukaguzi kama kawaida.
Huduma huunganishwa na mifumo mingi ya kitabibu na majukwaa yanayoshirikiwa, mara nyingi kupitia API za HL7 FHIR na ujumbe, hivyo mifumo ya uunganishaji ni kiini cha usanifu.
Uchaguzi wa usanifu wa kiufundi, kama vile uhifadhi wa muda, kujaribu tena na ushughulikiaji wa muda, unaweza kusababisha hatari za kitabibu, hivyo wasanifu huchangia hoja za usalama.
Mifumo ya zamani ya kitabibu na vifaa tiba vinaweza kuzuia uchaguzi wa teknolojia, mitandao na uhifadhi.

pcfRole.name: Technical architect
pcfRole.description: A technical architect provides technical leadership and architectural design.

levels.title: Msanifu msaidizi wa kiufundi
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
An associate technical architect supports technical architects in putting forward designs as solutions to technology challenges, usually under supervision.

At this role level, you will:
- work closely with developers when designing appropriate solutions
- have an understanding of the overall strategy and how your work supports it
responsibilities: Kuchora michoro ya kiufundi na kuandika vijenzi, uhifadhi na miunganisho ya huduma zilizopo.
Kutafiti chaguzi za teknolojia na kufupisha faida na hasara zake, kwa mwongozo.
Kufanya kazi na wasanidi kukagua kama ujenzi unafuata miundo na mifumo iliyokubaliwa.
Kurekodi maamuzi ya kiufundi na kuweka nyaraka za usanifu zikiwa za kisasa.
qualifications: Shahada katika kompyuta au somo linalohusiana, au uzoefu unaolingana katika uhandisi wa programu au miundombinu.
Maarifa maalumu ya usanifu wa kiufundi, katika kiwango cha stashahada ya uzamili au uzoefu unaolingana.
levels.jobEvaluationNotes: Imewekwa katika daraja la juu zaidi ya pendekezo la daraja la UK GDaD PCF (Daraja la 5): matangazo ya sekta ya afya yanaweka nafasi hii katika Daraja la 6. Maarifa yamepewa alama ya kiwango cha stashahada ya uzamili, na rasilimali za taarifa kiwango cha 5 kwa sababu kazi inasanifu sehemu za mifumo mikubwa ya taarifa.

levels.title: Msanifu wa kiufundi
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A technical architect is responsible for the design and build of technical architecture.

At this role level, you will:
- undertake structured analysis of technical issues, translating this analysis into technical designs that describe a solution
- be consulted about design and provide design patterns
- identify deeper issues that need fixing
- look for opportunities to collaborate and reuse components, communicating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
responsibilities: Kubuni usanifu wa kiufundi wa huduma, ikiwemo vijenzi, uhifadhi, uunganishaji na usalama.
Kutoa mifumo ya usanifu kwa timu za utoaji na kukagua miundo yao ya kiufundi na muundo wa msimbo.
Kufafanua mahitaji yasiyo ya kiutendaji, kama vile upatikanaji, utendaji na malengo ya urejeshaji, pamoja na wamiliki wa huduma.
Kutambua deni la kiufundi na teknolojia isiyoungwa mkono, na kupanga jinsi ya kuirekebisha.
Kutambua hatari za kiufundi na udhibiti kwa hoja ya usalama wa kitabibu.
qualifications: Maarifa maalumu ya usanifu wa kiufundi, katika kiwango cha shahada ya uzamili au uzoefu unaolingana.
Uzoefu wa kubuni au kujenga programu au miundombinu ya uzalishaji.
levels.jobEvaluationNotes: Imewekwa katika pendekezo la daraja la UK GDaD PCF la Daraja la 7, sambamba na matangazo ya sekta ya afya kwa nafasi hii. Maarifa yamepewa alama ya kiwango cha shahada ya uzamili au kinacholingana kwa maarifa maalumu katika wigo wa usanifu wa kiufundi.

levels.title: Msanifu mwandamizi wa kiufundi
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A senior technical architect works on large or multiple pieces of work that are complex or risky.

At this role level, you will:
- define strategy and be central to assuring services
- regularly collaborate and find agreement with senior stakeholders, providing direction and challenge
- be proactive in identifying problems and translating these into non-technical descriptions that can be widely understood
- mentor and coach junior colleagues
responsibilities: Kuongoza usanifu wa kiufundi wa huduma kubwa, tata au zenye hatari kubwa, kama vile mifumo ya kitabibu na majukwaa ya uunganishaji yanayoshirikiwa.
Kuweka mwelekeo wa kiufundi kwa timu moja au zaidi za utoaji na kupinga miundo inayoongeza hatari.
Kubuni kwa ustahimilivu, urejeshaji baada ya maafa na uendeshaji salama, na kukagua kama timu zinajaribu.
Kueleza hatari za kiufundi na maridhiano kwa wamiliki wa huduma, viongozi wa kitabibu na wadau wakuu kwa lugha rahisi.
Kuwa mshauri na kuwaongoza wasanifu wa kiufundi na wasanidi waandamizi.
qualifications: Uzoefu mkubwa wa usanifu wa kiufundi kwa huduma tata, katika kiwango kinacholingana na shahada ya uzamili.
levels.jobEvaluationNotes: Imewekwa katika daraja la juu zaidi ya pendekezo la daraja la UK GDaD PCF (Daraja la 7): matangazo ya sekta ya afya yanaweka nafasi hii katika Daraja la 8a. Mipango, sera na uhuru wa kutenda vimepewa alama za juu zaidi ya wasifu wa Daraja la 7 kwa sababu kazi inaweka mwelekeo wa kiufundi kwa timu kadhaa kwa usimamizi mdogo.

levels.title: Msanifu kiongozi wa kiufundi
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A lead technical architect works with multiple projects or teams on problems that require broad architectural thinking.

At this role level, you will:
- be responsible for leading the technical design of systems and services, justifying and communicating design decisions
- assure other services and system quality, ensuring the technical work fits into the broader strategy for government
- explore the benefits of cross-government alignment
- provide mentoring within teams
- provide leadership to other architects
responsibilities: Kuongoza usanifu wa kiufundi katika huduma au timu kadhaa, akiweka mifumo na viwango vinavyoshirikiwa.
Kuhakikisha ubora wa kiufundi wa miundo katika mamlaka za usanifu, ikiwemo usalama, ustahimilivu na ushirikiano wa mifumo.
Kuunda ramani ya njia ya teknolojia ya taasisi pamoja na wasanifu wa taasisi na viongozi wa uhandisi.
Kuwashauri viongozi wakuu kuhusu uchaguzi wa teknolojia, uwekezaji wa jukwaa na hatari za kiufundi.
Kuongoza na kuendeleza wasanifu wa kiufundi.
qualifications: Uzoefu mpana wa kuongoza usanifu wa kiufundi kwa huduma tata.

levels.title: Msanifu mkuu wa kiufundi
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A principal technical architect leads at the highest level and is responsible for making sure the strategy is agreed and followed.

At this role level, you will:
- network and communicate with senior stakeholders across organisations
- proactively seek opportunities for digital transformation
- support multiple teams, finding and using best practice and emerging technologies
- inspire other architects and help them understand how to deliver the goals of the organisation
- be responsible for governance, solving complex and high risk issues or delivering architecture design
responsibilities: Kuweka mkakati, kanuni na viwango vya usanifu wa kiufundi wa taasisi.
Kusimamia usanifu wa kiufundi katika taasisi, ikiwemo mamlaka ya usanifu wa kiufundi.
Kuishauri timu ya watendaji kuhusu maamuzi makubwa ya teknolojia, kama vile mkakati wa uhifadhi na kuunganisha majukwaa.
Kuiwakilisha taasisi katika jumuiya za kiufundi na za viwango za taasisi mbalimbali.
Kuwatia moyo na kuwaendeleza wasanifu katika taasisi.
qualifications: Uzoefu mpana wa kuongoza usanifu wa kiufundi katika timu au taasisi nyingi.

roles.title: Msanifu wa data
roles.summary: Wasanifu wa data husanifu jinsi taasisi inavyopanga, kuhifadhi, kuhamisha na kusimamia data zake za afya na matunzo, ili ziweze kutumika kwa usalama kwa matunzo ya moja kwa moja, mipango ya huduma na utafiti. Husanifu miundo ya data, majukwaa ya data na mtiririko wa data, huweka viwango vya data, na kuhakikisha maana ya kitabibu, ubora na usiri vinatunzwa kutoka mwanzo hadi mwisho.
healthContext: Data za afya lazima zitunze maana yake ya kitabibu, hivyo miundo ya data hutumia istilahi za kitabibu kama SNOMED CT na uainishaji kama ICD.

Data zinazotumika kwa matunzo ya moja kwa moja na data zinazotumika kwa mipango au utafiti zina misingi tofauti ya kisheria, hivyo wasanifu husanifu kwa ajili ya utenganishaji, kuficha utambulisho na ufikiaji unaodhibitiwa.

Data hutoka kwenye mifumo mingi ya kitabibu na ya matunzo yenye ubora tofauti, hivyo wasanifu husanifu kwa ajili ya ukaguzi wa ubora wa data, ulinganishaji wa wagonjwa na ufuatiliaji wa asili ya data.
Kumbukumbu za matunzo zinazoshirikiwa na kubadilishana data hutegemea miundo ya pamoja kama rasilimali za HL7 FHIR na seti za data zilizokubaliwa za kitaifa au za kimataifa.
Kumbukumbu lazima zihifadhiwe kwa vipindi virefu vya uhifadhi, hivyo miundo lazima ipange kwa ajili ya kuhifadhi kwenye jalada na kufikia data za kihistoria.

pcfRole.name: Data architect
pcfRole.description: A data architect sets the vision for the organisation’s use of data, through data design, to ensure that data is managed properly and meets the organisation’s needs.

levels.title: Msanifu wa data
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A data architect designs and builds data models to fulfil the strategic data needs of the organisation, as defined by chief data architects.

At this role level, you will:
- design, support and provide guidance for the upgrade, management, decommission and archive of data in compliance with data policy
- provide input into data dictionaries
- define and maintain the data technology architecture, including metadata, integration and business intelligence or data warehouse architecture
responsibilities: Kubuni miundo ya kimantiki na ya kimwili ya data kwa data za kitabibu na za kiutendaji, akitumia istilahi za kitabibu inapohitajika.
Kubuni mtiririko wa data na vijenzi vya jukwaa la data, kama vile ghala, ziwa-ghala na tabaka za uunganishaji.
Kufafanua metadata, maingizo ya kamusi ya data na asili ya data kwa seti za data za eneo lake.
Kubuni udhibiti wa kuficha utambulisho na ufikiaji ili data zitumike tu kwa kusudi lake halali.
Kufanya kazi na wenzake wa ubora wa data na uwekaji misimbo ya kitabibu kurekebisha visababishi vya kimuundo vya data duni.
Kuwaongoza wahandisi wa data na wachambuzi kuhusu miundo ya data na viwango.
qualifications: Uzoefu mkubwa wa uundaji wa miundo ya data na usanifu wa majukwaa ya data, katika kiwango kinacholingana na shahada ya uzamili.
levels.jobEvaluationNotes: Imewekwa katika daraja la juu zaidi ya pendekezo la daraja la UK GDaD PCF (Daraja la 7): matangazo ya sekta ya afya yanaweka nafasi hii katika Daraja la 8a. Mipango, sera na uhuru wa kutenda vimepewa alama za juu zaidi ya wasifu wa Daraja la 7 kwa sababu kazi inasanifu majukwaa ya data na udhibiti unaotumika katika huduma nyingi.

levels.title: Msanifu mwandamizi wa data
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A senior data architect delivers the vision for the organisation as set by the chief data architect.

At this role level, you will:
- design data models and metadata systems
- help chief data architects to interpret an organisation’s needs
- provide oversight and advice to other data architects who are designing and producing data artefacts
- design and support the management of data dictionaries
- make sure that your teams are working to the standards set for the organisation by the chief data architects
- work with technical architects to make sure that an organisation’s systems are designed in accordance with the appropriate data architecture
responsibilities: Kubuni usanifu wa data kwa eneo kuu, kama vile kumbukumbu ya matunzo inayoshirikiwa au jukwaa la uchanganuzi.
Kuhakikisha miundo ya data katika timu zote inafuata viwango na miundo ya data ya taasisi.
Kubuni jinsi data zinavyoshirikishwa na taasisi washirika, ikiwemo viwango, udhibiti na makubaliano ya ushirikishaji wa data.
Kushauri wenzake wa usimamizi wa taarifa na usalama wa kitabibu kuhusu hatari za data za miundo mipya.
Kukagua na kuongoza kazi ya wasanifu wa data.
qualifications: Uzoefu mpana wa usanifu wa data kwa taasisi tata.

levels.title: Msanifu mkuu wa data
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A chief data architect sets the vision for the organisation’s use of data as directed by the appropriate governance body.

At this role level, you will:
- oversee the design of multiple data models and have a broad understanding of how each model fulfils the needs of the organisation
- be accountable for supporting and aligning to the organisation’s data strategy
- champion data architecture both internally and through collaborating and communicating at the most senior levels across government
- set the standards and ways of working for the data architecture community
- be accountable for assuring data models at the level of a project or enterprise
- provide advice to project teams and oversee the management of the full data product life cycle
- be responsible for ensuring that the organisation’s systems are designed in accordance with the enterprise data architecture
responsibilities: Kuweka maono na ramani ya njia ya usanifu wa data ya taasisi, kulingana na mkakati wake wa data.
Kumiliki muundo wa data wa taasisi nzima, viwango vya data na kamusi ya data.
Kushauri timu ya watendaji na vyombo vya usimamizi wa data kuhusu usanifu wa data, hatari na uwekezaji.
Kuiwakilisha taasisi katika kazi ya viwango vya data na ushirikiano wa mifumo ya taasisi mbalimbali.
Kuongoza mazoezi ya usanifu wa data na kuendeleza watu wake.
qualifications: Uzoefu mpana wa kuongoza usanifu wa data katika taasisi mbalimbali.

roles.title: Msanifu wa usalama
roles.summary: Wasanifu wa usalama husanifu usalama wa huduma za afya za kidijitali za taasisi, ili taarifa za wagonjwa zibaki za siri, sahihi na zinapatikana matunzo yanapozihitaji. Huweka mifumo na udhibiti wa usalama, hutathmini hatari za usalama za miundo mipya na wasambazaji, na kuzisaidia timu kufanya maamuzi yanayotegemea hatari yanayoweka huduma salama na zinazoweza kutumika kwa madaktari na wagonjwa.
healthContext: Taasisi za afya ni walengwa wa mara kwa mara wa programu za kutaka fidia na wizi wa data, na shambulio linaweza kusimamisha huduma za kitabibu, hivyo upatikanaji ni muhimu kama usiri.
Udhibiti wa usalama haupaswi kuzuia matunzo ya dharura, hivyo miundo husawazisha uthibitishaji imara na ufikiaji wa haraka katika mazingira ya kitabibu.
Vifaa tiba vilivyounganishwa na mifumo ya zamani ya kitabibu mara nyingi haviwezi kuwekewa marekebisho haraka, hivyo wasanifu husanifu udhibiti mbadala kama ugawaji.
Wafanyakazi wengi, taasisi washirika na wasambazaji wanahitaji ufikiaji wa kumbukumbu za wagonjwa, hivyo utambulisho, ufikiaji unaotegemea nafasi na ukaguzi ni kiini.
Miundo ya usalama lazima iunge mkono wajibu wa usimamizi wa taarifa na viwango vilivyochapishwa vya usalama, kama vile ISO/IEC 27001.

pcfRole.name: Security architect
pcfRole.description: A security architect designs and builds secure solutions.

levels.title: Msanifu wa usalama
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A security architect creates and designs security for a system or service, maintains security documentation and develops architecture patterns and security approaches to new technologies.

At this role level, you will:
- recommend security controls and identify solutions that support a business objective
- provide specialist advice and recommend approaches across teams and various stakeholders
- communicate widely with other stakeholders
- advise on important security-related technologies and assess the risk associated with proposed changes
- inspire and influence others to execute security principles
- help review other people’s work
responsibilities: Kubuni udhibiti wa usalama kwa huduma na mifumo, ikiwemo utambulisho, usimbaji fiche, uandishi wa kumbukumbu na ulinzi wa mtandao.
Kutathmini usalama wa miundo mipya na bidhaa za wasambazaji, na kurekodi hatari na udhibiti unaopendekezwa.
Kuendeleza mifumo ya usalama ambayo timu za utoaji zinaweza kuitumia tena, kama vile kwa kuingia kwa wagonjwa na kuingia mara moja kwa wafanyakazi.
Kushauri kuhusu udhibiti mbadala kwa vifaa tiba na mifumo ya zamani ya kitabibu isiyoweza kusasishwa kwa urahisi.
Kufanya kazi na wenzake wa usimamizi wa taarifa na usalama wa kitabibu ili hatari za usalama, faragha na usalama wa mgonjwa zitathminiwe pamoja.
Kuwaongoza wahandisi wa usalama na wasanifu wengine katika usanifu salama.
qualifications: Uzoefu mkubwa wa usanifu wa usalama au uhandisi wa usalama, katika kiwango kinacholingana na shahada ya uzamili.
Sifa ya usalama inayotambuliwa au uzoefu unaolingana.
levels.jobEvaluationNotes: Imewekwa katika daraja la juu zaidi ya pendekezo la daraja la UK GDaD PCF (Daraja la 6): matangazo ya sekta ya afya yanaweka nafasi hii katika Daraja la 8a. Uchambuzi na uhuru wa kutenda vimepewa alama za juu zaidi ya wasifu wa Daraja la 7 kwa sababu kazi inasanifu usalama wa mifumo muhimu ya kitabibu kwa usimamizi mdogo.

levels.title: Msanifu kiongozi wa usalama
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A lead security architect undertakes complex work of a high risk level, often working on several projects.

At this role level, you will:
- interact with senior stakeholders across departments
- reach and influence a wide range of people across larger teams and communities
- research and apply innovative security architecture solutions to new or existing problems and be able to justify and communicate design decisions
- develop vision, principles and strategy for security architects for one project or technology
- work out subtle security needs
- understand the impact of decisions, balancing requirements and deciding between approaches
- produce particular patterns and support quality assurance
- be the point of escalation for architects in lower grade roles
- lead the technical design of systems and services
responsibilities: Kuongoza usanifu wa usalama kwa miradi kadhaa yenye hatari kubwa au eneo kuu, kama vile mifumo ya kitabibu au uhifadhi wa wingu.
Kuweka kanuni na viwango vya usalama kwa miundo katika eneo lake na kuvihakikisha katika mamlaka za usanifu.
Kuwashauri wamiliki wakuu wa hatari kuhusu hatari za usalama na chaguzi za kuzisimamia.
Kubuni usalama kwa data zinazoshirikishwa na taasisi washirika na wasambazaji.
Kuongoza na kuendeleza wasanifu wa usalama.
qualifications: Uzoefu mpana wa usanifu wa usalama kwa huduma tata.

levels.title: Msanifu mkuu wa usalama
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A principal security architect works on services of high complexity and risk, making decisions to enable the business to achieve its needs.

At this role level, you will:
- work on projects with high strategic impact, setting a strategy that can be used in the long term and across the breadth of the organisation
- communicate with a broad range of senior stakeholders and be responsible for defining the vision, principles and strategy for security architects
- recommend security design across several projects or technologies, up to an organisational or inter-organisational level
- have a deep and evolving level of technical expertise, so you can act as an exemplar
- make and influence important business and architectural decisions
- research, identify, validate and adopt new technologies and methodologies
- be a recognised expert and demonstrate this expertise by solving unprecedented issues and problems
- further the profession, demonstrating and sharing best practice within and outside the organisation
responsibilities: Kuweka maono, kanuni na mkakati wa usanifu wa usalama wa taasisi.
Kuishauri timu ya watendaji na bodi kuhusu hatari ya usalama wa mtandao kwa matunzo ya wagonjwa na huduma.
Kuhakikisha ustahimilivu wa mtandao, ikiwemo urejeshaji baada ya shambulio kubwa, umebuniwa ndani ya huduma muhimu za kitabibu.
Kuiwakilisha taasisi katika jumuiya za usalama wa mtandao na viwango za taasisi mbalimbali.
Kuongoza mazoezi ya usanifu wa usalama na kuendeleza watu wake.
qualifications: Uzoefu mpana wa kuongoza usanifu wa usalama katika taasisi mbalimbali.

roles.title: Msanifu wa mtandao
roles.summary: Wasanifu wa mtandao husanifu mitandao ya ndani, ya eneo pana, isiyo na waya na ya wingu inayounganisha maeneo ya taasisi, wafanyakazi, mifumo ya kitabibu na vifaa tiba. Huhakikisha mitandao ni ya haraka, thabiti na salama vya kutosha kwa matunzo yasiyokoma, na hupanga jinsi mitandao inavyobadilika huduma zinapohamia kwenye wingu na kuunganishwa na taasisi washirika.
healthContext: Mifumo ya kitabibu, simu na vifaa tiba hutegemea mtandao, hivyo kukatika kunaweza kusimamisha matunzo; miundo inahitaji ustahimilivu na kuhamia mfumo mbadala kulikojaribiwa.
Mitandao mara nyingi hubeba vifaa tiba vilivyounganishwa ambavyo ni vigumu kuviwekea marekebisho, hivyo wasanifu husanifu ugawaji na ufuatiliaji kuvilinda.
Wafanyakazi hufanya kazi hospitalini, kliniki, mazingira ya jamii na nyumbani kwa wagonjwa, hivyo miundo lazima iunge mkono ufikiaji salama wa simu na wa mbali.
Mitandao huunganishwa na mitandao ya afya na matunzo inayoshirikiwa na taasisi washirika, ambazo huweka mahitaji yao ya muunganisho na usalama.
Mabadiliko katika maeneo ya kitabibu yanahitaji mipango makini kuzunguka matunzo ya wagonjwa, kwa mfano kupanga kazi nje ya vipindi vyenye shughuli nyingi.

pcfRole.name: Network architect
pcfRole.description: A network architect is responsible for network designs and specifications, including cloud networks.

levels.title: Msanifu msaidizi wa mtandao
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
An associate network architect works with network architects on designs and specifications, with guidance.

At this role level, you will:
- be aware and knowledgeable of new technology solutions and produce network design policy
- draft recommendations for network support, creating and maintaining network plans and planning infrastructure runs
- ensure designs meet SLAs (service level agreements) and develop an understanding of common tools
- have an understanding of one or two of the following network technologies: LAN (local area network), WAN (wide area network), wifi, data centre LAN, SD (software-defined) networks, telephony, mobile solutions infrastructure, unified comms, network management solutions, network specific security and remote access technologies and approaches
- collaborate with engineers to ensure systems are practically designed
responsibilities: Kuandaa rasimu za miundo ya mtandao, michoro na vipimo kwa mwongozo wa wasanifu wa mtandao.
Kukagua maeneo na kukusanya mahitaji ya maeneo ya kitabibu, ikiwemo wigo wa mtandao usio na waya na miunganisho ya vifaa.
Kuweka rekodi za muundo wa mtandao, anwani na vifaa vilivyounganishwa zikiwa za kisasa.
Kukagua kama miundo inatimiza viwango vya huduma na usalama kabla ya ukaguzi.
qualifications: Shahada katika kompyuta au mitandao, sifa inayotambuliwa ya mitandao, au uzoefu unaolingana.
Maarifa maalumu ya usanifu wa mtandao, katika kiwango cha stashahada ya uzamili au uzoefu unaolingana.
levels.jobEvaluationNotes: Imewekwa katika daraja la juu zaidi ya pendekezo la daraja la UK GDaD PCF (Daraja la 5): matangazo ya sekta ya afya yanaweka nafasi hii katika Daraja la 6. Maarifa yamepewa alama ya kiwango cha stashahada ya uzamili, na rasilimali za taarifa kiwango cha 5 kwa sababu kazi inasanifu sehemu za mtandao ambazo mifumo mikubwa ya taarifa inazitegemea.

levels.title: Msanifu wa mtandao
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A network architect has responsibility for network designs and specifications to support business strategies using common tools.

At this role level, you will:
- research new technologies and solutions, and ensure appropriate levels of assurance
- plan, direct and co-ordinate activities, engaging with other stakeholders to manage and implement a programme
- agree SLAs (service level agreements) and engage with third party vendors
- have an understanding of most of the following network technologies: LAN (local area network), WAN (wide area network), wifi, data-centre LAN, SD (software-defined) networks, telephony, mobile solutions infrastructure, unified comms, network management solutions, network-specific security and remote access technologies and approaches
- coach and mentor associate network architects where appropriate
- collaborate with engineers to ensure systems are practically designed
responsibilities: Kubuni suluhisho za mtandao wa ndani, wa eneo pana, usio na waya na wa wingu kwa maeneo na huduma.
Kubuni ugawaji wa mtandao kwa vifaa tiba, mifumo ya kitabibu na ufikiaji wa wageni.
Kupanga mabadiliko ya mtandao katika maeneo ya kitabibu pamoja na viongozi wa huduma ili matunzo yasivurugike.
Kukubaliana viwango vya huduma na wasambazaji na mahitaji ya muunganisho na mitandao ya washirika.
Kutathmini teknolojia mpya za mtandao na kufaa kwake na viwango vya usalama vya taasisi.
qualifications: Maarifa maalumu ya usanifu wa mtandao, katika kiwango cha shahada ya uzamili au uzoefu unaolingana.
Uzoefu wa kubuni na kusaidia mitandao ya taasisi.
levels.jobEvaluationNotes: Imewekwa katika daraja la juu zaidi ya pendekezo la daraja la UK GDaD PCF (Daraja la 6): matangazo ya sekta ya afya yanaweka nafasi hii katika Daraja la 7. Maarifa yamepewa alama ya kiwango cha shahada ya uzamili au kinacholingana kwa maarifa maalumu katika mitandao ya ndani, ya eneo pana, isiyo na waya na ya wingu.

levels.title: Msanifu kiongozi wa mtandao
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A lead network architect is accountable for designs and networks representing their business area.

At this role level, you will:
- be a point of escalation
- actively input into governance forums that determine IT strategy
- cascade messages, standards and best practice from other architecture teams and design authorities to the network architecture team
- act as a subject matter expert for network architects
- represent network architects internally and externally
- have an understanding of all network technology including LAN (local area network), WAN (wide area network), wifi, data centre LAN, SD (software-defined) networks, telephony, mobile solutions infrastructure, unified comms, network management solutions, and network specific security and remote access technologies and approaches
- champion new technologies and solutions
- coach and mentor network architects and associate network architects
- be a strategic thinker who can communicate network concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders
responsibilities: Kumiliki usanifu wa mtandao wa taasisi, ikiwemo maeneo yake, vituo vya data na miunganisho ya wingu.
Kuweka viwango vya usanifu wa mtandao na kuhakikisha miundo katika mamlaka ya usanifu.
Kubuni ustahimilivu na urejeshaji wa mtandao kwa huduma muhimu za kitabibu, na kuhakikisha unajaribiwa.
Kushauri kuhusu uwekezaji wa mtandao, mikataba ya wasambazaji na hatari za mtandao za huduma mpya.
Kuwa kituo cha kitaalamu cha kupeleka masuala juu na kuwaongoza wasanifu na wahandisi wengine wa mtandao.
qualifications: Uzoefu mkubwa wa usanifu wa mtandao kwa taasisi tata, katika kiwango kinacholingana na shahada ya uzamili.
levels.jobEvaluationNotes: Imewekwa katika daraja la juu zaidi ya pendekezo la daraja la UK GDaD PCF (Daraja la 7): matangazo ya sekta ya afya yanaweka nafasi hii katika Daraja la 8a. Rasilimali za taarifa ni kiwango cha 6 kwa sababu kazi inamiliki usanifu wa mtandao ambao mifumo yote ya taarifa ya taasisi inautegemea.

roles.title: Msanifu wa biashara
roles.summary: Wasanifu wa biashara hujenga mtazamo ulio wazi na ulioungana wa jinsi taasisi inavyotoa huduma za afya na matunzo, yaani uwezo wake, huduma, njia za matunzo, michakato na taarifa. Hutumia mtazamo huo kuonyesha mahali mabadiliko yanapohitajika, kuunganisha mkakati na programu, na kuhakikisha mabadiliko ya kidijitali yanaboresha matunzo kwa wagonjwa na maisha ya kazi ya madaktari na wafanyakazi wa matunzo.
healthContext: Njia za matunzo huvuka timu, mazingira na taasisi, hivyo wasanifu wa biashara huunda miundo ya huduma kutoka mtazamo wa mgonjwa, si kwa idara tu.

Mabadiliko katika michakato ya kitabibu yanaweza kuathiri usalama wa mgonjwa na mzigo wa kazi wa wafanyakazi, hivyo miundo hujengwa pamoja na madaktari na wafanyakazi wa matunzo na kukaguliwa dhidi ya mazoezi halisi.
Mkakati wa afya na matunzo huundwa na sera, udhibiti na kanuni za ufadhili, ambazo wasanifu lazima wazigeuze kuwa mabadiliko ya vitendo ya uwezo.
Uwezo mwingi hushirikiwa na taasisi washirika, hivyo wasanifu husaidia kukubaliana nani anafanya nini na mahali ambapo taarifa lazima zitiririke.

pcfRole.name: Business architect
pcfRole.description:
A business architect develops an integrated view of an enterprise, such as a business area or organisation. They use this view to help their organisation put its strategy in place.

In this role, you will:
- understand and apply business architectural principles, techniques, and tools to business challenges
- ensure design work from projects and programmes aligns with strategy
- ensure business change is implemented effectively to meet strategy
- aggregate and disaggregate complex information from across your organisation
- communicate complex information about the organisation to stakeholders

levels.title: Msanifu wa biashara mwanafunzi
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A trainee business architect supports the more senior business architect roles. They also receive training on the tasks they support so they can work on their own.

At this role level, you will:
- develop your knowledge of the frameworks, practice, and principles of business architecture
- work with other business architects to support the production of clear business architecture outputs
- support during workshops and meetings with stakeholders in the organisation
responsibilities: Kujifunza mbinu za usanifu wa biashara, kama vile uundaji wa miundo ya uwezo, mnyororo wa thamani na michakato, kupitia mafunzo na mazoezi.
Kukusanya taarifa kuhusu huduma na njia za matunzo kupitia mahojiano, nyaraka na uchunguzi.
Kuandaa rasimu za ramani za uwezo na miundo ya michakato kwa mwongozo wa wasanifu wa biashara.
Kusaidia kuendesha warsha na madaktari, wafanyakazi wa matunzo na mameneja, na kuandika matokeo.
qualifications: Shahada au uzoefu unaolingana katika biashara, uchambuzi, au somo linalohusiana.
Mafunzo maalumu ya mbinu za usanifu wa biashara, katika kiwango cha stashahada ya uzamili au uzoefu unaolingana.
levels.jobEvaluationNotes: Imewekwa katika daraja la juu zaidi ya pendekezo la daraja la UK GDaD PCF (Daraja la 5): matangazo ya sekta ya afya yanaweka nafasi hii katika Daraja la 6. Maarifa yamepewa alama ya kiwango ambacho kazi inahitaji mara mafunzo yanapokuwa yamekamilika vya kutosha kufanya kazi.

levels.title: Msanifu msaidizi wa biashara
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
An associate business architect uses their knowledge and experience to address business scenarios. They continue to get support and training for their role.

At this role level, you will:
- apply architectural methods following direction and wider strategy to produce outputs
- break down complexity and produce clear outputs
- explain complex business problems using clear language and artefacts
- bring together disconnected information to inform decision making
- recognise issues that cut across different areas of the organisation and present opportunities for improvement
responsibilities: Kuunda miundo ya uwezo, huduma na njia za matunzo kwa sehemu ya taasisi.
Kuchambua miundo kupata mapengo, urudufu na kero kwa wagonjwa na wafanyakazi.
Kuleta pamoja taarifa kutoka timu na taasisi tofauti ili kuongoza maamuzi ya mabadiliko.
Kueleza matatizo tata ya huduma kwa wadau kwa kutumia miundo iliyo wazi na lugha rahisi.
Kuweka hazina ya usanifu wa biashara ikiwa sahihi na iliyounganishwa na miundo ya programu na data.
qualifications: Maarifa maalumu ya usanifu wa biashara au uchambuzi wa biashara, katika kiwango cha shahada ya uzamili au uzoefu unaolingana.
Uzoefu wa uchambuzi wa biashara au usanifu wa huduma.
levels.jobEvaluationNotes: Imewekwa katika daraja la juu zaidi ya pendekezo la daraja la UK GDaD PCF (Daraja la 6): matangazo ya sekta ya afya yanaweka nafasi hii katika Daraja la 7. Maarifa yamepewa alama ya kiwango cha shahada ya uzamili au kinacholingana, kwa sababu kazi inaunda miundo na kuchambua huduma na njia za matunzo katika timu na taasisi.

levels.title: Msanifu wa biashara
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A business architect uses their knowledge and experience to understand business scenarios, communicate the issues and recommend next steps. They support and guide other business architects.

At this role level, you will:
- support executive level work and management of the business architecture practice
- guide others in using appropriate business architectural tools and methods
- understand and apply business architectural principles, techniques, and tools to business scenarios
- create business architecture artefacts, including abstract representations of the organisation, knowing when to apply them
- develop standard and scalable models to collect, aggregate, or disaggregate complex information
responsibilities: Kuendeleza usanifu wa sasa na lengwa wa biashara kwa eneo kubwa la huduma, kama vile huduma za dharura au huduma za jamii.
Kugeuza mkakati na sera kuwa mabadiliko ya uwezo na ramani ya mabadiliko.
Kukagua kama wigo wa programu na mradi unalingana na usanifu lengwa wa biashara.
Kufanya kazi na viongozi wa kitabibu kutathmini jinsi mabadiliko yanayopendekezwa yanavyoathiri njia za matunzo, usalama na mzigo wa kazi wa wafanyakazi.
Kuwaongoza wasanifu wengine wa biashara katika mbinu na zana.
qualifications: Uzoefu mkubwa wa usanifu wa biashara, uchambuzi wa biashara, au usanifu wa huduma, katika kiwango kinacholingana na shahada ya uzamili.
levels.jobEvaluationNotes: Imewekwa katika daraja la juu zaidi ya pendekezo la daraja la UK GDaD PCF (Daraja la 7): matangazo ya sekta ya afya yanaweka nafasi hii katika Daraja la 8a. Mipango, sera na uhuru wa kutenda vimepewa alama za juu zaidi ya wasifu wa Daraja la 7 kwa sababu kazi inageuza mkakati kuwa ramani ya mabadiliko kwa eneo kubwa la huduma.

levels.title: Msanifu kiongozi wa biashara
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A lead business architect uses their expert knowledge and experience to direct the work addressing high level and complex business scenarios. They support and lead other business architects.

At this role level, you will:
- be accountable for outputs produced by the business architecture team
- lead and direct the application of architectural principles, methods, and tools to business scenarios
- use architectural methods to form a view of the whole enterprise in a way that is easily understood by stakeholders
- work with stakeholders at executive levels
- provide overall direction, guidance, and definition of business architecture to support strategy
- develop and maintain a strong business architecture capability through coaching, mentoring, and training
responsibilities: Kuongoza mazoezi ya usanifu wa biashara na kuwajibika kwa matokeo yake.
Kutunza mtazamo wa taasisi nzima wa uwezo, huduma na njia za matunzo, na kuufanya uwe rahisi kueleweka.
Kuwashauri wakurugenzi kuhusu vipaumbele vya mabadiliko na jinsi majalada ya uwekezaji yanavyolingana na mkakati.
Kufanya kazi na taasisi washirika kukubaliana uwezo na majukumu ya pamoja katika njia za matunzo.
Kuongoza na kuendeleza wasanifu wa biashara.
qualifications: Uzoefu mpana wa kuongoza usanifu wa biashara katika taasisi tata.

roles.title: Mchambuzi wa data
roles.summary: Wachambuzi wa data hugeuza data za afya na matunzo kuwa taarifa zinazosaidia madaktari, mameneja na wapangaji kufanya maamuzi. Huandaa, huunganisha na kuchambua data kutoka vyanzo vya kitabibu, vya kiutendaji na vilivyoripotiwa na wagonjwa, na kuziwasilisha katika ripoti, dashibodi na maelezo mafupi. Huhakikisha uchambuzi wao ni sahihi, unaoweza kurudiwa, na unashughulikia data za siri za wagonjwa kwa usalama.
healthContext: Data nyingi huelezea wagonjwa mmoja mmoja, hivyo wachambuzi hufanya kazi na data zenye majina bandia inapowezekana na hukagua matokeo kwa hatari ya ufichuzi kabla ya kuyatoa.
Data za afya hurekodiwa kwa istilahi na uainishaji wa kitabibu kama SNOMED CT na ICD, hivyo wachambuzi wanahitaji kujua jinsi misimbo inavyotumika na mahali inapoweza kupotosha.

Ubora wa data hutofautiana kati ya mazingira ya matunzo na mifumo, na mapengo mara nyingi huathiri baadhi ya makundi ya wagonjwa zaidi ya mengine, hivyo wachambuzi hukagua upendeleo kabla ya kufikia hitimisho.
Uchambuzi unaweza kubadilisha jinsi huduma zinavyopangwa, kufadhiliwa na kutolewa, hivyo matokeo yanahitaji tahadhari wazi na hayapaswi kukuza uhakika kupita kiasi.

pcfRole.name: Data analyst
pcfRole.description:
A data analyst collects, manages, explores and shares data to support organisational objectives and deliver business impact.

In this role, you will:
- identify, collect and move data between a range of systems
- apply data analysis and data visualisation tools and techniques
- prepare, manage and model data, following appropriate standards and practices
- communicate data, insights and conclusions in appropriate formats

levels.title: Mchambuzi msaidizi wa data
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
An associate data analyst supports data analysis activities and projects. They develop their skills in data analysis by working closely with other data professionals.

At this role level, you will:
- support the development and delivery of data analysis and data projects
- develop analytical approaches and data visualisations, under supervision
- work with others to understand roles within a multi-disciplinary team and how data analysts work with them
responsibilities: Kutoa ripoti na dashibodi za kawaida kuhusu shughuli, muda wa kusubiri na matumizi ya huduma, akifuata mbinu zilizokubaliwa.
Kusafisha na kuandaa dondoo kutoka kwenye mifumo ya utawala wa wagonjwa, ya kitabibu na ya kiutendaji chini ya usimamizi.
Kukagua matokeo dhidi ya kanuni za ubora wa data na kuripoti matatizo kwa mmiliki sahihi wa data.
Kutumia ukandamizaji wa nambari ndogo na kanuni nyingine za ufichuzi kabla ya kushirikisha matokeo.
Kujibu maombi rahisi ya data kutoka kwa timu za kitabibu na za kiutendaji.
qualifications: Shahada katika somo linalotumia namba, uanagenzi wa uchanganuzi, au uzoefu unaolingana.

levels.title: Mchambuzi wa data
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A data analyst contributes to the planning, analysis and implementation of data. They work to appropriate standards and ensure data is used to achieve the team's goals.

At this role level, you will:
- prepare and manage data
- apply appropriate techniques, tools and processes to effectively analyse data
- communicate data to stakeholders with different needs
responsibilities: Kubuni na kufanya uchambuzi unaojibu maswali kutoka kwa timu za kitabibu, za kiutendaji na za mipango.
Kuunganisha data za kiwango cha mgonjwa kutoka vyanzo tofauti kwa usalama, kwa kutumia vitambulisho vyenye majina bandia na mbinu za uunganishaji zilizokubaliwa.
Kuandika msimbo wa uchambuzi unaoweza kurudiwa na kuandika mbinu, dhana na vyanzo vya data.
Kueleza matokeo na mipaka yake kwa madaktari na mameneja kwa lugha rahisi.
Kukagua uchambuzi kwa upendeleo katika makundi ya wagonjwa, kama vile kwa umri, jinsia, kabila na umaskini.
Kuwasaidia wachambuzi wasaidizi na kukagua kazi zao.
qualifications: Shahada katika somo linalotumia namba, au uzoefu unaolingana.
Uzoefu wa kuchambua na kuwasilisha data tata.

levels.title: Mchambuzi mwandamizi wa data
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A senior data analyst leads data analysis in a team or across an area. They ensure data is appropriately prepared, managed and used, and that data analysis outcomes align with the organisation's goals.

At this role level, you will:
- guide others in appropriate practices for preparing, managing and using data
- lead the application and improvement of processes and ways of working with data
- lead communication of data and data projects with stakeholders, adapting to their needs and requirements
responsibilities: Kuongoza uchambuzi kwa eneo la huduma, kama vile huduma za dharura, saratani au afya ya akili, akikubaliana vipaumbele na viongozi wake.
Kuweka mbinu na uhakikisho wa ubora kwa uchambuzi wa timu, ikiwemo ukaguzi wa wenzake wa msimbo na matokeo.
Kuongoza miradi tata ya uunganishaji katika mazingira ya matunzo na kukubaliana msingi wake wa usimamizi wa taarifa.
Kuwasilisha matokeo kwa vikundi vya waandamizi wa kitabibu na vya usimamizi na kushauri maana yake kwa huduma.
Kufanya kazi na wahandisi wa data na wamiliki wa data kurekebisha visababishi vya ubora duni wa data.
Kuwaongoza na kuwaendeleza wachambuzi katika timu.
qualifications: Uzoefu mkubwa wa kuongoza uchambuzi wa data, katika kiwango kinacholingana na shahada ya uzamili.

levels.title: Mchambuzi mkuu wa data
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A principal data analyst leads teams or significant areas of work in data analysis. They determine and implement appropriate standards, processes and structures to ensure data is prepared, managed and used effectively within the organisation.

At this role level, you will:
- influence organisational decision making on data analysis and the use of data
- oversee continuous improvement of the organisation's data practices and management
- represent the data analyst community inside and outside of the organisation
responsibilities: Kuweka viwango vya taasisi vya uchambuzi wa data, uhakikisho wa ubora na mazoezi ya uchambuzi yanayoweza kurudiwa.
Kuwashauri viongozi watendaji na wa kitabibu kuhusu ushahidi ulio nyuma ya maamuzi makubwa kuhusu huduma na uwekezaji.
Kuongoza jumuiya ya uchambuzi, ikiwemo mafunzo, zana na maendeleo ya taaluma.
Kuunda mipango ya ushirikishaji na uunganishaji wa data na washirika wa afya na matunzo.
Kusimamia moja kwa moja wachambuzi waandamizi na kuhakikisha timu ina uwezo na ujuzi inaohitaji.
qualifications: Uzoefu mpana wa kuongoza uchambuzi wa data katika taasisi.

roles.title: Mchambuzi wa utendaji
roles.summary: Wachambuzi wa utendaji hupima jinsi huduma za afya za kidijitali za taasisi zinavyofanya kazi kwa wagonjwa, watumiaji wa huduma, madaktari na wafanyakazi wa matunzo. Huanzisha mifumo ya kupima, hukusanya na kuchambua data za matumizi na matokeo, na kuzisaidia timu za bidhaa na viongozi wa huduma kuelewa kama mabadiliko yanaboresha ufikiaji, uzoefu, usalama na ufanisi.
healthContext: Vipimo vya mafanikio huenda zaidi ya kupitishwa kidijitali, na kujumuisha athari kwa matunzo, kama vile miadi iliyokosekana, muda wa kusubiri, upangaji salama wa vipaumbele vya wagonjwa na muda wa wafanyakazi uliookolewa.
Uchanganuzi na ufuatiliaji kwenye huduma za afya unaweza kufichua taarifa nyeti, kama vile ugonjwa ambao mtu alitafuta, hivyo upimaji lazima uheshimu ridhaa, kanuni za vidakuzi na usiri.
Huduma za kidijitali hazipaswi kupanua ukosefu wa usawa wa afya, hivyo wachambuzi huangalia kupitishwa na matokeo kwa makundi yenye uwezekano mdogo wa kutumia huduma za kidijitali.
Data za utendaji zinaweza kuripotiwa kwa bodi, waagizaji wa huduma na wadhibiti, hivyo fasili lazima ziwe thabiti na zimeandikwa vizuri.

pcfRole.name: Performance analyst
pcfRole.description: A performance analyst conducts analysis. In this role, you will develop performance measurement frameworks - Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), goals, user needs and benefits - and analyse the performance of a service or product against these, adapting your approach and framework appropriately and in line with any changes.

levels.title: Mchambuzi msaidizi wa utendaji
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
An associate performance analyst is an entry-level role requiring numeracy and some experience in analysis or data handling.

At this role level, you will:
- have the aptitude to learn to use analytical tools and produce standardised reports and charts
- start by working on projects with limited scope under the guidance of performance analysts and more senior role levels, replicating existing analysis and data techniques
- progress to greater independence (where appropriate)
- have the opportunity to develop an understanding of the wider analytics context, tools and techniques
- be responsible for the accuracy and quality of data and analysis, and how they are used
- engage with the performance analysis community
responsibilities: Kutoa ripoti za mara kwa mara kuhusu jinsi wagonjwa na wafanyakazi wanavyotumia huduma za kidijitali, kama vile usajili, kukamilisha na mahali watu wanapoacha.
Kukagua data za uchanganuzi na ufuatiliaji kwa mapengo na makosa, na kuyaripoti kwa timu.
Kufuata kanuni za taasisi kuhusu ridhaa na usiri wakati wa kukusanya na kushirikisha data za matumizi.
Kuzisaidia timu za bidhaa kujibu maswali rahisi kuhusu matumizi ya huduma.
qualifications: Ujuzi mzuri wa kuhesabu na uzoefu fulani wa kushughulikia au kuchambua data, au unaolingana.

levels.title: Mchambuzi wa utendaji
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A performance analyst has a strong understanding of a wide range of sources and analytical tools needed for the project they are working on.

At this role level, you will:
- be responsible for the performance analysis in your given area
- help the project team measure and assess outcomes (for example, what good looks like and how it will be measured)
- help to plan and ensure project delivery
- find opportunities to share information with the project team, community colleagues and others
- work independently, but know to seek guidance when necessary
- be adaptable in applying analysis techniques to new contexts, especially when acting as the sole representative for performance analysts on a project
- create a performance measurement framework for a project with the wider team, including identifying reporting requirements, advising on procurement, implementation and validation of tools to deliver against these requirements
- be responsible for the accuracy and quality of data and analysis, and how they are used
- be engaged with, and actively contribute to, the performance analysis community
responsibilities: Kukubaliana na timu za bidhaa na viongozi wa kitabibu mafanikio yanamaanisha nini kwa huduma, ikiwemo athari kwa matunzo na wafanyakazi.
Kuanzisha na kuthibitisha uchanganuzi, ili ufuatiliaji uwe sahihi, sawia na unaoheshimu ridhaa.
Kuchanganya uchanganuzi wa kidijitali na data za kiutendaji, kama vile miadi na rufaa, kuonyesha athari za mabadiliko.
Kuchambua kupitishwa na matokeo kwa makundi tofauti ya wagonjwa na kuangazia hatari za kutengwa kidijitali.
Kuwasilisha matokeo kwa timu za bidhaa na viongozi wa huduma na kupendekeza maboresho.
qualifications: Shahada katika somo linalotumia namba, au uzoefu unaolingana.
Uzoefu wa kupima utendaji wa huduma za kidijitali.

levels.title: Mchambuzi mwandamizi wa utendaji
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A senior performance analyst looks to delegate, automate or upskill others in analysis where possible and appropriate, provide leadership within their team and proactively use analysis to improve services.

At this role level, you will:
- potentially manage one or more performance analysts
- be proficient in a wide range of tools
- ensure the team is equipped with the required skills according to the strategy set out by the head of performance analysis
- be skilled and experienced at carrying out the day-to-day activities of a performance analyst, including setting up performance measurement frameworks
- carry out increasingly complex analysis, working with other teams where necessary
- actively contribute to the performance analysis community within your department or organisation, while forging links with other analytical disciplines
As a 'technical specialist senior performance analyst', you would look to develop tools and techniques to aid others in analysis. You would be responsible for the accuracy and quality of data and analysis, and for how data and analysis are used.
responsibilities: Kuongoza upimaji wa utendaji kwa kundi la huduma au programu kuu, kama vile wagonjwa wa nje wa kidijitali au upangaji wa vipaumbele mtandaoni.
Kubuni vipimo vya manufaa pamoja na viongozi wa kitabibu, wa fedha na wa kiutendaji, na kuvifuatilia katika utoaji.
Kuchagua na kusanidi zana za uchanganuzi zinazotimiza mahitaji ya usimamizi wa taarifa na usalama.
Kuwasilisha ushahidi wa utendaji kwa bodi za programu na viongozi wakuu.
Kuwaongoza wachambuzi na anaweza kusimamia moja kwa moja mchambuzi mmoja au zaidi wa utendaji.
qualifications: Uzoefu mkubwa wa uchambuzi wa utendaji wa huduma za kidijitali, katika kiwango kinacholingana na shahada ya uzamili.

levels.title: Mchambuzi kiongozi wa utendaji
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A lead performance analyst manages junior performance analysts at any level, co-ordinating teams or groups of related analysts.

At this role level, you will:
- assist, take forward and influence the strategy as determined by the head of performance analysis, including data implementation and data architecture
- remove blockers and act as an escalation point for important issues
- be an ambassador for analytics across communities, departments and government
- be responsible for the accuracy and quality of data and analysis, and of how data and analysis are used
- proactively share knowledge and promote a data-driven culture, as a leader in the community
- coach and mentor senior performance analysts, performance analysts and associate performance analysts
responsibilities: Kuongoza timu ya wachambuzi wa utendaji katika jalada la huduma za afya za kidijitali.
Kukubaliana fasili thabiti za vipimo muhimu vya utendaji, ili ripoti kwa bodi na washirika ziweze kulinganishwa kadiri muda unavyopita.
Kuhakikisha data za uchanganuzi ni sahihi, zinatumika ipasavyo, na zinashughulikiwa kulingana na kanuni za usimamizi wa taarifa.
Kutumia ushahidi wa utendaji kushawishi vipaumbele na uwekezaji wa jalada.
Kuwaongoza na kuwa mshauri wa wachambuzi katika ngazi zote.
qualifications: Uzoefu mpana wa uchambuzi wa utendaji na wa kuongoza wachambuzi.

levels.title: Mkuu wa uchambuzi wa utendaji
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
The head of performance analysis leads the performance analysis community, acting as the point of contact between the community and the business.

At this role level, you will:
- remove blockers and act as an escalation point for important issues
- set the performance analysis strategy with input from lead and senior performance analysts
- be responsible for defining a framework for quality assurance within performance analysis
- champion performance analysis and performance analysts, working with colleagues across government and other Government Digital and Data communities and analytical professions
- manage the organisation’s performance analysis capability through business planning, development and recruitment
responsibilities: Kuweka mkakati wa kupima utendaji na manufaa ya huduma za kidijitali za taasisi.
Kufafanua mfumo wa uhakikisho wa ubora wa uchambuzi wa utendaji na kuripoti utendaji.
Kuwashauri viongozi watendaji ushahidi wa utendaji unaonyesha nini kuhusu huduma za kidijitali na matokeo ya wagonjwa.
Kufanya kazi na taaluma nyingine za uchambuzi, kama vile uchambuzi wa data na sayansi ya data, kushirikisha mbinu na data.
Kupanga uwezo wa jumuiya ya uchambuzi wa utendaji, ikiwemo uajiri na maendeleo.
qualifications: Uzoefu mpana wa kuongoza uchambuzi wa utendaji katika taasisi.

roles.title: Mhandisi wa data
roles.summary: Wahandisi wa data hujenga na kuendesha mifereji na majukwaa yanayohamisha data za afya na matunzo kutoka kwenye mifumo ya kitabibu na ya kiutendaji hadi mahali ambapo zinaweza kuchambuliwa na kutumika kwa usalama. Husanifu mtiririko wa data, huunganisha vyanzo vinavyotumia viwango tofauti, na kuhakikisha data ni sahihi, za wakati, salama, na zinapatikana tu kwa watu wanaostahili kuziona.
healthContext: Mifumo chanzo hujumuisha rekodi za wagonjwa za kielektroniki, na mifumo ya maabara, picha za kitabibu na famasia, inayotumia viwango kama HL7 toleo la 2, HL7 FHIR, SNOMED CT na ICD.
Mifereji mara nyingi hubeba data zinazotambulisha wagonjwa, hivyo wahandisi hujenga ndani ufichaji wa utambulisho kwa majina bandia, udhibiti wa ufikiaji na ukaguzi tangu mwanzo.

Baadhi ya mitiririko ya data inaunga mkono matunzo ya moja kwa moja, kama vile tahadhari au orodha za wagonjwa, hivyo mfereji uliofeli au uliochelewa unaweza kuathiri wagonjwa na unahitaji tathmini ya usalama wa kitabibu.
Data mara nyingi zinahitaji kuunganishwa katika mazingira ya matunzo, jambo linalotegemea ulinganishaji wa wagonjwa unaoaminika na vitambulisho thabiti.

pcfRole.name: Data engineer
pcfRole.description: A data engineer develops and constructs data products and services, and integrates them into systems and business processes.

levels.title: Mhandisi wa data
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A data engineer delivers the designs set by more senior members of the data engineering community.

At this role level, you will:
- implement data flows to connect operational systems, data for analytics and business intelligence (BI) systems
- document source-to-target mappings
- re-engineer manual data flows to enable scaling and repeatable use
- support the build of data streaming systems
- write ETL (extract, transform, load) scripts and code to ensure the ETL process performs optimally
- develop business intelligence reports that can be reused
- build accessible data for analysis
responsibilities: Kujenga na kutunza mifereji ya data kutoka mifumo ya kitabibu na ya kiutendaji hadi jukwaa la data, akifuata miundo iliyokubaliwa.
Kuchora ramani ya data chanzo, ikiwemo data za kitabibu zenye misimbo, kwenda miundo lengwa na kuandika ramani hizo.
Kujenga ufichaji wa utambulisho kwa majina bandia, uthibitishaji na ukaguzi wa ubora wa data ndani ya mifereji.
Kufuatilia mifereji na kurekebisha hitilafu, akipa kipaumbele mitiririko inayounga mkono matunzo ya moja kwa moja.
Kutumia udhibiti wa ufikiaji na uandishi wa kumbukumbu za ukaguzi unaotimiza kanuni za usimamizi wa taarifa.
qualifications: Shahada katika kompyuta au somo linalohusiana, au uzoefu unaolingana.
Uzoefu wa kujenga mifereji ya data.

levels.title: Mhandisi mwandamizi wa data
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A senior data engineer designs and leads the implementation of data flows to connect operational systems, data for analytics and business intelligence (BI) systems.

At this role level, you will:
- recognise opportunities to reuse existing data flows
- lead the build of data streaming systems
- optimise the code to ensure processes perform optimally
- lead work on database management
responsibilities: Kubuni mtiririko wa data na huduma za mtiririko wa moja kwa moja zinazoleta pamoja data kutoka mifumo mingi ya afya na matunzo.
Kubuni michakato ya ulinganishaji na uunganishaji wa wagonjwa, na kupima jinsi inavyofanya kazi vizuri.
Kuongoza kazi ya utendaji wa hifadhidata na jukwaa ili data zipatikane huduma zinapozihitaji.
Kutathmini hatari za usalama wa kitabibu na usimamizi wa taarifa za mtiririko wa data pamoja na wataalamu husika.
Kukagua kazi ya wahandisi wengine na kuwaongoza.
qualifications: Uzoefu mkubwa wa kubuni na kujenga mifumo ya data, katika kiwango kinacholingana na shahada ya uzamili.

levels.title: Mhandisi kiongozi wa data
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A lead data engineer is responsible for the design and implementation of numerous complex data flows to connect operational systems, data for analytics and business intelligence (BI) systems.

At this role level, you will:
- recognise and share opportunities to reuse existing data flows between teams
- be responsible for the build of data-streaming systems
- co-ordinate teams and set best practice and standards
- apply knowledge of systems integration to your work
- champion data engineering across government
responsibilities: Kuongoza usanifu na uendeshaji wa jukwaa la data la taasisi na mtiririko wake mwingi wa data.
Kuweka viwango vya uhandisi kwa mifereji, majaribio, usalama na uandishi wa nyaraka.
Kupanga uunganishaji wa data na washirika wa afya na matunzo, ikiwemo kumbukumbu za matunzo zinazoshirikiwa na huduma za data za kikanda.
Kuhakikisha mtiririko wa data unaounga mkono matunzo ya moja kwa moja ni thabiti na una hoja za usalama wa kitabibu.
Kuratibu timu za uhandisi wa data na kusimamia moja kwa moja wahandisi.
qualifications: Uzoefu mpana wa kuongoza uhandisi wa data kwa mifumo tata.

levels.title: Mkuu wa uhandisi wa data
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A head of data engineering leads multi-functional delivery teams to deliver robust data services for their department, other government departments and private sector partners.

At this role level, you will:
- inspire best practice for data products and services within your teams
- build data engineering capability by providing technical leadership and career development for the community
- work with other senior team members to identify, plan, develop and deliver data services
responsibilities: Kuweka mkakati wa majukwaa ya data na huduma za uhandisi wa data za taasisi.
Kuongoza timu za fani mbalimbali zinazotoa huduma za data kwa timu za ndani na washirika wa afya na matunzo.
Kuwashauri viongozi wakuu kuhusu hatari, gharama na uwekezaji wa jukwaa la data.
Kuhakikisha huduma za data zinatimiza mahitaji ya usimamizi wa taarifa, usalama na usalama wa kitabibu.
Kujenga uwezo wa uhandisi wa data kupitia uajiri, maendeleo na njia za taaluma.
qualifications: Uzoefu mpana wa kuongoza uhandisi wa data katika timu nyingi.

roles.title: Mhandisi wa uchanganuzi
roles.summary: Wahandisi wa uchanganuzi hugeuza data ghafi za afya na matunzo kuwa miundo safi ya data, iliyojaribiwa na kuandikwa ambayo wachambuzi, wanasayansi wa data na zana za kuripoti wanaweza kuitegemea. Wako kati ya uhandisi wa data na uchambuzi, wakitumia mazoezi ya uhandisi wa programu kama vile udhibiti wa matoleo, majaribio na ukaguzi wa msimbo katika mabadiliko yaliyo nyuma ya ripoti na dashibodi za taasisi.
healthContext: Miundo ya data hubeba fasili za kitabibu na za kiutendaji, kama vile kinachohesabiwa kuwa kulazwa, kulazwa tena, au kukiuka kiwango cha muda wa kusubiri, hivyo fasili hukubaliwa na viongozi wa kitabibu na wa kiutendaji.
Misimbo ya kitabibu kutoka istilahi na uainishaji kama SNOMED CT na ICD hupangwa katika seti za marejeleo kwa ajili ya uchambuzi, ambazo zinahitaji udhibiti makini wa matoleo.
Miundo inayotumika kwa ripoti za utendaji na ufadhili lazima iwe thabiti na inayoweza kukaguliwa, kwa sababu makosa yanaweza kuathiri maamuzi kuhusu huduma za wagonjwa.
