Miundo mara nyingi hushikilia data za kiwango cha mgonjwa zenye majina bandia, hivyo ufikiaji, uandishi wa nyaraka na upunguzaji wa data huingizwa ndani yake.

pcfRole.name: Analytics engineer
pcfRole.description:
An analytics engineer transforms data relevant to the organisation into structures that enable analysis and decision-making.

In this role, you will:
- work with subject matter experts to understand organisational processes and translate these into data structures optimised for analysis
- work with data users to design and build data models they can use for effective analysis and decision-making, using modelling techniques such as Kimball or Inmon
- support data quality improvement
- develop standards for data transformation
- create and maintain data documentation
- refine requirements in response to feedback from users and changes in the organisation
- provide ongoing support to users

levels.title: Mhandisi wa uchanganuzi mwanafunzi
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A trainee analytics engineer attends training and develops skills on the job.

At this role level, you will:
- spend time shadowing other analytics engineers
- build your knowledge of the organisation
- learn skills for managing data
- learn to use different applications, tools, templates and best practices
- handle simple queries from users and document their data requirements
- contribute to data documentation and user training
responsibilities: Kujifunza zana na mazoezi ya timu ya kuunda miundo ya data kupitia mafunzo na kufanya kazi kwa jozi.
Kufanya mabadiliko madogo yaliyobainishwa vizuri kwenye miundo ya data chini ya usimamizi.
Kuandika vipengee vya data na fasili zake katika katalogi ya data.
Kujibu maswali rahisi kutoka kwa watumiaji wa data na kurekodi mahitaji yao.
Kufuata kanuni za usimamizi wa taarifa anapofanya kazi na data za wagonjwa.
qualifications: Amesajiliwa katika, au anaelekea kukamilisha, uanagenzi wa data au unaolingana nao.
levels.jobEvaluationNotes: Maarifa yamepewa alama ya kiwango ambacho kazi inahitaji mara mafunzo yanapokuwa yamekamilika vya kutosha kufanya kazi.

levels.title: Mhandisi wa uchanganuzi
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
An analytics engineer develops and tests data models assigned by more senior analytics engineers to help people in a defined area access and use data.

At this role level, you will:
- draft documentation of data that meets standards
- work with other analytics engineers to resolve issues and risks
- support trainee analytics engineers
- provide training and support for users of data sets
- work with more experienced analytics engineers to develop your skills
responsibilities: Kujenga na kujaribu miundo ya data kwa eneo la huduma, kama vile shughuli za wagonjwa waliolazwa au matunzo ya jamii, kutoka kwenye miundo iliyokubaliwa.
Kuandika majaribio ya kiotomatiki yanayokagua miundo ya data dhidi ya fasili zilizokubaliwa za kitabibu na za kiutendaji.
Kutunza seti za marejeleo za misimbo ya kitabibu zinazotumika katika uchambuzi, zenye matoleo wazi.
Kuandika miundo ili wachambuzi waelewe maana yake, vyanzo na mipaka yake.
Kuwafunza na kuwasaidia watumiaji wa seti za data za timu.
qualifications: Shahada katika somo linalotumia namba au kompyuta, au uzoefu unaolingana.
Uzoefu wa kujenga miundo ya data au msimbo wa uchambuzi.

levels.title: Mhandisi mwandamizi wa uchanganuzi
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A senior analytics engineer oversees the development and testing of data models, including directing the work of other analytics engineers.

At this role level, you will:
- oversee tasks and support less senior analytics engineers
- build relationships with stakeholders within a defined area
- coach and mentor less senior analytics engineers
- ensure documentation of data meets standards
- ensure issues and risks are resolved
- oversee training and support for users of data sets
- explore and develop new ways of working with data
responsibilities: Kusimamia usanifu na majaribio ya miundo ya data katika maeneo kadhaa ya huduma.
Kukubaliana fasili za vipimo muhimu na viongozi wa kitabibu, wa kiutendaji na wa fedha, na kuhakikisha miundo inazitumia kwa uthabiti.
Kuhakikisha miundo inayolisha ripoti za utendaji na ufadhili inaweza kukaguliwa na imejaribiwa vizuri.
Kutatua masuala na hatari za data pamoja na wahandisi wa data na wamiliki wa data.
Kuwaongoza na kuelekeza kazi ya wahandisi wengine wa uchanganuzi.
qualifications: Uzoefu mkubwa wa kuunda miundo ya data na uhandisi wa uchanganuzi, katika kiwango kinacholingana na shahada ya uzamili.

levels.title: Mhandisi kiongozi wa uchanganuzi
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A lead analytics engineer leads the design and deployment of data models for analysis.

At this role level, you will:
- lead and support a team of analytics engineers to design, build and maintain data models
- work with stakeholders and teams across the organisation to understand relationships between data and organisational processes, and use this to define data requirements
- promote, build awareness and support understanding of analytics engineering
- review the work of other analytics engineers
- create standards for communication, data models and documentation
- define and improve ways of working in the team
responsibilities: Kuongoza timu inayobuni, kujenga na kutunza miundo ya data ya uchambuzi ya taasisi.
Kuweka viwango vya miundo ya data, majaribio, uandishi wa nyaraka na fasili za vipimo.
Kufanya kazi na timu katika taasisi nzima kuelewa jinsi michakato ya kitabibu na ya kiutendaji inavyozalisha data.
Kukagua kazi ya wahandisi wengine wa uchanganuzi na kuboresha njia za kufanya kazi za timu.
Kusimamia moja kwa moja wahandisi wa uchanganuzi.
qualifications: Uzoefu mpana wa kuongoza uhandisi wa uchanganuzi au uundaji wa miundo ya data.

levels.title: Mkuu wa uhandisi wa uchanganuzi
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A head of analytics engineering oversees the development of a range of data models that meet analysis needs across the organisation.

At this role level, you will:
- build relationships with senior stakeholders across the organisation to determine what the organisation needs
- ensure the activities of the analytics engineering team align with strategic priorities
- ensure the team works to standards for communication, data models and documentation
- advocate for the analytics engineering role to senior leadership and other organisations
- build analytics engineering capability by providing technical leadership and career development for the community
- ensure appropriate technology is available for the community
responsibilities: Kuweka mwelekeo wa miundo ya data ya uchambuzi ya taasisi, ili uchambuzi katika taasisi nzima utumie seti moja ya fasili inayoaminika.
Kuhakikisha vipaumbele vya uhandisi wa uchanganuzi vinaunga mkono mkakati wa taasisi na wajibu wake wa kuripoti.
Kuwashauri viongozi wakuu kuhusu uaminifu wa data zilizo nyuma ya ripoti na maamuzi makubwa.
Kuhakikisha jumuiya ina zana na majukwaa inayohitaji, na kusimamia bajeti inayohusiana.
Kujenga uwezo wa uhandisi wa uchanganuzi kupitia uongozi wa kiufundi na maendeleo ya taaluma.
qualifications: Uzoefu mpana wa kuongoza uhandisi wa uchanganuzi katika taasisi.

roles.title: Mwanasayansi wa data
roles.summary: Wanasayansi wa data hutumia takwimu, kujifunza kwa mashine na mbinu nyingine za hali ya juu kupata mifumo katika data za afya na matunzo na kujenga miundo inayosaidia huduma kupanga, kutabiri na kuboresha matunzo. Kazi ya kawaida hujumuisha kutabiri mahitaji, kutambua wagonjwa wanaoweza kunufaika na msaada wa mapema, na kutathmini athari za mabadiliko ya huduma. Hufanya kazi kwa karibu na madaktari na wachambuzi, na kuhakikisha miundo ni halali, ya haki, na inatumika kwa usalama.
healthContext: Muundo unaosaidia maamuzi kuhusu wagonjwa unaweza kusababisha madhara ukiwa si sahihi au una upendeleo, hivyo miundo huthibitishwa kwa watu watakaoitumia na kutathminiwa kwa usalama wa kitabibu.

Data za afya zinaakisi ukosefu wa usawa katika kupata matunzo, hivyo miundo inaweza kurudia au kuzidisha ukosefu wa usawa wa afya isipokuwa upendeleo upimwe na kushughulikiwa kwa kila kundi la wagonjwa.
Baadhi ya miundo, kama ile inayoongoza utambuzi au matibabu, inaweza kudhibitiwa kama vifaa tiba, na udhibiti wa AI unaweza pia kutumika.

Sayansi ya data mara nyingi inahitaji data za kina za wagonjwa zilizounganishwa, hivyo kazi hufanyika katika mazingira salama, kwa data zenye majina bandia, chini ya msingi wa usimamizi wa taarifa uliokubaliwa.
Madaktari na wagonjwa wanahitaji kuelewa na kuamini matokeo ya muundo, hivyo maelezo na mawasiliano kwa lugha rahisi ya kutokuwa na uhakika ni muhimu.

pcfRole.name: Data scientist
pcfRole.description:
Data science is a broad and fast-moving field spanning maths, statistics, software engineering and communications. Data scientists will often work as part of a multidisciplinary team, using data and analytics to inform and achieve organisational goals.

In this role, you will:
- be inquisitive
- explore and visualise data
- make recommendations to address complex problems and to inform strategic and operational decision making
- use data ethically and appropriately
- be innovative and adaptable
- explore existing and new data using a range of statistical tools and techniques, such as machine learning and predictive analytics
- find patterns in data and transform them into organisational insight

levels.title: Mwanasayansi wa data mwanafunzi
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A trainee data scientist is inquisitive, curious about data and keen to learn and develop.

At this role level, you will:
- have a basic understanding of software development and analytical methods
- interpret statistical outputs effectively
- be aware of how data science techniques can be used, and have a basic knowledge of those key techniques, such as machine learning
- work as part of a multidisciplinary team to develop data science solutions and outputs
- prepare and manipulate data
- present effectively
- be aware of ethical considerations
- be aware of the technologies used
responsibilities: Kujifunza mbinu za takwimu na kujifunza kwa mashine za timu, zana na njia salama za kufanya kazi kupitia mafunzo yaliyopangwa.
Kuandaa na kuchunguza seti za data za afya zenye majina bandia chini ya usimamizi.
Kuendesha na kufasiri uchambuzi rahisi wa takwimu, akikagua matokeo na mwanasayansi wa data mwenye uzoefu zaidi.
Kufuata taratibu za usimamizi wa taarifa, udhibiti wa ufichuzi na maadili.
Kujitahidi kupata uanagenzi wa sayansi ya data au sifa inayolingana.
qualifications: Amesajiliwa katika, au anaelekea kukamilisha, uanagenzi wa sayansi ya data au unaolingana nao.
levels.jobEvaluationNotes: Maarifa yamepewa alama ya kiwango ambacho kazi inahitaji mara mafunzo yanapokuwa yamekamilika vya kutosha kufanya kazi.

levels.title: Mwanasayansi msaidizi wa data
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
An associate data scientist is inquisitive, curious about data and keen to learn and develop.

At this role level, you will:
- understand the basics of software development and analytical methods, and be able to develop basic models
- understand and be able to implement a range of data science techniques, including machine learning
- collaborate with others to develop data science solutions and outputs supporting the organisation
- prepare and manipulate data, and perform analytics
- present and communicate effectively
- be aware of project delivery methods
- be aware of ethical considerations
- have knowledge of the technologies used
responsibilities: Kujenga na kujaribu miundo ya msingi ya takwimu na ya kujifunza kwa mashine, kama vile utabiri wa mahitaji, kwa mwongozo.
Kuandaa na kuunganisha seti za data za afya kwa ajili ya uundaji wa miundo katika mazingira salama.
Kupima jinsi miundo inavyofanya kazi kwa makundi tofauti ya wagonjwa na kuripoti tofauti.
Kuwasilisha matokeo na kutokuwa na uhakika kwake kwa wachambuzi na timu za huduma.
Kuandika vyanzo vya data, mbinu na dhana ili kazi iweze kurudiwa.
qualifications: Shahada katika somo linalotumia namba, uanagenzi wa sayansi ya data, au uzoefu unaolingana.

levels.title: Mwanasayansi wa data
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A data scientist will work independently and have a good understanding of a range of topics, including data science techniques, delivery methods and stages (such as minimal viable products), tools and technologies.

At this role level, you will:
- develop complex solutions using a range of data science techniques, whilst understanding any ethical considerations
- understand the role and benefits of data science within the organisation
- support capability building within the organisation
- collaborate with others to develop data science solutions and outputs supporting the organisation
- prepare and manipulate data, and perform complex analytics
- present and communicate effectively
responsibilities: Kuendeleza miundo tata kwa kujitegemea, kama vile ugawaji wa hatari au utabiri wa muda wa kukaa hospitalini, akichagua mbinu zinazofaa.
Kuthibitisha miundo pamoja na madaktari, akikagua kama ni sahihi, ya haki na yenye manufaa kwa data za wagonjwa wa eneo.
Kuandika matumizi yaliyokusudiwa ya kila muundo, data, utendaji na mipaka, na kuchangia ushahidi kwa hoja za usalama wa kitabibu.
Kutathmini athari za mabadiliko ya huduma kwa kutumia mbinu zinazofaa za takwimu.
Kueleza miundo na kutokuwa na uhakika kwake kwa hadhira za kitabibu na zisizo za kiufundi.
Kuwasaidia wanasayansi wasaidizi na wanafunzi wa data.
qualifications: Shahada katika somo linalotumia namba, au uzoefu unaolingana.
Uzoefu wa kujenga na kuthibitisha miundo ya takwimu au ya kujifunza kwa mashine.

levels.title: Mwanasayansi mkuu wa data
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A principal data scientist is a leader of data science, quite often with responsibility for managing and developing teams.

At this role level, you will:
- have a broad knowledge of data science techniques, use cases and potential impact, as well as the tools and technologies
- have extensive experience in scoping, designing and delivering data science outputs and products
- work collaboratively with a range of experts in support of organisational objectives
- communicate effectively and challenge delivery plans and priorities
- appreciate and understand data ethics, data preparation and manipulation
- appreciate and understand delivery methods, and how to deliver supported solutions at scale
responsibilities: Kubainisha wigo, kubuni na kuongoza miradi ya sayansi ya data inayounga mkono mipango ya huduma na matunzo ya wagonjwa.
Kuamua ni mbinu, zana na data gani zinazofaa, na kupinga mipango isiyowezekana au isiyo salama.
Kupanga uthibitishaji, tathmini ya upendeleo na ufuatiliaji wa miundo pamoja na wenzake wa usalama wa kitabibu na usimamizi wa taarifa.
Kukubaliana na timu za bidhaa jinsi miundo itakavyosambazwa na kuungwa mkono kwa kiwango kikubwa.
Kusimamia na kuendeleza timu ndogo ya wanasayansi wa data.
qualifications: Uzoefu mkubwa wa kutoa sayansi ya data, katika kiwango kinacholingana na shahada ya uzamili au uzamivu katika somo la kiasi.

levels.title: Mwanasayansi kiongozi wa data
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A lead data scientist is a leader, coach, and champion of data science. They have responsibility for managing and developing teams, building organisational capability, and setting and communicating direction.

At this role level, you will:
- have experience in identifying opportunities to deploy extensive knowledge of data science techniques, and in challenging the status quo
- design and implement scalable data science outputs and products, driving collaboration with others in support of organisational objectives
- select the most appropriate tools and technologies
- navigate ethical and data challenges
- communicate and present effectively
- challenge delivery plans and priorities
responsibilities: Kuongoza timu za sayansi ya data na kuweka mwelekeo, vipaumbele na viwango vyake.
Kupata fursa ambapo sayansi ya data inaweza kuboresha matunzo, na kutoa hoja kuzihusu kwa viongozi wa kitabibu na wa huduma.
Kuhakikisha miundo inabuniwa, inathibitishwa na kufuatiliwa ili ibaki salama na ya haki katika matumizi.
Kutatua changamoto tata za kimaadili na za data, kama vile ridhaa, upendeleo na matumizi ya data nyeti.
Kujenga uwezo wa sayansi ya data kupitia uongozi, uajiri na mafunzo.
qualifications: Uzoefu mpana wa kuongoza timu za sayansi ya data.
levels.jobEvaluationNotes: UK GDaD PCF inapendekeza mwanasayansi kiongozi wa data na mkuu wa sayansi ya data wote katika G7 au G6. Marejeleo haya yanaweka kiongozi katika Daraja la 8a na mkuu katika Daraja la 8b, ili ngazi hizi mbili ziwe katika madaraja tofauti.

levels.title: Mkuu wa sayansi ya data
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
The head of data science has complete oversight of data science within their organisation.

At this role level, you will:
- set direction
- build capability
- oversee resourcing, budgeting, professionalism and outputs and products
- support and enable future IT developments
- understand and use a wide range of data science techniques, tools and technologies
- lead on ethics
- communicate and present data science and data ethics effectively to ministers and senior leaders
- champion the role of data science in supporting organisational priorities, and in collaborative working across professions
- represent the department on data science matters
responsibilities: Kuweka mwelekeo wa sayansi ya data na AI katika taasisi, kulingana na mkakati na vipaumbele vyake.
Kuongoza maadili, usalama na uhakikisho wa miundo na AI ya taasisi, na kuishauri bodi kuhusu hayo.
Kusimamia rasilimali, bajeti na ubora wa bidhaa za sayansi ya data.
Kuiwakilisha taasisi kuhusu sayansi ya data na AI kwa washirika wa afya na matunzo, watafiti na wadhibiti.
Kujenga uwezo na taaluma za sayansi ya data katika taaluma mbalimbali.
qualifications: Uzoefu mpana wa kuongoza sayansi ya data katika taasisi.

roles.title: Mhandisi wa kujifunza kwa mashine
roles.summary: Wahandisi wa kujifunza kwa mashine huchukua miundo iliyojengwa na wanasayansi wa data, au iliyonunuliwa kutoka kwa wasambazaji, na kuifanya ifanye kazi kwa uaminifu katika huduma za moja kwa moja za afya na matunzo. Hujenga mifereji inayofunza, kujaribu, kusambaza na kufuatilia miundo, na kuiunganisha na mifumo ya kitabibu na ya kiutendaji. Huhakikisha miundo inabaki salama, ya kuhifadhiwa, ya haki na yenye ufanisi wakati wagonjwa na wafanyakazi halisi wanaitegemea.
healthContext: Miundo inayotumika moja kwa moja inaweza kuteleza idadi ya wagonjwa, mazoezi ya kitabibu, au tabia za kurekodi zinapobadilika, hivyo utendaji hufuatiliwa kwa kila kundi la wagonjwa na miundo hufunzwa upya au kuondolewa inapohitajika.

Muundo unaoongoza utambuzi, upangaji wa vipaumbele vya wagonjwa, au matibabu unaweza kudhibitiwa kama kifaa tiba, jambo linaloleta mahitaji rasmi ya mzunguko wa maisha wa programu, udhibiti wa mabadiliko na ufuatiliaji baada ya soko.
Hoja za usalama wa kitabibu zinahitaji ushahidi kuhusu jinsi muundo unavyoshindwa, jinsi matokeo yake yanavyoonyeshwa kwa madaktari, na nini kinatokea usipopatikana.
Miundo iliyofunzwa kwa data za wagonjwa inaweza kuvujisha taarifa kuhusu watu binafsi, hivyo data za mafunzo, vitu vya muundo na kumbukumbu hulindwa kama data zenyewe.
AI ya kuzalisha na miundo mikubwa ya lugha huleta hatari zaidi, kama vile maudhui yaliyobuniwa katika maelezo ya kitabibu, ambazo zinahitaji majaribio maalumu na usimamizi wa binadamu.

pcfRole.name: Machine learning engineer
pcfRole.description:
A machine learning engineer develops, assures and maintains machine learning models so they can be used in products and services.

In this role, you will:
- be responsible for the software development and technical infrastructure needed to design, train, deploy and scale machine learning models
- provide and maintain effective, secure and sustainable machine learning models for use in products and services
- support all stages of the machine learning life cycle
- help product teams evaluate and choose appropriate machine learning solutions

levels.title: Mhandisi mwandamizi wa kujifunza kwa mashine
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A senior machine learning engineer develops machine learning models so they can be used in products and services.

At this role level, you will:
- decide what model is most suitable for use in products and services
- customise, optimise, re-train and maintain existing models
- deploy models into production, testing and assuring them to ensure they meet performance requirements
- work with others to integrate models with existing systems
- check that models used in live products and services stay safe, secure and continue to work effectively
responsibilities: Kusambaza miundo kwenye huduma za kitabibu na za kiutendaji za uzalishaji, kwa majaribio ya kiotomatiki, matoleo na kurudi nyuma.
Kujenga ufuatiliaji wa utendaji wa muundo, mteleo na haki katika makundi ya wagonjwa, wenye tahadhari na wamiliki walio wazi.
Kuunganisha miundo na mifumo ya kitabibu, akitumia viwango huria kama HL7 FHIR inapowezekana.
Kutoa ushahidi wa majaribio, mabadiliko na ufuatiliaji unaohitajika kwa hoja za usalama wa kitabibu na mafaili ya kiufundi ya vifaa tiba.
Kutathmini na kurekebisha miundo ya wasambazaji na ya chanzo huria kwa matumizi ya ndani, ikiwemo miundo ya AI ya kuzalisha.
Kuwaongoza wanasayansi wa data na wahandisi kuhusu mazoezi ya uhandisi wa kujifunza kwa mashine.
qualifications: Uzoefu mkubwa wa kujenga na kuendesha mifumo ya kujifunza kwa mashine katika uzalishaji, katika kiwango kinacholingana na shahada ya uzamili.

levels.title: Mhandisi kiongozi wa kujifunza kwa mashine
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A lead machine learning engineer leads the technical development and deployment of machine learning models.

At this role level, you will:
- lead the most complex technical work needed to develop models for use in products and services
- co-ordinate moving a model from the research and development stage to production
- define ways of working across the machine learning life cycle
- identify training needs for machine learning engineers and related roles
- help your team work with other teams and disciplines
- assure the effectiveness of machine learning models in use across the organisation
- define and communicate software standards and guidelines related to ethics, risk and security
responsibilities: Kuongoza kazi tata zaidi ya kuleta miundo kutoka utafiti hadi matumizi salama ya moja kwa moja katika taasisi.
Kufafanua mzunguko wa maisha wa kujifunza kwa mashine, ikiwemo udhibiti unaohitajika kwa miundo inayodhibitiwa na inayohusu usalama.
Kuweka viwango vya majaribio ya miundo, ufuatiliaji, usalama na maadili, na kuhakikisha miundo inayotumika moja kwa moja.
Kufanya kazi na maafisa wa usalama wa kitabibu, usimamizi wa taarifa na wataalamu wa udhibiti kukubaliana jinsi miundo inavyotathminiwa na kuidhinishwa.
Kubaini mahitaji ya mafunzo na kuendeleza wahandisi wa kujifunza kwa mashine na nafasi zinazohusiana.
qualifications: Uzoefu mpana wa kuongoza uhandisi wa kujifunza kwa mashine kwa huduma tata au zinazodhibitiwa.

roles.title: Meneja wa usimamizi wa data
roles.summary: Mameneja wa usimamizi wa data huhakikisha data za afya na matunzo za taasisi zinasimamiwa vizuri, zinaaminika, na zinatumika kwa usalama na kihalali. Huanzisha na kuendesha mifumo, sera na viwango vya umiliki wa data, ubora, metadata na ushirikishaji wa data, na hufanya kazi na wamiliki wa data, wenzake wa usimamizi wa taarifa na viongozi wa kitabibu ili data zitumike kwa kujiamini kwa matunzo, mipango na utafiti.
healthContext: Data za afya ni data binafsi nyeti sana, hivyo usimamizi wa data hufanya kazi kwa karibu na usimamizi wa taarifa, ulinzi wa data na wajibu wa usiri.
Data hushirikishwa na washirika wengi wa afya na matunzo kwa matunzo ya moja kwa moja, mipango na utafiti, na kila matumizi yanahitaji msingi halali ulio wazi, makubaliano na udhibiti.
Viwango vya data za kitabibu, kama SNOMED CT, ICD na HL7 FHIR, na fasili za data zilizokubaliwa ni kiini cha kufanya data ziwe thabiti katika mifumo na taasisi.
Ubora duni wa data unaweza kusababisha moja kwa moja madhara kwa wagonjwa, kama vile mizio iliyokosekana au ulinganishaji usio sahihi wa wagonjwa, pamoja na maamuzi yasiyo sahihi kuhusu huduma.
Wagonjwa na umma wanatarajia uwazi kuhusu jinsi data zao zinavyotumika, hivyo usimamizi hujumuisha uwazi na kuheshimu chaguzi za wagonjwa kuhusu matumizi ya pili.

pcfRole.name: Data governance manager
pcfRole.description:
A data governance manager plans, monitors and enforces the management of data assets.

In this role, you will:
- catalogue, monitor and identify data assets that are essential to the organisation’s operations or services
- assign ownership of data, ensuring there is a clear RACI (responsible, accountable, consulted and informed) matrix in the organisation
- incorporate governance of data into routine processes
- support or manage risk processes around data
- advocate for better use and management of data within the organisation
- encourage better data literacy within the organisation

levels.title: Meneja wa usimamizi wa data
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A data governance manager defines, implements and manages data governance frameworks, policies and standards.

At this role level, you will:
- work on the design and implementation of practical data governance solutions to support organisational needs
- identify opportunities and make recommendations to improve the quality and trustworthiness of data throughout the organisation
- implement and establish wider data management competencies within the organisation (such as data quality, metadata management, master data management, data modelling, and development of data standards and data strategy)
- apply data governance to optimise the safety and value of data throughout the data life cycle
- work within the organisation to minimise data risks and increase data literacy
responsibilities: Kuendesha mfumo wa usimamizi wa data wa taasisi, ikiwemo umiliki wa data, uangalizi na vikundi vya kufanya maamuzi.
Kutunza katalogi ya data, faharasa ya biashara na viwango vya data, ikiwemo fasili zilizokubaliwa za kitabibu na za kiutendaji.
Kufuatilia ubora wa data kwa seti kuu za data na kufanya kazi na wamiliki wa data kurekebisha visababishi.
Kufanya kazi na wenzake wa usimamizi wa taarifa kuhusu makubaliano ya ushirikishaji wa data na tathmini za athari za ulinzi wa data kwa matumizi mapya ya data.
Kurekodi na kusimamia hatari na masuala ya data, na kuyapeleka kwa mmiliki sahihi.
Kuboresha uelewa wa data miongoni mwa wafanyakazi wanaounda na kutumia data za afya.
qualifications: Shahada au sifa ya kitaaluma katika data, usimamizi wa taarifa, au somo linalohusiana, au uzoefu unaolingana.
Uzoefu wa usimamizi wa data au uongozi wa data katika taasisi tata.
levels.jobEvaluationNotes: UK GDaD PCF inapendekeza HEO hadi G7 kwa ngazi hii, ambayo inalingana na Daraja la 6. Marejeleo haya yanaiweka katika Daraja la 7 kwa sababu, katika taasisi ya huduma za afya, nafasi hii kwa kawaida husimamia data za siri za wagonjwa katika taasisi nzima na kuendeleza sera ya data inayoathiri huduma kadhaa.

levels.title: Meneja kiongozi wa usimamizi wa data
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A lead data governance manager undertakes complex work related to the principles and practices of data governance, and co-ordinates with data owners to lead wider data management competencies.

At this role level, you will:
- lead the formation, implementation and management of data governance frameworks, policies and standards
- implement and establish wider data management competencies within the organisation (such as data quality assurance, metadata management, master data management, data modelling, and development of data standards and data strategy)
- be responsible for understanding and managing the organisational data risks and issues, and co-ordinating with data owners to accept or resolve them
responsibilities: Kuongoza usanifu na uendeshaji wa mifumo, sera na viwango vya usimamizi wa data katika taasisi nzima.
Kuratibu wamiliki wa data na waangalizi kusimamia hatari za data, kuzikubali au kuzitatua, na kuziripoti kwa kamati za juu.
Kuongoza kazi pana ya usimamizi wa data, kama vile data kuu za wagonjwa, wafanyakazi na maeneo, na data za marejeleo.
Kukubaliana mipango ya usimamizi wa data kwa data zinazoshirikishwa na washirika wa afya na matunzo na watafiti.
Kushauri programu jinsi mifumo mipya na matumizi mapya ya data yanavyotimiza viwango vya data na kanuni za usimamizi.
Kusimamia moja kwa moja wafanyakazi wa usimamizi wa data.
qualifications: Uzoefu mpana wa kuongoza usimamizi wa data au uongozi wa data.

levels.title: Mkuu wa usimamizi wa data
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
The head of data governance works with the chief data officer across the organisation and government, providing strategic oversight and leadership in all aspects of data governance and use. They ensure high standards are maintained in-line with regulations and ethical requirements.

At this role level, you will:
- work with the chief data officer to provide strategic oversight of data governance throughout the organisation
- set and monitor the adherence to data governance policies, frameworks and standards
- be accountable for understanding and managing the organisational data risks and issues, and co-ordinating with data owners to accept or resolve them
- act as a senior advisor across government on the best practice of data security development, in accordance with the data enterprise architecture
- maintain effective long-term relationships at a senior level with important decision-makers and influencers
- advocate improved data risk management and practices within the organisation
- encourage better data literacy and understanding of data governance within the organisation
responsibilities: Kufanya kazi na mkuu wa data na mmiliki mtendaji wa hatari za taarifa kuweka mkakati wa usimamizi na matumizi ya data.
Kuweka sera na viwango vya usimamizi wa data na kufuatilia jinsi taasisi inavyovifuata vizuri.
Kuwajibika kwa kusimamia hatari za data za taasisi, na kuripoti kuzihusu kwa bodi.
Kuiwakilisha taasisi kuhusu usimamizi wa data kwa washirika wa afya na matunzo, wadhibiti na vikundi vya wagonjwa.
Kukuza uwazi kwa wagonjwa na umma kuhusu jinsi data zao zinavyotumika.
Kuongoza na kuendeleza kitengo cha usimamizi wa data.
qualifications: Uzoefu mpana wa kuongoza usimamizi wa data katika taasisi.

roles.title: Mwekaji misimbo ya kitabibu
roles.summary: Waweka misimbo ya kitabibu husoma kumbukumbu za afya za wagonjwa na kutafsiri utambuzi, taratibu na taarifa nyingine za kitabibu kuwa misimbo ya kawaida ya uainishaji, kama vile ICD kwa utambuzi na uainishaji wa taratibu kwa afua. Data zenye misimbo hutumika kwa malipo, mipango ya huduma, ukaguzi wa kitabibu, utafiti na takwimu za afya ya umma, hivyo usahihi wake ni muhimu zaidi ya timu ya uwekaji misimbo. Waweka misimbo hufanya kazi kwa karibu na madaktari kufafanua kumbukumbu, na zaidi na zaidi hutumia istilahi za kitabibu kama SNOMED CT na zana za uwekaji misimbo zinazosaidiwa na kompyuta.
healthContext: Waweka misimbo husoma maelezo kamili ya kesi, ambayo mara nyingi huelezea magonjwa makubwa, majeraha, unyanyasaji, kujidhuru na vifo, hivyo kazi huhitaji nguvu za kihisia na timu zinahitaji msaada na usimamizi mzuri.
Data zenye misimbo huendesha malipo ya shughuli, viashiria vya vifo na matokeo, na mipango ya huduma, hivyo makosa yanaweza kuathiri ufadhili, utendaji uliochapishwa na maamuzi kuhusu matunzo.
Uwekaji misimbo hutegemea ubora wa nyaraka za kitabibu, hivyo waweka misimbo huuliza madaktari kuhusu kumbukumbu zisizo wazi na kusaidia kuboresha jinsi matunzo yanavyorekodiwa.
Waweka misimbo hushughulikia kumbukumbu kamili za afya zinazotambulisha kila siku, hivyo usiri na ufikiaji sahihi ni muhimu.
Uwekaji misimbo wa kiotomatiki na unaosaidiwa na kompyuta, na ulinganishaji kutoka SNOMED CT hadi uainishaji, unabadilisha kazi hii, na waweka misimbo hukagua kama misimbo ya kiotomatiki ni sahihi.

levels.title: Mwekaji misimbo ya kitabibu mwanafunzi
levels.summary: Mwekaji misimbo ya kitabibu mwanafunzi hujifunza kuweka misimbo ya visa rahisi vya hospitali chini ya usimamizi wa karibu, akielekea kupata sifa ya uwekaji misimbo ya kitabibu.
responsibilities: Kuweka misimbo ya visa rahisi, kama vile wagonjwa wa siku moja, kutoka kwenye kumbukumbu za afya kwa kutumia kanuni za uainishaji, huku kazi yote ikikaguliwa na mwekaji misimbo mwandamizi.
Kujifunza istilahi za kitabibu, anatomia, na viwango vya kitaifa na kimataifa vya uwekaji misimbo kupitia mafunzo yaliyopangwa.
Kupata, kufuatilia na kurudisha kumbukumbu za afya kwa usahihi, na kuziweka salama.
Kurekodi data zenye misimbo katika mfumo wa utawala wa wagonjwa au wa uwekaji misimbo kwa usahihi na kwa wakati.
Kuibua taarifa zisizo wazi au zinazokosekana kwa mwekaji misimbo mwandamizi.
qualifications: Ujuzi mzuri wa kusoma na kuandika na kutumia kibodi, na usajili katika programu ya mafunzo ya uwekaji misimbo ya kitabibu, au unaolingana.
levels.jobEvaluationNotes: Juhudi za kiakili ni kiwango cha 4 kwa sababu waweka misimbo hukazia fikira kwa muda mrefu wakisoma na kufasiri maelezo ya kina ya kesi. Juhudi za kihisia ni kiwango cha 2 kwa sababu waweka misimbo mara nyingi husoma kumbukumbu zinazoelezea matukio ya kuhuzunisha.

levels.title: Mwekaji misimbo ya kitabibu
levels.summary: Mwekaji misimbo ya kitabibu huweka misimbo ya aina zote za visa vya kawaida kwa kujitegemea na kwa usahihi, akitimiza tarehe za mwisho na viwango vya ubora vilivyokubaliwa.
responsibilities: Kuweka misimbo ya visa vya wagonjwa waliolazwa, wa siku moja na wa nje kwa usahihi katika taaluma za kawaida, kwa kutumia kanuni za uainishaji na sera za ndani.
Kuuliza madaktari kuhusu taarifa za kitabibu zisizo wazi, zinazokosekana au zinazokinzana na kurekodi matokeo.
Kukagua misimbo inayopendekezwa na uwekaji misimbo unaosaidiwa na kompyuta au ramani za istilahi, na kuisahihisha inapohitajika.
Kutimiza tarehe za mwisho za ukamilifu wa uwekaji misimbo, ili data ziwe tayari kwa malipo na kuripoti.
Kushiriki katika ukaguzi wa uwekaji misimbo na kuchukua hatua kulingana na matokeo yake.
qualifications: Sifa inayotambuliwa ya uwekaji misimbo ya kitabibu, au anaelekea kuipata akiwa na uzoefu unaolingana.
levels.jobEvaluationNotes: Juhudi za kiakili na za kihisia zinaakisi vipindi virefu vya umakini kwenye maelezo ya kesi ambayo mara nyingi huelezea magonjwa makubwa, majeraha na vifo.

levels.title: Mwekaji misimbo mwandamizi wa kitabibu
levels.summary: Mwekaji misimbo mwandamizi wa kitabibu huweka misimbo ya visa tata katika taaluma mbalimbali, ni chanzo cha ushauri wa kitaalamu kwa waweka misimbo wengine, na hukagua na kufunza waweka misimbo wenye uzoefu mdogo.
responsibilities: Kuweka misimbo ya visa tata, kama vile huduma muhimu, saratani, taratibu nyingi na vifo, katika taaluma mbalimbali.
Kutatua maswali magumu ya uwekaji misimbo pamoja na washauri bingwa na madaktari wengine waandamizi, akieleza kanuni za uwekaji misimbo kwa uwazi.
Kukagua kazi ya waweka misimbo wanafunzi na kuwapa maoni na mafunzo kazini.
Kuthibitisha data zenye misimbo kabla ya kuwasilishwa na kurekebisha makosa pamoja na timu sahihi.
Kufanya kazi na timu za kitabibu kuboresha ubora wa nyaraka za kitabibu.
qualifications: Sifa inayotambuliwa ya uwekaji misimbo ya kitabibu, au uzoefu unaolingana.
Uzoefu wa kuweka misimbo ya visa tata katika taaluma mbalimbali.
levels.jobEvaluationNotes: Juhudi za kihisia zinabaki katika kiwango cha 2, kwani visa tata kama vifo na huduma ya saratani ni sehemu ya kawaida ya kazi.

levels.title: Mkaguzi na mkufunzi wa uwekaji misimbo ya kitabibu
levels.summary: Mkaguzi na mkufunzi wa uwekaji misimbo ya kitabibu hukagua usahihi wa data zenye misimbo, hubuni na kutoa mafunzo ya uwekaji misimbo, na kushauri taasisi kuhusu viwango vya uwekaji misimbo. Katika baadhi ya taasisi ngazi hii pia huongoza timu ya uwekaji misimbo kila siku.
responsibilities: Kupanga na kufanya ukaguzi wa uwekaji misimbo katika taaluma mbalimbali, akipima usahihi dhidi ya viwango vya kitaifa na kimataifa.
Kuripoti matokeo ya ukaguzi kwa timu za uwekaji misimbo, za kitabibu, za fedha na za taarifa, na kukubaliana hatua za kuboresha.
Kubuni na kutoa mafunzo ya uwekaji misimbo, kuanzia kozi za msingi kwa waweka misimbo wapya hadi mafunzo ya kujikumbusha kuhusu mabadiliko ya viwango.
Kuwashauri madaktari na mameneja jinsi uwekaji misimbo unavyoathiri malipo, viashiria vya vifo na data za utendaji.
Kuongoza utekelezaji wa mabadiliko katika matoleo ya uainishaji, viwango vya uwekaji misimbo na zana za uwekaji misimbo.
Kuongoza timu ya uwekaji misimbo kila siku pale taasisi inapochanganya hili na ukaguzi na mafunzo.
qualifications: Sifa inayotambuliwa ya uwekaji misimbo ya kitabibu na sifa inayotambuliwa ya ukaguzi au mafunzo ya uwekaji misimbo ya kitabibu, au uzoefu unaolingana.
levels.jobEvaluationNotes: Watu ni kiwango cha 3 kwa sababu kubuni na kufundisha mafunzo maalumu ya uwekaji misimbo ni jukumu kuu. Utafiti ni kiwango cha 2 kwa sababu ukaguzi wa uwekaji misimbo ni sehemu ya kawaida ya kazi.

levels.title: Meneja wa uwekaji misimbo ya kitabibu
levels.summary: Meneja wa uwekaji misimbo ya kitabibu huongoza huduma ya uwekaji misimbo ya kitabibu ya taasisi, ikiwemo timu zake za uwekaji misimbo, programu ya ubora na mahusiano na timu za kitabibu, za fedha na za taarifa.
responsibilities: Kuongoza huduma ya uwekaji misimbo ya kitabibu na viongozi wa timu zake, akihakikisha uwekaji misimbo umekamilika, ni sahihi na uko kwa wakati.
Kuweka sera za uwekaji misimbo na programu ya ubora wa uwekaji misimbo, kulingana na viwango vya kitaifa na kimataifa.
Kusimamia bajeti ya uwekaji misimbo na kupanga nguvu kazi, ikiwemo uajiri, mafunzo na uthibitisho.
Kuwashauri viongozi wakuu jinsi uwekaji misimbo unavyoathiri ufadhili, viashiria vya vifo na matokeo, na data zilizochapishwa.

Kuongoza kupitishwa kwa teknolojia mpya ya uwekaji misimbo, kama vile uwekaji misimbo unaosaidiwa na kompyuta na ulinganishaji wa istilahi, pamoja na wenzake wa usalama wa kitabibu na usimamizi wa taarifa.
Kusaidia ustawi wa waweka misimbo wanaosoma mara kwa mara kumbukumbu zenye kuhuzunisha.
qualifications: Sifa inayotambuliwa ya uwekaji misimbo ya kitabibu na uzoefu mpana wa uwekaji misimbo, ukaguzi na kuongoza waweka misimbo, au uzoefu unaolingana.

roles.title: Mchambuzi wa biashara
roles.summary: Wachambuzi wa biashara husaidia taasisi kuelewa matatizo katika huduma za afya na matunzo na kupata mabadiliko sahihi ya kuyatatua. Huchambua jinsi michakato ya kitabibu, ya kiutawala na inayowalenga wagonjwa inavyofanya kazi leo, hufafanua mahitaji ya watumiaji na ya biashara, na kusaidia timu kuhakikisha huduma mpya za kidijitali zinalingana na njia halisi za matunzo na kuleta manufaa yanayopimika.
healthContext: Michakato huvuka mipaka ya taasisi na taaluma, hivyo wachambuzi huchora ramani za njia nzima za matunzo, ikiwemo makabidhiano kati ya madaktari, wafanyakazi wa matunzo, wagonjwa na taasisi nyingine.
Mahitaji mara nyingi hubeba hatari za kitabibu, hivyo wachambuzi hufanya kazi na maafisa wa usalama wa kitabibu kuhakikisha mahitaji yanayohusu usalama yananaswa, yanafuatiliwa na kujaribiwa.

Mahitaji mengi yanahusu kushirikisha data za afya kati ya mifumo, hivyo wachambuzi wanahitaji uelewa wa vitendo wa viwango vya ushirikiano wa mifumo kama HL7 FHIR na istilahi za kitabibu kama SNOMED CT.
Manufaa katika matunzo mara nyingi yanahusu usalama, ubora, muda wa wafanyakazi na uzoefu wa wagonjwa, si gharama tu, hivyo wachambuzi husaidia kufafanua vipimo ambavyo madaktari wanavitambua.

pcfRole.name: Business analyst
pcfRole.description:
Business analysts help teams to:
- analyse and understand a business problem or opportunity
- undertake research and analysis to understand how a business or business area works, considering the people, organisation, processes, information, data and technology
- identify areas for improvement, explore feasible options, analyse the effects of change and define success measures
- identify and elaborate user and business needs to enable effective design, development and testing of services and business change
- make decisions related to prioritisation and minimum viable product by using analysis led insights
- ensure new products and services meet business and user needs, and are aligned with organisational goals
- understand any business and policy constraints that need to be considered, and assess the implications

levels.title: Mchambuzi wa biashara mwanafunzi
levels.pcfLevelDescription: A trainee business analyst receives direction from more senior business analysts. At this level, you will work with others or under supervision to build and develop your skills.
responsibilities: Kujifunza mbinu za uchambuzi wa biashara kupitia mafunzo yaliyopangwa, kuwafuata wenye uzoefu na kazi chini ya usimamizi.
Kuandika maelezo na kuandaa rasimu za ramani za michakato kutoka kwenye warsha na wafanyakazi wa kitabibu na wa kiutawala.
Kutunza kumbukumbu za mahitaji, hadithi za watumiaji na rekodi za ufuatiliaji chini ya uelekezi.
Kusaidia kuandaa matukio ya majaribio kwa majaribio ya ukubalifu wa watumiaji.
Kufuata kanuni za usimamizi wa taarifa anaposhughulikia nyaraka zenye taarifa za wagonjwa.
qualifications: Anaelekea kukamilisha uanagenzi au sifa ya uchambuzi wa biashara, au uzoefu unaolingana.

levels.title: Mchambuzi mdogo wa biashara
levels.pcfLevelDescription: A junior business analyst receives direction from more senior business analysts but is responsible for the output of specific tasks. At this level, you will have limited skills and will work with others or under supervision. You will support stakeholder relationship management.
responsibilities: Kuchora ramani za michakato ya sasa na ya baadaye ya mtiririko wa kazi za kitabibu na za kiutawala, kama vile rufaa, miadi, au ushughulikiaji wa matokeo ya vipimo.
Kukusanya na kuandika mahitaji na hadithi za watumiaji kwa vipande vya kazi vilivyobainishwa vizuri.
Kukusanya data za utendaji wa michakato, kama vile muda wa kusubiri au njia mbadala za mikono, ili kusaidia uchambuzi.
Kuandaa na kuendesha matukio ya majaribio ya ukubalifu wa watumiaji pamoja na watumiaji wa kitabibu na wa kiutendaji.
Kuashiria mahitaji yanayoweza kuathiri usalama wa mgonjwa kwa timu na afisa wa usalama wa kitabibu.
qualifications: Shahada, sifa au uanagenzi wa uchambuzi wa biashara, au uzoefu unaolingana.

levels.title: Mchambuzi wa biashara
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A business analyst leads small to medium size projects and supports larger and more complex projects.

At this role level, you will:
- manage stakeholder relationships
- work independently
- have a good understanding of your work area
- develop the business analysis community by sharing best practice and mentoring others
responsibilities: Kuongoza uchambuzi wa miradi midogo na ya kati, kuanzia ufafanuzi wa tatizo hadi kupima manufaa.
Kuendesha warsha na madaktari, wafanyakazi wa matunzo na mameneja kuelewa kero na kukubaliana chaguzi.
Kuunda miundo ya njia za matunzo na mtiririko wa taarifa, ikiwemo data zinazobadilishana na mifumo mingine ya afya na matunzo.
Kufafanua mahitaji yanayohusu usalama na data, na kuyafuatilia kupitia usanifu, ujenzi na majaribio.
Kujenga hoja za manufaa kwa vipimo kama vile muda wa wafanyakazi uliookolewa, makosa yaliyoepukwa, au uzoefu wa wagonjwa.
Kuwa mshauri wa wachambuzi wadogo wa biashara na wanafunzi.
qualifications: Shahada au sifa inayotambuliwa ya uchambuzi wa biashara, au uzoefu unaolingana.
Uzoefu wa uchambuzi wa biashara katika miradi ya mabadiliko ya kidijitali.

levels.title: Mchambuzi mwandamizi wa biashara
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A senior business analyst has a good understanding of strategic arenas and leads large or complex projects.

At this role level, you will:
- have functional or people management responsibilities, or a combination of both
- mentor others
- develop best practice
- own stakeholder relationships
- manage community of practice activities within a business area
responsibilities: Kuongoza uchambuzi wa biashara katika programu kubwa au tata, kama vile kubadilisha mfumo wa kitabibu au kubuni upya njia ya matunzo.
Kuchambua chaguzi na athari zake kwa matunzo, usalama, mzigo wa kazi wa wafanyakazi na gharama, na kuwasilisha mapendekezo kwa bodi.
Kuhakikisha hatari za kitabibu, usimamizi wa taarifa na athari za usawa vinachambuliwa na kushughulikiwa katika mahitaji.
Kufafanua na kufuatilia manufaa ya mabadiliko, na kuweka jinsi yatakavyopimwa baada ya kuanza kutumika.
Kusimamia moja kwa moja au kuongoza wachambuzi wa biashara na kuendesha shughuli za jumuiya ya mazoezi.
qualifications: Uzoefu mkubwa wa uchambuzi wa biashara katika mabadiliko tata, katika kiwango kinacholingana na shahada ya uzamili.

levels.title: Mchambuzi kiongozi wa biashara
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A lead business analyst has a good understanding of the enterprise arena and works in highly complex problem spaces, typically spanning multiple products or services.

At this role level, you will:
- be a leader in the business analysis community (across government and externally)
- have functional management or people management accountabilities, or a combination of both
- actively share knowledge and be seen as a go-to person in the field
- mentor others
- own the main stakeholder relationships
responsibilities: Kuongoza uchambuzi wa matatizo tata sana yanayovuka bidhaa, huduma au taasisi kadhaa katika mfumo wa matunzo.
Kuunda hoja ya kibiashara na mpango wa kufikia manufaa kwa uwekezaji mkubwa.
Kuweka viwango vya uchambuzi wa biashara, kama vile ufuatiliaji wa mahitaji kwa programu zinazohusu usalama na zinazodhibitiwa.
Kufanya kazi na viongozi wa kitabibu, wasanifu na mameneja wa bidhaa kuoanisha uchambuzi na mkakati wa taasisi.
Kusimamia moja kwa moja wachambuzi wa biashara na kuongoza maendeleo yao ya kitaaluma.
qualifications: Uzoefu mpana wa kuongoza uchambuzi wa biashara katika mabadiliko tata ya timu nyingi.

levels.title: Mkuu wa uchambuzi wa biashara
levels.pcfLevelDescription: The head of business analysis leads the business analysis function across the enterprise area and builds business analysis capability for the organisation.
responsibilities: Kuongoza kitengo cha uchambuzi wa biashara na kuweka mkakati, viwango na njia zake za kufanya kazi.
Kujenga uwezo wa uchambuzi wa biashara, ikiwemo uajiri, njia za taaluma na mafunzo.
Kuwashauri viongozi watendaji na wa kitabibu kuhusu uchambuzi unaohitajika kwa mageuzi makubwa ya afya na matunzo.
Kuhakikisha kufikia manufaa kunapangwa, kupimwa na kuripotiwa katika jalada zima.
Kusimamia bajeti na mpango wa nguvu kazi wa kitengo.
qualifications: Uzoefu mpana wa kuongoza kitengo au mazoezi ya uchambuzi wa biashara.
levels.jobEvaluationNotes: Rasilimali za taarifa zimepewa alama ya kiwango cha 6 kwa sababu mkuu wa uchambuzi wa biashara anamiliki viwango vya taasisi nzima vya jinsi mahitaji, miundo ya michakato na kumbukumbu za manufaa zinavyotunzwa katika kazi zote za mabadiliko.

roles.title: Meneja wa utoaji
roles.summary: Mameneja wa utoaji huzisaidia timu za fani mbalimbali kutoa huduma za afya za kidijitali zinazowafaa wagonjwa, madaktari na wafanyakazi wa matunzo. Huunda mazingira ya timu kufanya kazi vizuri, huondoa vikwazo, husimamia hatari na utegemezi, na kuweka utoaji ukiendelea kwa kasi endelevu, kwa kutumia njia za agile na lean.
healthContext: Matoleo ya huduma zinazounga mkono matunzo ya wagonjwa lazima yapitie ukaguzi wa usalama wa kitabibu na usimamizi wa taarifa, hivyo mameneja wa utoaji huyaingiza katika mipango ya timu na ufafanuzi wa kukamilika.
Utoaji mara nyingi hutegemea madaktari na wafanyakazi wa matunzo wenye muda mdogo mbali na wagonjwa, hivyo mameneja wa utoaji hupanga utafiti, majaribio na mafunzo kuzunguka ratiba za kitabibu.

Mabadiliko ya huduma za kitabibu zinazoendelea yanahitaji muda makini, hivyo mameneja wa utoaji hupanga kuanza kutumika pamoja na timu za kiutendaji ili kuepuka vipindi vya kilele vya kitabibu na kuhakikisha msaada upo.
Timu mara nyingi hutegemea wasambazaji wa mifumo ya kitabibu na taasisi nyingine za afya na matunzo, hivyo mameneja wa utoaji husimamia utegemezi na mikataba ya nje.

pcfRole.name: Delivery manager
pcfRole.description: A delivery manager is accountable for the delivery of products and services.

levels.title: Meneja msaidizi wa utoaji
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
At this role level, you will:
- work on a small or mature Agile team
- learn on the job
- potentially work alongside a delivery manager on a larger team, shadowing and providing support, or working to deliver an element under guidance and mentorship
responsibilities: Kuwezesha taratibu za timu kama vile mikutano ya kusimama, mipango, maonyesho na tafakari.
Kuweka ubao wa timu, kumbukumbu ya hatari na masuala, na rekodi za utegemezi zikiwa za kisasa.
Kufuatilia kazi za usalama wa kitabibu, usimamizi wa taarifa na ufikivu zinazohitajika kabla ya kila toleo.
Kupanga vikao na madaktari, wafanyakazi wa matunzo na wagonjwa kwa ajili ya utafiti na majaribio, akizunguka ratiba za kitabibu.
Kumfuata na kumsaidia meneja wa utoaji katika timu kubwa, akitoa sehemu za kazi kwa mwongozo.
qualifications: Uzoefu fulani wa kufanya kazi katika, au na, timu ya utoaji, au uzoefu unaolingana.

levels.title: Meneja wa utoaji
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A delivery manager is accountable for the performance of the team.

At this role level, you will:
- build and maintain teams, ensuring they are motivated, collaborating and working well
- identify obstacles and help the team to overcome them
- focus the team on what is most important to the delivery of products and services
- encourage and facilitate continuous improvement of the delivery team
- coach and mentor both team members and others to apply the most appropriate Agile and Lean tools and techniques
The complexity or breadth of products or teams will vary in this role, depending on the context.
responsibilities: Kuongoza utoaji wa bidhaa au huduma ya afya ya kidijitali kupitia ugunduzi, alfa, beta na huduma ya moja kwa moja.
Kupanga matoleo pamoja na timu za kiutendaji na za kitabibu, ikiwemo msaada wa kuanza kutumika, mafunzo na mipango ya kurudi nyuma.
Kuhakikisha uhakikisho wa usalama wa kitabibu, usimamizi wa taarifa na ufikivu unafanyika sambamba na utoaji, si mwishoni.
Kusimamia bajeti ya timu, mikataba ya wasambazaji na upatikanaji wa rasilimali.
Kuripoti maendeleo, hatari na manufaa kwa bodi za usimamizi kwa maneno rahisi.
Kujenga utamaduni mzuri wa timu na kuwaongoza wanachama wa timu katika njia za kufanya kazi za agile.
qualifications: Uzoefu mkubwa wa kutoa bidhaa au huduma za kidijitali kwa kutumia mbinu za agile.
levels.jobEvaluationNotes: Hakuna ngazi ya Daraja la 6 kwa sababu UK GDaD PCF haina ngazi ya meneja wa utoaji kati ya msaidizi (EO/HEO) na meneja wa utoaji (SEO/G7).

levels.title: Meneja mwandamizi wa utoaji
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A senior delivery manager is accountable for the effective delivery of complex, high risk products and services. The role is similar to a delivery manager role, but senior delivery managers have more experience across a range of products and services, throughout the entire product life cycle, and have greater responsibility and accountability as the main point of escalation.

At this role level, you will:
- have strong communication skills and engage senior stakeholders
- coach and mentor delivery managers
responsibilities: Kuongoza utoaji wa huduma tata au zenye hatari kubwa, kama zile zinazotumika katika huduma za dharura au zinazobadilisha mfumo mkuu wa kitabibu.
Kuwa kituo kikuu cha kupeleka juu hatari za utoaji, masuala na utegemezi katika timu kadhaa.
Kupanga usambazaji mkubwa katika maeneo na taasisi, pamoja na maafisa wa usalama wa kitabibu na viongozi wa kiutendaji.
Kusimamia bajeti, mipango ya kibiashara na utendaji wa wasambazaji kwa huduma.
Kusimamia moja kwa moja na kuendeleza mameneja wa utoaji.
qualifications: Uzoefu mpana wa kutoa huduma tata za kidijitali katika mzunguko wao wote wa maisha.

levels.title: Mkuu wa usimamizi wa utoaji
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A head of (Agile) delivery management is an experienced practitioner who exemplifies what good looks like across the delivery roles.

At this role level, you will:
- represent and champion the role within your department, across government and in industry
- lead the community of practice for this role and build capability and excellence (in an Agile, Lean practice)
- be responsible for the recruitment of the right people to the right teams
- support professional development and continuous improvement of your community
- work with other heads of roles to promote effective cross-functional delivery
- be a skilled team leader who can confidently communicate the value of the role to digital and non-digital stakeholders
- be credible and influential across departments
responsibilities: Kuongoza taaluma ya usimamizi wa utoaji na kuweka viwango vya taasisi vya utoaji wa agile.
Kuajiri, kuendeleza na kupeleka mameneja wa utoaji katika jalada lote.
Kuhakikisha mbinu za utoaji zinatimiza mahitaji ya usalama wa kitabibu, usimamizi wa taarifa na uhakikisho bila kupunguza kasi ya timu bila sababu.
Kuwashauri viongozi watendaji na wa kitabibu kuhusu hatari za utoaji, uwezo na vipaumbele.
Kusimamia bajeti na mpango wa nguvu kazi wa taaluma.
qualifications: Uzoefu mpana wa kuongoza utoaji katika timu nyingi na wa kuongoza mazoezi ya utoaji.

roles.title: Meneja wa bidhaa
roles.summary: Mameneja wa bidhaa huhakikisha bidhaa za afya za kidijitali za taasisi zinakidhi mahitaji ya wagonjwa, madaktari na wafanyakazi wa matunzo na kutoa thamani kwa mfumo wa afya na matunzo. Huweka maono na ramani ya njia ya bidhaa, huweka vipaumbele vya kazi ya timu za fani mbalimbali kwa ushahidi, na kuwajibika kwa matokeo ambayo bidhaa zao zinafikia, ikiwemo athari kwa matunzo.
healthContext: Maamuzi ya bidhaa yanaweza kuathiri usalama wa mgonjwa, hivyo mameneja wa bidhaa humiliki hatari ya kitabibu ya bidhaa yao pamoja na afisa wa usalama wa kitabibu na kuhakikisha hatari zinasimamiwa kabla ya toleo.
Bidhaa huhudumia makundi mengi ya watumiaji wenye mahitaji tofauti, kama vile wagonjwa, walezi, madaktari na wafanyakazi wa kiutawala, na mameneja wa bidhaa lazima wayasawazishe kwa haki.
Baadhi ya bidhaa zinaweza kudhibitiwa kama vifaa tiba, hivyo mameneja wa bidhaa wanahitaji kujua ni lini udhibiti unatumika na kupanga kuuhusu.

Matokeo katika matunzo hujumuisha usalama, ubora, ufikiaji, usawa na muda wa wafanyakazi, hivyo mameneja wa bidhaa hufafanua vipimo vya mafanikio ambavyo viongozi wa kitabibu na wa kiutendaji wanavitambua.
Bidhaa mara nyingi hutegemea viwango vya data za afya vya kitaifa na kikanda na majukwaa yanayoshirikiwa, hivyo mameneja wa bidhaa hufanya kazi kuvuka mipaka ya taasisi.

pcfRole.name: Product manager
pcfRole.description:
A product manager makes sure that their products provide value and achieve the right outcomes by balancing user and business needs.

In this role, you will:
- work with multidisciplinary teams, bringing together their views, user needs and business needs, to frame the problem
- work with multidisciplinary teams to provide the right outcomes for users and the organisation
- make decisions on priorities for your teams
- ensure teams comply with appropriate standards

levels.title: Meneja msaidizi wa bidhaa
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
An associate product manager is responsible for features, components or part of a product, contributing to the delivery of value.

This can be an entry-level role for civil servants who are looking to move into a digital role or those on emerging talent schemes.

At this role level, you will:
- work with product managers to advocate for user needs throughout the organisation, prioritising delivery of greatest value
- manage a smaller product with support, or a subset of features of a larger product
- learn product management approaches and methods
responsibilities: Kumiliki orodha ya kazi ya kipengele au sehemu ya bidhaa, akifanya kazi na meneja wa bidhaa.
Kugeuza ushahidi kutoka utafiti wa watumiaji na wagonjwa, madaktari na wafanyakazi wa matunzo kuwa hadithi za watumiaji zilizopewa vipaumbele.
Kufanya kazi na maafisa wa usalama wa kitabibu kurekodi na kukagua hatari za vipengele anavyovimiliki.
Kufuatilia vipimo vya bidhaa, kama vile kupitishwa, viwango vya kukamilisha na simu za msaada, na kuripoti vinavyoonyesha.
Kuwakilisha bidhaa kwenye maonyesho na kwa wadau wa kiutendaji.
qualifications: Uzoefu katika nafasi ya kidijitali, ya kitabibu au ya kiutendaji, au uzoefu unaolingana.

levels.title: Meneja wa bidhaa
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A product manager is responsible for product quality and value, working with the team to identify, implement and improve strategies and tactics for their products. They might recruit and manage people in the product profession, ensuring people with the right skills are hired, supported and developed.

This can be an entry-level role for new product managers who have been working in other digital roles.

At this role level, you will:
- lead a product through different phases of the product life cycle, from discovery, through development, delivery and continuous improvement, to retirement
- support lead and senior product managers
- prioritise work for your teams and be able to measure outcomes
responsibilities: Kuweka maono, ramani ya njia na vipimo vya mafanikio kwa bidhaa ya afya ya kidijitali.
Kuweka vipaumbele vya kazi ya timu, akisawazisha mahitaji ya watumiaji, usalama wa kitabibu, sera, vikwazo vya kiufundi na gharama.
Kukubali hatari ya kitabibu kwa mabadiliko ya bidhaa pamoja na afisa wa usalama wa kitabibu, na kusimamisha matoleo yasiyo salama.
Kufanya kazi na viongozi wa kitabibu na wa kiutendaji kuhakikisha bidhaa inalingana na njia za matunzo na inapitishwa.
Kuhakikisha bidhaa inatimiza viwango vya ufikivu, usimamizi wa taarifa na huduma.
Kupima matokeo ya bidhaa, ikiwemo manufaa yake kwa wagonjwa na wafanyakazi.
qualifications: Uzoefu mkubwa wa usimamizi wa bidhaa au wa nafasi inayohusiana ya kidijitali.

levels.title: Meneja mwandamizi wa bidhaa
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A senior product manager can work on a group of products that share a value proposition, or a single product that is complex, high risk or sensitive. They are responsible for product quality and value, working with teams to identify, implement and improve strategies and tactics for their products. They might also be involved in parts of programme management activity.

At this role level, you will:
- lead products through different phases of the product life cycle, from discovery, through development, delivery and continuous improvement, to retirement
- make decisions based on the overall quality and value of your products
- manage associate product managers and product managers
- be involved in recruiting associate product managers, product managers and contractors
responsibilities: Kuongoza kundi la bidhaa zinazohusiana, au bidhaa moja tata, yenye hatari kubwa au nyeti, kama ile inayotumika katika huduma za dharura.
Kujenga mkakati wa bidhaa kutoka ushahidi kuhusu mahitaji ya wagonjwa, mazoezi ya kitabibu na sera ya afya na matunzo.
Kuhakikisha bidhaa inatimiza udhibiti wa vifaa tiba pale unapotumika.
Kusimamia bajeti ya bidhaa na kutoa hoja ya uwekezaji kwa manufaa ya matunzo.
Kuwaongoza na kuwasimamia moja kwa moja mameneja wa bidhaa.
qualifications: Uzoefu mpana wa kusimamia bidhaa za kidijitali katika mzunguko wao mzima wa maisha.

levels.title: Meneja kiongozi wa bidhaa
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A lead product manager is responsible for a product portfolio or end-to-end service, and the delivery of product quality and value. They work with teams to identify, implement and improve strategies and tactics for their products. They are a member of the management team for their product area and provide product leadership and direction across multiple teams.

At this role level, you will:
- manage people and manage products
- maintain the high level roadmap
- be involved in a range of programme management activities relevant to the product portfolio
- be involved in recruiting product managers at all levels and contractors
- provide leadership in your programmes and across the local community, working closely with the head of product, where they exist
responsibilities: Kuongoza jalada la bidhaa au huduma kutoka mwanzo hadi mwisho, kama vile bidhaa zote zinazounga mkono njia moja ya matunzo.
Kuweka mwelekeo wa bidhaa katika timu kadhaa na kuhakikisha bidhaa zinafanya kazi pamoja kwa wagonjwa na wafanyakazi.
Kufanya kazi na viongozi wa kitabibu na afisa wa usalama wa kitabibu kusimamia hatari ya kitabibu katika jalada.
Kushikilia bajeti ya jalada na kuripoti manufaa kwa bodi za juu za usimamizi.
Kuongoza na kuendeleza mameneja wa bidhaa katika eneo la bidhaa.
qualifications: Uzoefu mpana wa kuongoza bidhaa katika timu nyingi.

levels.title: Mkuu wa bidhaa
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A head of product provides support to all product managers in the organisation and to the product community across government. They lead on product strategy, working closely with lead product managers and their business units. They are responsible for setting and raising standards for product management in their organisation.

At this role level, you will:
- coach others in product management
- work with organisation management and other communities to represent product community interests
- oversee every member of the community, including their role, assignments, development, pay and performance
- manage recruitment, development, moves and exits from the community, covering civil servants and contractors
- line manage senior and lead product managers
responsibilities: Kuweka mkakati wa bidhaa wa taasisi, akifanya kazi na viongozi watendaji, wa kitabibu na wa kiutendaji.
Kuweka na kuinua viwango vya usimamizi wa bidhaa, ikiwemo jinsi bidhaa zinavyosimamia hatari ya kitabibu na kupima matokeo.
Kuongoza taaluma ya bidhaa, ikiwemo uajiri, njia za taaluma na kujenga uwezo.
Kuamua vipaumbele vya uwekezaji katika bidhaa, akitumia ushahidi wa hitaji, thamani na usawa.
Kuwakilisha bidhaa za taasisi kwa washirika katika mfumo wa afya na matunzo.
qualifications: Uzoefu mpana wa kuongoza usimamizi wa bidhaa katika taasisi.

roles.title: Meneja wa mradi
roles.summary: Mameneja wa miradi hupanga na kutoa miradi inayobadilisha jinsi taasisi inavyosaidia afya na matunzo, kama vile kusambaza mfumo wa kitabibu kwenye maeneo mapya, kuhamisha huduma kwenye miundombinu mipya, au kuanzisha zana mpya za kidijitali kwa wafanyakazi wa matunzo. Hudhibiti wigo, muda, gharama, ubora na hatari, kwa kutumia mbinu za mradi zinazotambuliwa, na kuhakikisha miradi inatoa manufaa iliyoahidi kwa wagonjwa na wafanyakazi.
healthContext: Miradi inayobadilisha mifumo au mtiririko wa kazi za kitabibu inahitaji uhakikisho wa usalama wa kitabibu kabla ya kuanza kutumika, hivyo mameneja wa miradi hupanga warsha za hatari, idhini ya hoja za usalama na mchango wa afisa wa usalama wa kitabibu katika ratiba.

Kuanza kutumika hakupaswi kuvuruga matunzo ya wagonjwa, hivyo mameneja wa miradi hupanga mpito, mipango ya mwendelezo wa biashara na msaada wa kuzunguka maeneo ya kazi pamoja na timu za kitabibu na za kiutendaji.
Miradi mara nyingi inahitaji tathmini za athari za ulinzi wa data na makubaliano ya ushirikishaji wa taarifa, hivyo mameneja wa miradi huyapanga mapema pamoja na wenzake wa usimamizi wa taarifa.

Manufaa katika matunzo, kama vile muda wa wafanyakazi uliookolewa au makosa machache, huchukua muda kuonekana, hivyo mameneja wa miradi huweka vipimo vya msingi na kukabidhi ufuatiliaji wa manufaa kwa huduma.

levels.title: Meneja msaidizi wa mradi
levels.summary: Meneja msaidizi wa mradi husaidia utoaji wa miradi, au husimamia miradi midogo iliyobainishwa vizuri kwa mwongozo wa meneja mwandamizi zaidi wa mradi.
responsibilities: Kutunza mipango ya mradi, kumbukumbu za hatari na masuala, kumbukumbu za hatua na rekodi za utegemezi.
Kupanga na kuandika muhtasari wa mikutano na bodi za mradi, na kufuatilia hatua.
Kusimamia vipande vidogo vilivyobainishwa vizuri vya kazi, kama vile usambazaji wa eneo au ratiba ya mafunzo, kwa mwongozo.
Kufuatilia kazi za utayari wa kuanza kutumika, kama vile idhini ya usalama wa kitabibu, ukaguzi wa ulinzi wa data na mafunzo ya wafanyakazi.
Kuandaa ripoti za mambo muhimu na kufuatilia matumizi ya mradi dhidi ya bajeti.
qualifications: Sifa ya msingi ya usimamizi wa miradi, au uzoefu unaolingana.

levels.title: Meneja wa mradi
levels.summary: Meneja wa mradi huendesha miradi ya ukubwa na ugumu wa wastani kuanzia mwanzo hadi kufunga, kama vile kusambaza huduma ya kidijitali katika mazingira kadhaa ya matunzo.
responsibilities: Kupanga na kusimamia miradi kuanzia kuanzishwa hadi kufunga, akidhibiti wigo, muda, gharama, ubora na hatari.
Kupanga kuanza kutumika pamoja na timu za kitabibu na za kiutendaji, ikiwemo mpito, mwendelezo wa biashara na mipango ya msaada.
Kuhakikisha uhakikisho wa usalama wa kitabibu, usimamizi wa taarifa na ufikivu umepangwa na kukamilika kabla ya kuanza kutumika.
Kusimamia bajeti ya mradi na vitu vinavyopaswa kutolewa na wasambazaji.
Kuripoti kwa bodi ya mradi na kupeleka juu hatari na masuala nje ya uvumilivu.
Kuweka vipimo vya msingi vya manufaa na kukabidhi ufuatiliaji wa manufaa kwa huduma.
qualifications: Sifa inayotambuliwa ya usimamizi wa miradi, kama vile cheti cha kiwango cha mtendaji, au uzoefu unaolingana.
Uzoefu wa kusimamia miradi inayobadilisha huduma au mifumo.

levels.title: Meneja mwandamizi wa mradi
levels.summary: Meneja mwandamizi wa mradi huongoza miradi mikubwa, tata au yenye hatari kubwa, kama vile kubadilisha mfumo wa kitabibu katika taasisi nzima, na anaweza kusimamia wafanyakazi wengine wa mradi.
responsibilities: Kuongoza miradi mikubwa au yenye hatari kubwa, kama vile kubadilisha mifumo ya kitabibu au usambazaji wa maeneo mengi.
Kusimamia utegemezi tata na wasambazaji, miradi mingine na taasisi washirika za afya na matunzo.
Kuongoza maamuzi ya kuanza kutumika pamoja na afisa wa usalama wa kitabibu, viongozi wa kiutendaji na mmiliki mkuu mwenye wajibu.
Kusimamia bajeti ya mradi na mipango ya kibiashara, ikiwemo udhibiti wa mabadiliko na wasambazaji.
Kuhakikisha manufaa kwa wagonjwa na wafanyakazi yanafafanuliwa, yanamilikiwa na kupimwa.
Kusimamia na kuendeleza mameneja wa miradi na wafanyakazi wa msaada wa mradi.
qualifications: Sifa inayotambuliwa ya usimamizi wa miradi, au uzoefu unaolingana.
Uzoefu mkubwa wa kusimamia miradi tata katika mazingira yanayodhibitiwa au yanayohusu usalama.

levels.title: Meneja kiongozi wa mradi
levels.summary: Meneja kiongozi wa mradi huongoza miradi tata zaidi au kundi la miradi inayohusiana, na huweka mazoezi ya usimamizi wa miradi kwa eneo lake.
responsibilities: Kuongoza miradi tata zaidi, au kundi la miradi inayohusiana, katika huduma au taasisi kadhaa.
Kuweka viwango vya usimamizi wa miradi, violezo na uhakikisho kwa eneo, na kuwaongoza mameneja wa miradi.
Kuwashauri wamiliki wakuu wenye wajibu na bodi kuhusu chaguzi za utoaji, hatari na kuokoa miradi inayosuasua.
Kusimamia bajeti na mikataba mikubwa, na kuhakikisha miradi inatoa thamani ya fedha.
Kuhakikisha mahitaji ya usalama wa kitabibu na usimamizi wa taarifa yanatimizwa katika kundi la miradi.
Kusimamia moja kwa moja mameneja wa miradi.
qualifications: Uzoefu mpana wa kuongoza miradi tata, akiwa na sifa inayotambuliwa ya usimamizi wa miradi au uzoefu unaolingana.

levels.title: Mkuu wa usimamizi wa miradi
levels.summary: Mkuu wa usimamizi wa miradi huongoza mazoezi ya usimamizi wa miradi ya taasisi na mameneja wa miradi wanaotoa mabadiliko yake ya kidijitali.
responsibilities: Kuongoza mazoezi ya usimamizi wa miradi, ikiwemo mbinu, viwango, zana na uhakikisho wake.
Kugawa mameneja wa miradi kwa miradi ya taasisi na kusimamia uwezo wa mazoezi.
Kujenga uwezo wa usimamizi wa miradi, ikiwemo uajiri, mafunzo na njia za taaluma.
Kuwashauri viongozi watendaji kuhusu afya ya miradi, hatari za utoaji na mafunzo yaliyopatikana.
Kusimamia bajeti ya mazoezi.
qualifications: Uzoefu mpana wa kuongoza miradi na mameneja wa miradi, akiwa na sifa inayotambuliwa ya usimamizi wa miradi au uzoefu unaolingana.

roles.title: Meneja wa utoaji wa programu ya miradi
roles.summary: Mameneja wa utoaji wa programu ya miradi wanawajibika kutoa huduma tata za afya za kidijitali zinazohitaji timu, wasambazaji au taasisi kadhaa kufanya kazi pamoja, au zenye hatari kubwa za kiufundi, za kitabibu au za umma. Husimamia utegemezi, bajeti, mipango ya kibiashara na watu katika programu, na kuhakikisha inatoa manufaa yaliyokusudiwa kwa wagonjwa, madaktari na wafanyakazi wa matunzo.
healthContext: Programu mara nyingi hubadilisha jinsi matunzo yanavyotolewa katika taasisi kadhaa, hivyo mameneja wa utoaji wa programu huratibu viongozi wa kitabibu, wa kiutendaji na wa kidijitali wenye vipaumbele na usimamizi tofauti.

Hatari ya kitabibu lazima isimamiwe katika programu nzima, si ndani ya kila timu tu, hivyo hufanya kazi na maafisa wa usalama wa kitabibu kuweka mtazamo wa ngazi ya programu wa hatari na hoja za usalama.
Programu mara nyingi huhusisha mikataba mikubwa na wasambazaji wa mifumo ya kitabibu, hivyo usimamizi wa kibiashara na wa mikataba ni sehemu kubwa ya nafasi hii.

Manufaa katika matunzo, kama vile muda mfupi wa kusubiri, uandikaji salama zaidi wa dawa, au muda wa wafanyakazi uliookolewa, lazima yafafanuliwe, yamilikiwe na huduma, na kufuatiliwa muda mrefu baada ya programu kufungwa.

pcfRole.name: Programme delivery manager
pcfRole.description: A programme delivery manager is accountable for the delivery of complex products and services that are being delivered by multiple teams or have high technical or political risk.

levels.title: Meneja wa utoaji wa programu ya miradi
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A programme delivery manager is accountable for the delivery of complex products and services that are delivered by multiple teams or have high technical or political risk.

At this role level, you will:
- manage dependencies of varying complexity, potentially planning and feeding into larger programmes and portfolios
- remove blockers and manage risks, commercials, budgets and people
- balance objectives and redeploy people and resources as priorities change
- have an in-depth knowledge of Agile and other methodologies
- be responsible for understanding, managing and communicating to complex stakeholder groups, balancing priorities
- be the initial escalation point for the programme
- have an awareness of the bigger picture
- support the programme director by overseeing the delivery of their vision for the programme
- support and coach delivery managers
responsibilities: Kuongoza utoaji wa programu ya timu kadhaa, kama vile kuanzisha huduma mpya ya kidijitali katika njia ya matunzo.
Kupanga na kusimamia utegemezi kati ya timu, wasambazaji na taasisi washirika za afya na matunzo.
Kuweka mtazamo wa ngazi ya programu wa hatari ya kitabibu pamoja na afisa wa usalama wa kitabibu, na kuhakikisha kila toleo lina uhakikisho linaouhitaji.
Kusimamia bajeti ya programu, mikataba na utendaji wa wasambazaji.
Kuripoti maendeleo, hatari na manufaa kwa bodi ya programu na mmiliki mkuu mwenye wajibu.
Kusimamia moja kwa moja mameneja wa utoaji na kujenga utamaduni mzuri wa utoaji katika programu.
qualifications: Uzoefu mpana wa kutoa huduma au programu tata za kidijitali za timu nyingi.

levels.title: Meneja mwandamizi wa utoaji wa programu ya miradi
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A programme delivery manager is accountable for the delivery of complex products and services that are delivered by multiple teams or have high technical or political risk.

At this role level, you will:
- manage dependencies of varying complexity, potentially planning and feeding into larger programmes and portfolios
- remove blockers and manage risks, commercials, budgets and people
- balance objectives and redeploy people and resources as priorities change
- have an in-depth knowledge of Agile and other methodologies
- be responsible for understanding, managing and communicating to complex stakeholder groups, balancing priorities
- be the initial escalation point for the programme
- have an awareness of the bigger picture
- support the programme director by overseeing the delivery of their vision for the programme
- support and coach delivery managers
responsibilities: Kuongoza utoaji wa programu kubwa zaidi au zenye hatari kubwa zaidi za taasisi, kama vile kubadilisha rekodi kuu ya mgonjwa ya kielektroniki au kumbukumbu ya matunzo inayoshirikiwa ya mfumo mzima.
Kuratibu utoaji katika taasisi kadhaa za mfumo wa matunzo, akioanisha mipango, usimamizi na maamuzi yao ya kuanza kutumika.
Kuongoza mkakati wa kibiashara na majadiliano na wasambazaji wakuu, na kusimamia bajeti za programu kwa miaka kadhaa.
Kuhakikisha usalama wa kitabibu, usimamizi wa taarifa na mwendelezo wa biashara vimehakikishwa katika ngazi ya programu kabla ya kuanza kutumika kwa kiwango kikubwa.
Kuongoza na kuendeleza mameneja wa programu na wa utoaji, na kuweka viwango vya utoaji katika jalada.
Kuwashauri viongozi watendaji kuhusu hatari za programu, chaguzi na urejeshaji.
qualifications: Uzoefu mpana wa kuongoza programu kubwa zenye hatari kubwa katika taasisi mbalimbali.
levels.jobEvaluationNotes: UK GDaD PCF ina ngazi moja ya meneja wa utoaji wa programu ya miradi, katika G7 au G6. Marejeleo haya yanaongeza ngazi ya uandamizi katika Daraja la 8c kwa programu kubwa zaidi za taasisi mbalimbali, zenye bajeti kubwa zaidi (rasilimali za fedha kiwango cha 5) na mawasiliano yenye mabishano zaidi (kiwango cha 6).

roles.title: Meneja wa jalada la miradi ya kidijitali
roles.summary: Mameneja wa jalada la miradi ya kidijitali huisaidia taasisi kuchagua, kufuatilia na kusimamia jalada lake la miradi, programu na bidhaa za kidijitali ili iwekeze katika kazi inayowanufaisha zaidi wagonjwa, madaktari na wafanyakazi wa matunzo. Huendesha usimamizi na kuripoti wa jalada, huwasaidia viongozi kuweka vipaumbele kwa ushahidi mzuri, na kuhakikisha jalada linatoa manufaa lililoahidi.
healthContext: Kazi ya kidijitali inashindania ufadhili na matunzo ya mstari wa mbele, hivyo mameneja wa jalada huwasaidia viongozi kuonyesha manufaa ya uwekezaji wa kidijitali kwa wagonjwa na wafanyakazi.
Usimamizi wa jalada lazima ujumuishe uhakikisho wa usalama wa kitabibu, usimamizi wa taarifa na usalama wa mtandao, hivyo mameneja wa jalada huvifuatilia pamoja na muda, gharama na wigo.

Miradi mingi ya kidijitali hutegemea uwezo wa timu za kitabibu na za kiutendaji, kama vile madaktari wa kujaribu au wafanyakazi wa kufunzwa, hivyo mameneja wa jalada hutazama migongano ya mahitaji kwa huduma.
Ufadhili mara nyingi hutoka vyanzo kadhaa vyenye kanuni na tarehe zao za kuripoti, hivyo mameneja wa jalada huweka kuripoti kuwa sahihi na kwa wakati.

pcfRole.name: Digital portfolio manager
pcfRole.description: A digital portfolio manager co-ordinates and manages a group , or ‘portfolio’, of digital projects. In this role, you will use an iterative and flexible approach to help define governance processes for this portfolio.

levels.title: Mchambuzi wa jalada la miradi ya kidijitali
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A digital portfolio analyst supports the tracking, analysis and delivery of outcomes across a portfolio of digital projects. This role level may be called ‘associate digital portfolio manager’ in your organisation.

As you will be learning basic portfolio management skills, you will report to a more senior portfolio manager.
responsibilities: Kukusanya na kukagua data za hali, hatari, fedha na manufaa kutoka miradi katika jalada.
Kutunza sajili ya jalada na dashibodi, na kutambua mapengo au kutolingana katika kuripoti.
Kuandaa nyaraka na ripoti kwa bodi za usimamizi wa jalada.
Kufuatilia hatua muhimu za uhakikisho, kama vile idhini ya usalama wa kitabibu na tathmini za athari za ulinzi wa data, katika miradi.
Kuwasaidia mameneja wa jalada kwa uchambuzi wa vipaumbele na mipango.
qualifications: Shahada au sifa husika, au uzoefu unaolingana wa uchambuzi au kuripoti.
levels.jobEvaluationNotes: UK GDaD PCF inaweka ngazi za mchambuzi na meneja zote katika HEO au SEO. Marejeleo haya yanaweka mchambuzi katika Daraja la 5, kwa sababu ni ngazi ya kujifunza inayoripoti kwa meneja wa jalada, na meneja katika Daraja la 6, ili ngazi hizi mbili zisiwe katika daraja moja.

levels.title: Meneja wa jalada la miradi ya kidijitali
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A digital portfolio manager helps to co-ordinate and manage a portfolio of digital projects.

At this role level, you will:
- help to create environments that enable teams to deliver
- support the prioritisation of a group of projects and programmes
- help teams to follow governance and delivery processes
- help stakeholders understand the performance of work and any related risks
- support more senior portfolio managers and leadership in making improvements
responsibilities: Kuratibu jalada la miradi na programu za kidijitali, kama vile kazi zote za kidijitali za kurugenzi moja.
Kuzisaidia timu kufuata michakato ya usimamizi, uhakikisho na utoaji, na kuifanya iwe sawia.
Kuwasaidia viongozi kuweka vipaumbele vya kazi kwa kutumia ushahidi wa hitaji, manufaa, hatari na uwezo.
Kuripoti utendaji wa jalada, hatari na manufaa kwa uwazi kwa bodi na wadau.
Kutambua migongano ya mahitaji kwa timu za kitabibu na za kiutendaji katika miradi na kusaidia kuitatua.
qualifications: Uzoefu wa usimamizi wa jalada, programu au mradi, au uzoefu unaolingana.

levels.title: Meneja mwandamizi wa jalada la miradi ya kidijitali
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A senior digital portfolio manager is responsible for co-ordinating and managing a portfolio of digital projects.

At this role level, you will:
- track, analyse and help deliver outcomes in your portfolio
- give guidance and deal with issues to help teams to deliver faster
- manage governance and assurance processes, and ensure standards are met
- provide information to stakeholders on work performance and related risks
responsibilities: Kusimamia jalada la kidijitali la taasisi, au sehemu kubwa yake, na michakato yake ya usimamizi na uhakikisho.
Kufuatilia na kuchambua matokeo na manufaa katika jalada, na kuchukua hatua juu ya masuala ili kusaidia timu kutoa.
Kuhakikisha jalada linatimiza viwango, ikiwemo uhakikisho wa usalama wa kitabibu, usimamizi wa taarifa na usalama wa mtandao.
Kuwashauri viongozi wakuu kuhusu vipaumbele, uwekezaji na maridhiano, kwa ushahidi ulio wazi.
Kusimamia kuripoti kwa jalada kwa wafadhili na vyombo vya nje.
Kusimamia moja kwa moja wachambuzi na mameneja wa jalada.
qualifications: Uzoefu mpana wa usimamizi wa jalada au programu, katika kiwango kinacholingana na shahada ya uzamili.
levels.jobEvaluationNotes: Hakuna ngazi ya Daraja la 7 kwa sababu UK GDaD PCF inahama kutoka meneja wa jalada la kidijitali (HEO/SEO) hadi meneja mwandamizi wa jalada la kidijitali (G7).

levels.title: Mkuu wa jalada la kidijitali
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A head of portfolio leads a team of digital portfolio managers. You will ensure the portfolio of digital projects delivers the best possible outcomes.

At this role level, you will:
- lead the tracking and governing of digital projects
- ensure the right controls are used
- address risks and deal with, or escalate, issues
- provide leaders with insights into the portfolio's future so they can make informed decisions
- build and lead a diverse, skilled and motivated team of digital portfolio managers
- ensure the portfolio team is meeting the needs of the organisation
- support the professional development of the portfolio community, including line management and coaching
responsibilities: Kuongoza kitengo cha jalada la kidijitali na timu ya mameneja wa jalada.
